plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-plugins

DSH Harness 的自制插件。两个：

| 插件 | 做什么 |
| --- | --- |
| `dsh-comprehensive-platform` | 把自制功能收进设置里的一个页面，导航名「综合平台」 |
| `dsh-localcoding-mcp` | 把 LocalCodingMCP 接进宿主：本地工具入表、任务出给 Codex、隧道打通网页版 ChatGPT |

## 综合平台（`dsh-comprehensive-platform`）

### 页面

综合平台是一个设置页、4 个页签：用量统计 / 归档历史 / 记忆系统 / FreeModel。

前三页（用量统计 / 归档历史 / 记忆系统）用本插件自己的 `/dsh-desktop/*` 路由，数据在本插件里。

第四页 FreeModel **不是本插件写的页面**：它是 `dsh-our-free-model` 的设置页。做法是把它自己的
代码取过来，只改必须改的地方（清单在 `tools/vendor-our-free-model.mjs` 的文件头与服务端阶段的
注释里，每处都写了为什么），再挂成这一页的第四个页签：

- **页面**（前端）内嵌在 `client.js` 的 VENDOR 段里，十三处改动，含删掉它的「免费模型」页、
  去掉它自己的标题行与「公告中心」面板、EAC 挪到第三、API 指向本插件自己的前缀。
- **服务端**在 `free-model/`，提供 `/api/comprehensive-platform/free-model/*`。
  它自己的自更新、公告通道与热重载都已停用——那三样都会改写已安装的字节，而那些字节现在是
  本插件的；数据目录也换成自己的，避免两个插件写同一份目录。

所以这一页**不依赖任何其他插件**：装这一个就完整可用。那 8 个页面（白嫖模型接入 / 聚合渠道 /
EAC 模型 / 省 Token / 路由 / 数据看板 / 运行日志 / 网关设置）的行为与原版一致。
来源与改动写在 `free-model/NOTICE.md`。

> **那 13 个账号渠道的包不在这个仓库里。** `free-model/vendor/channel-pack/` 是第三方项目的整份拷贝，
> 里面带着它的 Google OAuth 凭据；本仓库是公开的，推上去等于公开别人的凭据（GitHub 的推送保护也确实拦了）。
> 所以它 `.gitignore` 掉了，只留在装了它的机器上。缺了它插件照常工作：渠道列表会显示「渠道包不可用」
> 与原因，其余页面（免费车道、EAC 模型、账本、日志、网关、省 Token、路由）不受影响——这是它自己的降级路径。
> 它的 LICENSE 与 NOTICE 仍然在仓库里，第三方来源有据可查。
## 本地编码 MCP（`dsh-localcoding-mcp`）

**不启动任何外部程序。** 工具直接实现在本插件里（Node + 宿主 `ctx.tools.register`），
没有子进程、没有本地端口、没有需要单独编译的二进制。四个方向：

- **本地工具**：宿主工具表多出 30 多个 `lcm_*` 工具 —— 读写改文件、目录操作、搜索与符号定位、
  git 状态/差异/提交/还原、构建与测试、长驻进程会话、以及一个**可撤销的改动日志**
  （`lcm_undo_last_change`）。所有路径都被限制在工作区内，越界直接拒绝。
- **对外提供 MCP**：插件自己在 `/mcp` 上提供 MCP（streamable HTTP），
  和本地工具是**同一批实现**。Codex 用 `codex mcp add dsh-localcoding --url http://127.0.0.1:19387/mcp` 接进来。
- **本应用模型给 Codex 用**：插件在 `/v1` 上提供 OpenAI 兼容端点，背后是宿主的 `llm` 服务。
  设置页一个按钮把 `~/.codex/config.toml` 改成指向它（**改前自动备份**，可一键还原），
  于是 Codex 跑的就是本应用正在用的模型 —— 不需要第三方中转、不需要单独的 API Key、不用 `codex login`。
- **网页版 ChatGPT → 本地**：`chatgpt.com` 的连接器够不到 `127.0.0.1`，
  所以设置页按账号起 `tunnel-client.exe`（OpenAI 官方**出站**守护进程），
  它主动连 OpenAI 控制面；之后在 `chatgpt.com/#settings/Connectors` 里选中这条隧道，
  网页版 ChatGPT 就能调用上面那批工具。**这是唯一不需要开放入站端口的接法。**
  设置页可按账号启停、看 `/readyz` 与 `doctor` 输出，并提示
  `/readyz` 只证明进程活着 —— 真正的验收是去连接器里发一次真实工具调用。
  可选的浏览器面（Playwright MCP）也走同一个连接器。

设置页显示：工具表、两个端点的地址与可直接粘贴的客户端配置、Codex 状态、隧道舰队。
`sourceMode: 'external-mcp'` 是给「别人已经在跑 LocalCodingMCP.exe」的场景留的**只连接、不启动**模式。

> 两个账号相关的前提本机还不满足：`accounts.json` 里三个账号的 `organizationId` 都是空的
> （会得到 `403 tunnel_active_organization_required`），隧道 ID 也可能已过期需要在
> `platform.openai.com/settings/organization/tunnels` 重新建。控制面密钥是 DPAPI 加密串，
> 只在内存里解开，不进日志、不进响应、不进任何配置。

## 安装

前置：**DSH Desktop 至少启动过一次**（profile 的 `package.json` 由它生成），PATH 上有 `pnpm`
（`corepack enable pnpm` 或 `npm i -g pnpm`）。不需要装别的插件：四个页签的数据都在本插件里。

```powershell
git clone https://github.com/TiaYahng/dsh-plugins.git
cd dsh-plugins
powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File .\install-to-profile.ps1 -Plugin dsh-comprehensive-platform
```

重启 DSH Desktop，插件管理里出现「综合平台」即可。脚本做四件事：把插件复制进
`%APPDATA%\dsh-desktop\harness\profiles\web\plugins`、在 profile 的 `package.json` 里注册
`file:` 依赖与 `dsh.profile.bundles`、删掉 `node_modules` 里的旧拷贝再 `pnpm install --force`
（pnpm 对 `file:` 依赖是实体拷贝而不是链接，不删就还在跑旧代码）、最后确认
`cordis.patch.yml` 进了 `node_modules`。

只想要「综合平台」就带 `-Plugin dsh-comprehensive-platform`。不带这个参数会装上仓库里的两个插件，
而 `dsh-localcoding-mcp` 需要本机有编译好的 `LocalCodingMCP.exe`（仓库里没有），缺它跑起来是坏的。
其他参数：`-DshHome` / `-Profile` 换目标，`-SkipPnpm` 只复制与注册、不装依赖。

装完用这两条路由自检（宿主在跑时返回 200 即已激活）：

```
/dsh-desktop/usage-stats/summary   综合平台 › 用量统计
/dsh-desktop/shell/archive.list    综合平台 › 归档历史
```

**换一套 harness 数据目录时不要用这个脚本**，它第 3 步的 pnpm 在那套 profile 上会把
`node_modules` 弄坏（原因见 `docs/ENGINEERING.md`）。手动三步：

```powershell
# $P 指向目标 profile 目录（harness home 下的 profiles\<profile>）
Copy-Item -Recurse -Force "$P\plugins\<插件名>" "$P\node_modules\<插件名>"
```

`package.json` 里要有 `dependencies` 的 `file:` 条目与 `dsh.profile.bundles` 的行，
然后在插件管理里把该 bundle 关一次再开一次，即刻生效、不用重启。
**改完服务端代码仍需重启应用**（Node 的 ESM 模块缓存不随开关插件清除）。

## 给 agent 与自动化安装

宿主自带的插件通道接受四种源：**npm 包名 / Git 仓库地址 / 归档链接 / 本机目录**
（设置 › 插件 › 插件管理里的安装对话框，或 `dsh plugin add <源>`）。按这四种源看：

| 源 | 现在能用吗 | 还需要什么 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 本机目录 | ✅ 已验证 | 克隆仓库后跑 `install-to-profile.ps1`（见上）。脚本做的事与宿主通道一致，只是替你写 profile 的 `package.json` |
| Git 仓库地址 | ⚠️ 未验证 | 本仓库是**多插件仓库**，宿主按包名安装单个插件，需要指向子目录的写法；本仓库尚未按这个形态验证过 |
| 归档链接 | ⚠️ 未验证 | 同上 |
| npm 包名 | ❌ 还没有 | 插件尚未发布到 npm，且 `package.json` 里 `private: true`、没有 `files` 字段 |

所以今天给别的 agent 的答案是**本机目录**那一条：克隆 → 跑脚本 → 重启应用 → 打路由自检。
要让「一条命令装上」成立，需要先把每个插件单独发布到 npm，并把 `private`、`files`、
`engines.dsh`、`dsh-plugin` 关键字补齐。

更新同一条路：`git pull` → 重跑脚本 → **重启应用**。

上架插件列表（收录后市场就能搜到）的投稿文件与步骤在 `docs/market-entry.yml`：
目录不是市场本地索引，而是由 `awesome-dsh-plugin` 仓库生成，收录要往那边提一个 PR。

## 更新

```powershell
cd dsh-plugins
git pull
powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File .\install-to-profile.ps1 -Plugin dsh-comprehensive-platform
```

然后**重启 DSH Desktop**。前端（`client.js`）改动本可以靠插件管理里关一次开一次热加载，
但服务端是 Node 的 ESM，模块缓存不随开关清除——不重启就还在跑旧的服务端代码，
而前端已经变了，两边对不上。

内嵌的那份副本要跟上上游时：先升级 profile 里的 `dsh-our-free-model`，再跑

```powershell
node tools\vendor-our-free-model.mjs
```

重新生成副本（十二处改动都记在 `tools/vendor-our-free-model.mjs` 里），然后跑自检、再重装本插件。

## 环境

- 宿主 harness `0.2.0-rc.2`，peer 依赖都是宿主自带的 `@deepseek-ai/*`
- 内嵌的上游版本：`dsh-our-free-model` 2.1.0（前端与服务端都在本仓库里，见 `free-model/NOTICE.md`）
- `dsh-localcoding-mcp` 需要已编译的 `LocalCodingMCP.exe`（0.3.0）；网页版方向另需
  `mcp-accounts\tunnel-client.exe` 与 `config\accounts.json`（可选 Playwright MCP 另需扩展令牌）
- Codex CLI 走的是第三方中转，`codex login status` 说「未登录」是**预期**的（中转用 bearer
  token，不用 OpenAI 账号登录）；真正的就绪判据是插件去探中转入口能不能连通

## 自检

```powershell
node .\test\platform-client.test.mjs .\dsh-comprehensive-platform\client.js
node .\test\archive-delete.test.mjs
node .\test\free-model-standalone.test.mjs
node .\test\schema-calls.test.mjs
node .\test\localcoding-client.test.mjs .\dsh-localcoding-mcp\client.js
node .\test\localcoding-native.test.mjs
node .\test\localcoding-process.test.mjs
node .\test\localcoding-tunnel.test.mjs
node .\test\localcoding-plugin.test.mjs
node .\test\localcoding-server.test.mjs
```

前两个前端自检必须带 `client.js` 的路径参数（只认位置参数，不吃环境变量）。
`localcoding-plugin.test.mjs` **默认加载 profile 里那份将要被宿主加载的副本**，
跑完整的 `apply()`，所以漏部署一个文件会在这里报错而不是在应用里。
`localcoding-server.test.mjs` 需要本地 MCP 服务器在跑。

不需要装依赖。实现细节、踩过的坑与未验证项见 [docs/ENGINEERING.md](docs/ENGINEERING.md)。

plugins.description: 给 DeepSeek Harness 注入你自己的 CSS：在设置界面里新增的「自定义样式」一栏直接编辑样式文件，即可调整弹窗宽度、导航宽度、字号与内容居中；约两秒生效，不改应用本体、无需重启。 ｜ Inject custom CSS into the DeepSeek Harness GUI from a new Custom CSS section in Settings — dialog width, nav width, font size and content centering; applied in about two seconds, no app patching or restart.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-custom-style

[English](./README.en.md) | 中文

把你自己写的 CSS 注入 **DeepSeek Harness** 界面——设置弹窗宽度、字号、配色、间距，想改什么就改什么。
只需编辑 `$DSH_HOME/dsh-custom-style/` 下的 `*.css` 文件，**保存约 2 秒后自动生效**：不改应用本体、不重新打包、不重启。

它还会在 **DSH 设置界面里加一栏「自定义样式」**：用几个常用数值一键调整弹窗宽度、高度、正文字号与内容居中，或是设置一张带磨砂遮罩的全屏背景图——不用离开应用就能调界面。

![效果预览](docs/images/换背景图.png)

- **宿主半身**（`index.js`）：把 `$DSH_HOME/dsh-custom-style/*.css` 按文件名顺序拼成一张样式表，经
  `GET /dsh-custom-style/all.css` 提供；首次运行自动创建目录并播种起始样式表，**绝不覆盖已有文件**。
  另外为设置面板提供文件接口（`/files`、`/file`、`/file/delete`、`/reveal`）。
- **浏览器半身**（`client.js`）：把样式表注入自己持有的 `<style data-plugin-css="dsh-custom-style">`，
  每 2 秒重新拉取一次（页面隐藏时暂停），所以改完保存就会生效，无需刷新；设置分区通过客户端 slot API 注册。
- **零第三方运行时依赖**：宿主半身只用 `node:` 内置模块，浏览器半身只用 DOM、`fetch` 和平台提供的 React。
  因此 harness 升级不会破坏它；用户 CSS 存在包外，重装插件也不会丢样式。

## 目录

- [环境要求](#环境要求)
- [安装](#安装)
- [使用](#使用)
- [稳定选择器](#稳定选择器)
- [工作原理](#工作原理)
- [排查](#排查)
- [开发](#开发)
- [兼容性](#兼容性)
- [许可证](#许可证)

## 环境要求

- 带 web/桌面客户端的 DeepSeek Harness（`dsh` 0.2.x），已在 `0.2.0-rc.2` 上验证。
- Node.js `^22.19.0 || >=24.0.0`（只有可选的本地安装器与测试套件需要）。

## 安装

**A. 从插件目录 / npm 安装**（本仓库被收录之后）：

```sh
dsh plugin add dsh-custom-style
```

没有构建步骤——`client.js` 是手写的、不是打包产物——所以直接从本仓库源码安装也可以。

**B. 从本仓库安装到当前这台机器**（仓库自带安装器做的事）：

```powershell
node install.mjs            # 只预览（dry run）
node install.mjs --apply    # 安装到 $DSH_HOME/profiles/desktop
```

它会幂等地把插件登记进 DSH profile：

| 位置 | 变成什么 |
|---|---|
| `<profile>/local-plugins/dsh-custom-style` | 目录联接 → 本仓库（单一源码）；`--copy` 则改为复制文件 |
| `<profile>/node_modules/dsh-custom-style` | 目录联接 → 上面那一层 |
| `<profile>/package.json` | `dependencies["dsh-custom-style"] = "link:./local-plugins/dsh-custom-style"` 加一条 `dsh.profile.bundles` 登记（改前备份） |
| `$DSH_HOME/dsh-custom-style/00-starter.css` | 你的样式表——**仅在缺失时**写入 |

浏览器版 DSH 用 `--profile web`；非默认 `DSH_HOME` 用 `--dsh-home <路径>`。
安装后**完全退出并重开 DSH 一次**（宿主半身在启动时注册路由）；之后改 CSS 再也不需要重启。

## 使用

打开 **设置 → 自定义样式**。

| 调节：宽视野 (1500px) | 调节：紧凑 (1000px) |
|---|---|
| ![宽视野预设](docs/images/宽视野.png) | ![紧凑预设](docs/images/紧凑.png) |

| 调节：默认尺寸 (800px) | 背景：设置全屏壁纸与遮罩 |
|---|---|
| ![默认尺寸](docs/images/默认.png) | ![换背景图](docs/images/换背景图.png) |

面板分为「调节」、「背景」与「选择器与目录」三页：

| 顶部 tab | 能做什么 |
|---|---|
| **调节** | 八个数字 + 六组预设（宽视野 / 紧凑 / 纵向扩展 / 小巧 / 最大化 / 恢复默认）。预设按钮在输入项**上方**，先套用再微调；点「应用」写入 `20-quick-settings.css` |
| **背景** | 图片地址（填网址，或点「选择图片」从本机挑）/ 遮罩浓度 / 背景模糊 / 平铺方式；带缩略图预览与「清除背景图」 |
| **选择器与目录** | 显示当前 CSS 样式文件存放路径与「打开目录」按钮；提供从 deepseek-harness 源码核对过的稳定选择器举例与一键「复制」代码片段 |

三个 tab 各一页，一次只显示一页。较长的解释收在「说明」折叠里，默认收起。

习惯直接改文件也行：编辑 `%DSH_HOME%\dsh-custom-style\`
（默认 `C:\Users\<你>\.dsh\dsh-custom-style\`）下的任意 `*.css`——面板和文件夹改的是同一批文件：

```css
/* 01-my-tweaks.css —— 保存后约 2 秒生效 */
[data-shortcut-modal="settings"] { width: 1200px !important; }    /* 设置弹窗宽度（默认 800px） */
[data-shortcut-modal="settings"] nav { width: 220px !important; } /* 左侧导航宽度（默认 188px） */
body { --dsh-content-font-size: 15px !important; }                /* 会话正文字号 */
```

- 文件名决定拼接顺序（`00-` 在前、`99-` 在后），同特异性下后者胜出。
- 只有在与官方规则**特异性相同**时才需要 `!important`（弹窗宽度就是这种情况）。
- 新建、改名、删除文件都会在下一轮询（≤2 秒）自动反映。
- 想把样式放在别处：设 `DSH_CUSTOM_STYLE_DIR` 为绝对路径，宿主半身会改读那个目录。

## 稳定选择器

官方类名是构建期哈希（今天是 `.wCInkW_panel`，升级后就变），所以优先用能活下来的钩子。
下面这张表可以直接抄进你的 CSS。

| 目标 | 稳定选择器 | 示例 |
|---|---|---|
| 设置弹窗（尺寸、圆角、背景） | `[data-shortcut-modal="settings"]` | `width: 1200px !important;` |
| 它的左侧导航 | `[data-shortcut-modal="settings"] nav` | `width: 220px !important;` |
| 导航里的单个条目 | `[data-shortcut-modal="settings"] nav button` | `height: 44px !important;` |
| 当前所在的那一条导航 | `[data-shortcut-modal="settings"] nav button[aria-current]` | `background: … !important;` |
| 右侧内容列 / 滚动区 | `[data-shortcut-modal="settings"] > div:last-child` | `padding-inline-start: 4px !important;` |
| 任意模态（兜底） | `div[role="dialog"][aria-modal="true"]` | `border-radius: 14px !important;` |
| 设置页的错误提示 | `[role="alert"]` | `font-size: 12px !important;` |
| 正文字号 | `body` 上的 `--dsh-content-font-size` | `15px !important;` |
| 低一档字号（表格、摘要） | `body` 上的 `--dsh-content-font-size-secondary` | `13px !important;` |
| 颜色、圆角、描边、阴影、焦点环 | `body` 上的 `--dsw-*` 令牌 | `--dsw-radius-panel: 14px !important;` |
| 深色模式画布 | `body[data-ds-dark-theme]` | `background: #0f1114 !important;` |
| 指针输入（焦点环被置透明） | `html[data-input-modality="pointer"]` | 恢复焦点环颜色 |
| macOS 桌面端 | `html[data-platform="darwin"]` | `border-radius: 12px !important;` |
| 滚动条（官方令牌） | `body` 上的 `--dsh-scrollbar-width` 等 | `10px !important;` |
| 滚动条（WebKit 伪元素） | `::-webkit-scrollbar` | `width: 10px;` |
| 代码块与行内代码 | `pre, code, kbd, samp` | `font-size: 12.5px !important;` |
| 内置插件页标签栏 | `[role="tablist"]` / `[role="tab"][data-active]` | `gap: 18px !important;` |
| 设置页输入框 / 校验失败 | `… input` / `… input[aria-invalid]` | `border-radius: 8px !important;` |
| 插件市场里展开的卡片 | `[data-open="true"]` | `border-color: … !important;` |
| 侧栏会话行 / 工作区分组 | `[data-row-key^="session:"]` / `^="workspace:"` | `border-radius: 8px !important;` |
| 侧栏账户浮层菜单 | `[role="menu"]` / `[role="menuitem"]` | `border-radius: 12px !important;` |
| 本插件注入的样式表 | `style[data-plugin-css="dsh-custom-style"]` | 在 DevTools 里定位自己的规则 |

完整清单（每条都标了它在出厂 bundle 里的核对出处）见 [selectors.json](selectors.json)。

要找别的元素：DevTools 里选中它 → *Copy selector*，优先挑由 `data-*`、`aria-*`、`role` 组成的写法，
而不是由哈希类名组成的。

> **两条已核实不再成立的选择器**：旧版文档写过的 `[data-shortcut-modal="dialog"]` 与
> `[data-shortcut-modal="shortcut-edit"]`，在 `0.2.0-rc.2` 的出厂 bundle 里**都不存在**——
> 整棵树上 `data-shortcut-modal` 只有 `"settings"` 这一个值。要命中别的模态浮层，
> 请用 `div[role="dialog"][aria-modal="true"]`。

弹窗自带 `max-width: calc(100vw - 48px)`，所以设得再宽也不会溢出窄窗口。反过来说：窗口比
*你的设定值 + 48px* 更窄时，弹窗其实已经顶到上限——要么把 DSH 窗口拉大，要么自己缩小这条留白
（面板里的「弹窗两侧留白」就是干这个的）：

```css
[data-shortcut-modal="settings"] { max-width: calc(100vw - 16px) !important; }
```

### 为什么有些页面右侧还是留白

弹窗宽度只是一半原因。外壳的内容列本身不限宽，但**各个页面会限制自己内容的宽度**，
留白正是这个上限造成的。来自出厂 bundle 的实测：

| 页面 | 被限宽的元素 | 上限 | 出处 |
|---|---|---|---|
| 内置插件 | `.amjGKq_section` | 760px | `ui-settings-plugins/lib/client.js:11` |
| 插件市场 tab | `.RotMhW_section` | 760px | `ui-settings-plugin-inventory/lib/client.js:57` |
| 模型 | `._3nPmjq_section` | 720px | `ui-settings-models/lib/client.js:58` |
| 通用设置 | `.zZnCHW_section` | **不限宽** | `ui-settings-general/lib/client.js:618` |
| Agent 循环 / Shell | 无自带样式 | **不限宽** | 这两个包没有 CSS |

（第三方插件另算：它们常用 `_root` / `_shell` / `_wrap` 之类的容器名把自己卡窄，
所以清单里一并按后缀命中。）

两个事实决定了修法。第一，外壳结构（来自出厂的 `ui-settings-general` 源码）：

```
div[data-shortcut-modal="settings"]          role=dialog, aria-modal=true
├─ nav                                      188px
│  ├─ div（标题行，「设置」两个字）
│  └─ div（列表）
│     └─ button*（每个分区一条，选中的带 aria-current）
└─ div（内容列）
   ├─ div（顶部动作行：打开配置文件 + 关闭）
   └─ div（滚动区）
      └─ …                                  slot 渲染层，然后才是页面自己的容器
```
（结构出自 `ui-settings-general/lib/client.js:280-342`。）

滚动区是普通块级盒子，所以给被限宽的容器加 `margin-inline: auto` 就能把剩余空间均分——
内容居中而不是贴左——而且对没有限宽的元素这是空操作。第二，被限宽的元素**不是**滚动区的
直接子节点（中间隔着 slot 层），而且它的类名是构建期哈希，所以要按稳定的**后缀**匹配：官方页是
`_section`，第三方页常见 `_root` / `_shell` / `_wrap`。面板里的「内容居中宽度」写的就是这个：
`0` 表示保留各页自己的宽度、只做居中；填数字表示把它们统一成该宽度并居中。

```css
[data-shortcut-modal="settings"] [class*="_options"] > *,
[data-shortcut-modal="settings"] [class*="_section"],
[data-shortcut-modal="settings"] [class*="_root"],
[data-shortcut-modal="settings"] [class*="_shell"],
[data-shortcut-modal="settings"] [class*="_wrap"],
[data-shortcut-modal="settings"] [style*="max-width"] { margin-inline: auto !important; }
```

如果你希望内容**铺满**而不是居中，对同一组选择器再加 `max-width: none`。
它会把按窄列设计的页面拉伸（卡片网格摊开、文字行长变大），所以不作为默认。

## 工作原理

```
$DSH_HOME/dsh-custom-style/*.css
        │  按文件名顺序拼接，每个文件前加一条 "/* ===== 名字 ===== */" 横幅
        ▼
index.js（宿主半身）──GET /dsh-custom-style/all.css──▶  client.js（浏览器半身）
        │                                                    │
        └─ 自动创建目录、播种 00-starter.css                   └─ <style data-plugin-css="dsh-custom-style">，每 2 秒轮询
```

- 路由面：`GET /dsh-custom-style/all.css`（拼接后的 CSS，`Cache-Control: no-store`）、
  `GET /dsh-custom-style/status` 与 `/files`（JSON：目录、文件列表、字节数）、
  `POST /dsh-custom-style/file` 与 `/file/delete`（写入/删除一个 `*.css`）、
  `POST /dsh-custom-style/reveal`（打开目录）；支持 `HEAD`，其余返回 `404`/`405`/`413`。
- 只读写那个目录**直接**内部的 `*.css`；文件名必须匹配 `[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._-]{0,63}\.css`——
  不接受调用方传入的路径，因此没有路径穿越面。写入是原子的（临时文件 + rename），单文件上限 256 KiB。

plugins.description: A daily Token-usage heatmap for the DSH settings page, including an estimated daily cost in CNY from DeepSeek list prices. Aggregated entirely from local session logs; no external requests. ｜ DSH 设置中的每日 Token 用量热力图，含人民币估算消费金额；数据取自本机会话日志，不发起外部请求。
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-token-heatmap

[中文](README.zh.md) | English

A **daily token-usage heatmap** that adds a "Token usage" section to the DSH settings page. One cell per day; theme-aware greyscale indicates relative usage.

Selecting a day also shows an **estimated cost in CNY**, derived from DeepSeek's published list prices and their peak/off-peak schedule.

All data is derived from DSH's own local session logs. **No external network requests and no separate usage ledger.**

> **Privacy**: this plugin makes no outbound requests. Session logs are read on the local machine only, and the aggregated result is served to your local DSH page. The repository contains no personal data or credentials.

## Design highlights

- **A native settings section, not an overlay.** The component registers into the `settings.section` slot and renders React elements only. It does not append to `document.body`, does not replace the application root, and imports no Harness client package. It therefore occupies the settings sidebar alongside the built-in sections rather than floating above the application. See [Implementation notes](#implementation-notes).
- **Local data only, single source of truth.** No data leaves the machine and no additional ledger is required: every figure is derived from the session logs DSH already writes.
- **The session log format is parsed explicitly.** Concatenated zstd frames, replayed `seq` values and truncated tail frames are each handled as distinct cases. A single-pass decompression retains only the first frame of a multi-frame log and therefore under-reports usage. See [Data source](#data-source).
- **Colour levels remain readable at both ends of the scale.** The four metrics differ by orders of magnitude, so levels are derived from **quantiles of the local data set** (25th/50th/75th percentiles) rather than fixed thresholds. Cache reads frequently account for the majority of a day — 99% in the screenshots below — which is why `Input+output` is provided as a separate metric.
- **Brightness is reserved for days with recorded usage.** Days without usage occupy the lowest visual level, so an otherwise empty grid remains visually neutral and days with usage are distinguishable at a glance. This carries an accessibility benefit as well: the encoding never relies on colour hue.
- **Cost is estimated rather than billed.** DSH session logs record token counts but no currency amounts, so the detail panel applies DeepSeek's published CNY prices to the day's input, cache-read and output tokens. The peak/off-peak schedule is accounted for per record using the record's own timestamp, and the panel states that the figure is an estimate. See [Cost estimate](#cost-estimate).
- **Selection and expansion are separate states.** Collapsing a day's details retains its selection outline on the heatmap; selecting another day switches the details directly; `Esc` collapses first and clears the selection second. Reading a sequence of days therefore requires no intermediate close step.
- **Host integration for theme and language.** Colours are drawn from host theme tokens (`--dsw-alias-*`), and all visible text is registered through `ctx.locale.register`, so an application language change re-renders the section. Number units are localized as well (`万`/`亿` in Chinese, `K`/`M`/`B` in English).
- **Regression tests rather than claims.** Five self-test entry points cover frame parsing, deduplication, caching, weekly boundaries, client rendering and route registration. See [Layout](#layout).

## Screenshots

> **Note on screenshot currency.** The images below predate **v0.5.0** and have not been re-captured since. Three UI changes made since are therefore not visible in them:
>
> 1. **Empty-day cells render darker.** Days without recorded usage now occupy the dimmest level, reserving the brightness range for days with usage (v0.4.1).
> 2. **Collapsing a day retains its selection.** Selecting the same date again collapses only the detail body; the selection outline remains on the heatmap and the collapsed row carries an expand control (v0.4.1).
> 3. **The detail panel shows an estimated cost.** A daily cost in CNY is displayed next to the daily total (v0.5.0).
>
> The textual descriptions throughout this document reflect the current behaviour.

### Half-year heatmap and compact tooltip

Open Settings → **Token usage**. The default range is six months. Choose total, input+output, cache read or output, and switch between daily and weekly views. The range selector offers six months or a full year; the year is split into two rows.

Hover a date cell to display three lines: the date (YYYY-MM-DD), the selected metric's Token count, and “Click to view details”. The example below shows 2026-10-13 with a total of 117,405,946 Token. Selecting the cell displays that day's breakdown below the heatmap. The outline indicates hover or selection; today's cell has no default highlight. Cells with no recorded usage remain at the dimmest level, so the brightness range is reserved for days with usage.

![English half-year heatmap and tooltip](docs/heatmap-en.png)

### Inline daily details and Token composition

Selecting a date displays its details inline below the heatmap, without navigating away from the page. A single-line hint above the footnote indicates the interaction until a date is selected. Selecting the same date again collapses the detail body while retaining the selection outline on the heatmap, so the selected date remains identifiable; the collapsed row provides an expand control. Selecting a different date switches the details directly, with no intermediate collapse step. For keyboard users, `Esc` on a focused cell collapses the details, and a second press clears the selection. All filters remain available throughout.

Details include the total, input, output, cache reads and calls, plus cache writes when present, and an estimated daily cost in CNY. The grayscale bar shows each component's share by Token count. The October 13, 2026 example shows 117,405,946 Token, with cache reads accounting for 99.09%. These are screenshot examples; your statistics come from your local logs.

![English daily details and Token composition](docs/detail-en.png)

### Chinese interface

Labels, months, dates and number units follow the host language. The same daily total appears as “1.17 亿” in Chinese and “117.41M” in English.

![Chinese half-year heatmap and tooltip](docs/heatmap-zh.png)

![Chinese daily details and Token composition](docs/detail-zh.png)

## Features

- Default half-year range (26 weeks); full year uses two rows (27 + 26 weeks), each with month labels
- Cells capped at 20px with 4px gaps, sized to the container to avoid horizontal scrollbars
- **Daily / Weekly** views: daily levels or one shared level per natural week; Sunday–Saturday, future dates empty
- **Four metrics**: total / input+output / cache read / output, rendered in theme-aware grayscale
- Hover or focus shows the cell's date, the selected metric's Token count and a click hint; weekly counts are labeled
- Click a date for inline daily details below the heatmap: total, input, output, cache reads, calls, nonzero cache writes, and an estimated cost in CNY; weekly cells open their actual day
- Selecting the selected date again collapses the detail body while retaining its selection outline; an expand control and `Esc` both collapse, and selecting another date switches without an intermediate collapse
- **Cost estimate** based on DeepSeek's published CNY prices, including the peak/off-peak schedule applied per record timestamp; unknown models fall back to the Flash table and are labelled as such. The English interface writes `CNY ¥4.98` so the currency is explicit.
- Proportional Token composition bar with percentages and an empty state
- Approximately 600ms diagonal entrance without delaying the summary; filters and date selection do not replay it
- Native buttons support Enter/Space and focus feedback; respects system reduced-motion preferences
- Today / this week / all-time summary; minute refresh plus refresh on visibility or focus
- Chinese/English labels, month names and number units; follows the host light/dark th

plugins.description: Resource lease governance: auto-registers browser tabs, background jobs, processes and ports as session-owned leases with TTL auto-reclaim, pinning and manual sweep.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-resource-lease — 资源租约治理插件

解决「agent 打开浏览器 tab / 后台 job / 临时进程后忘记关」的问题。**不依赖模型自觉**：资源打开即自动登记租约（归属会话 + TTL），回收由机制执行。

## 三层防线

1. **自动登记**（tools/result 观察钩子，零提示词依赖）
   - browser_tab_new → browser-tab 租约（tabId + 归属会话 + TTL，默认 240min）
   - bash/subagent/workflow 带 run_in_background → job 租约（jobId，默认 360min）
   - 其他资源（run_code 里起的服务器等）→ lease_register 工具手动登记
2. **自动回收**（三个触发点互为冗余）
   - session/disposed → 关闭该会话全部 session 级租约（正常路径）
   - daemon 每 60s 扫 TTL 过期租约（会话挂死兜底）
   - 启动 10s 后扫过期账（宿主重启兜底；注册表持久化于 ~/.dsh/resource-lease/leases.json）
   - 浏览器空闲 10min 且**实查 0 残留 tab** 才 browser_close（共享实例安全闸：有未登记 tab 绝不误关）
3. **分类策略**
   - session（默认）：随会话/TTL 自动回收
   - pinned：用户说「这个留着」→ lease_pin 升级，永不自动回收
   - system：白名单（cron/watchdog 服务、外部 Chrome 本来就不登记，天然豁免）

## 工具面（agent）

| 工具 | 用途 |
|------|------|
| lease_list | 列租约（默认当前会话活跃；all=true 全部） |
| lease_register | 手动登记（kind=process/port/custom；process/port 需 pid） |
| lease_pin | pinned 升级/降级 |
| lease_release | 立即关闭（force=true 连 pinned 也关） |
| lease_sweep | 立即扫一轮（给 sessionId 则清该会话） |

## 面板（conversation.view slot「资源租约」）

活跃租约表 + 单个关闭/固定 + 清扫过期，10s 自动刷新。宿主 API：/resource-lease/api/{leases,release,pin,sweep}。

## 回收执行路径（实测）

- browser tab → ctx.tools.execute('browser_tab_close')（无 agent 上下文可用，PTC 不拦）
- job → ctx.jobs.kill(jobId, sessionId, reason) 直连服务（job_kill 工具是 agent 作用域注册，全局视图不可见——v1 实测踩坑）
- process/port → process.kill(pid, SIGTERM)
- 「资源已不存在」（not found/ESRCH/already-finished）视为关闭成功；'unknown tool' 不算——连续失败 3 次标 failed 停止重试，面板可见待人工处理

## 构建（离线，无需 npm install）

- host：bash scripts/build.sh（DSH_CHECKOUT 自动探测 ~/dsh-harness）
- client：bash scripts/build-client.sh（tsc CJS + 手工 __ModuleLoader__ 包装，替代 tsdown）
- 一键：dev_build_plugin → dev_inject_plugin / dev_reload_package 热重载

## 配置（cordis.patch.yml 可覆盖）

sweepIntervalMs(60s) tabTtlMinutes(240) jobTtlMinutes(360) autoCloseBrowser(true) browserIdleCloseMs(10min) keepClosedHours(72)

plugins.description: Named database connections for DeepSeek Harness - configure MySQL in a settings page, then refer to them by name in chat. Read-only by default, writes opt-in per connection.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-db-connections

English | [中文](README.zh.md)

**Named database connections** for DeepSeek Harness. Configure your databases in a settings page, then refer to them by name in chat — say "use 128" and the model knows which database to reach and how.

## The problem it solves

Asking an AI to query a database normally means restating host, port, user, and password every time. This plugin stores those in configuration and leaves one short name (`128`) for you and the model to use:

- The connection names are contributed to the system prompt, so "use 128" resolves without you repeating an address or a credential.
- All three tools take `connection` as their first argument, so the model only carries names.
- **No password ever reaches the prompt** — only host, port, default schema, and whether the connection is writable.

## Install

Plugin directory: `<path-to>/dsh-db-connections`

Install dependencies first (`mysql2` and `yaml`):

```sh
cd <path-to>/dsh-db-connections
npm install
```

Then install into a profile with the DSH plugin command. The Electron desktop app owns its `desktop` profile exclusively, so use the CLI the app ships:

```sh
# Default Windows desktop path; substitute your own if installed elsewhere.
"C:\Program Files\deepseek\resources\runtime\cli\bin\dsh.cmd" ^
  plugin --profile desktop add "<path-to>/dsh-db-connections"
```

`dsh plugin add` records the package in the profile's `dsh.profile.bundles`, and the package's own `cordis.patch.yml` inserts the `id: db-connections` row with `connections: []` (connect to nothing by default).

Any other profile (`web`, `tui`, your own) uses the ordinary CLI:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <name> add /absolute/path/to/dsh-db-connections
```

> **Restart the desktop app once after installing**, so the settings page appears: the client-plugin roster is scanned at startup, not re-scanned while running.
>
> Conversely, **the plugin directory must not be deleted, renamed, or moved**: the profile references it through a `link:`, and a missing directory produces `cannot resolve profile bundle "dsh-db-connections"`.

## Configure a database

Two routes, one configuration — use whichever you prefer.

### Route 1: click through the app (recommended)

Open **Settings → Databases** to add, edit, and delete connections, pick **read-only** or **read-write** per connection from a dropdown, and press **Test** to verify a connection on the spot. Saving applies immediately — no restart, and no need to touch the configuration file.

The page follows the shell's own language setting (Chinese/English): dictionaries are contributed with `ctx.locale.register()` and lookups go through `ctx.locale.bind()`, rather than guessing from the browser, so the page follows a language switch.

Passwords are shown and edited as plain text: the value lives in a file you own, and hiding it only makes a wrong password impossible to spot.

### Route 2: edit the configuration file

**Redefine** the `db-connections` row in the profile's `cordis.patch.yml`. The loader replaces a row's whole `config` rather than deep-merging it, so restate every key:

```yaml
- id: db-connections
  name: "dsh-db-connections"
  config:
    connections:
      - name: "128"              # the name you and the model use in chat
        host: 192.0.2.10
        port: 3306               # optional, default 3306
        user: root
        password: "change-me"       # or use passwordEnv, below
        database: appdb     # optional default schema
        description: dev database # optional; shown in the prompt
        allowWrite: false        # optional, default false = read-only
```

Where the profile's `cordis.patch.yml` lives:

| Platform | Path |
| --- | --- |
| Windows | `C:\Users\<you>\.dsh\profiles\desktop\cordis.patch.yml` |
| macOS / Linux | `~/.dsh/profiles/desktop/cordis.patch.yml` |

Press **Reload** on the settings page, or restart the app, to apply a hand edit. A change made through the settings page needs neither.

### Several connections

`connections` is a list, in order; names must be unique:

```yaml
- id: db-connections
  name: "dsh-db-connections"
  config:
    connections:
      - name: "128"
        host: 192.0.2.10
        user: root
        password: "change-me"
        database: appdb
        description: dev database
      - name: "prod"
        host: 192.0.2.9
        user: readonly_user
        passwordEnv: PROD_DB_PASSWORD   # keeps the secret out of the file
        database: app_prod
        description: production (read-only account)
      - name: "local"
        host: 127.0.0.1
        user: root
        password: ""
        description: local MySQL
```

### Keep the password out of the file

Name an environment variable with `passwordEnv`; it is resolved at load, and a missing variable fails loudly rather than becoming an empty password:

```yaml
        passwordEnv: PROD_DB_PASSWORD
```

When both are present, `passwordEnv` wins. **A settings-page save does not destroy this**: the page edits raw configuration, so a resolved password is never written back to the file. Note the other direction: the settings page has no `passwordEnv` field of its own — creating the indirection is a hand edit of the configuration file.

### Write access

**Set per connection, read-only by default.** The settings page's dropdown ("Read-only" / "Read-write") is exactly the `allowWrite` flag in the configuration file.

Read-only has two independent layers, neither of which is keyword matching in the plugin:

1. With `allowWrite: false` (the default), `db_execute` refuses outright.
2. Even on a writable connection, every `db_query` statement runs inside a server-enforced `START TRANSACTION READ ONLY` — **MySQL rejects the write** — so bypass-shaped statements such as `SELECT ... INTO OUTFILE`, `SELECT ... FOR UPDATE`, and `WITH ... UPDATE` are refused by the server too.

Before enabling writes, confirm the database should accept changes from the agent. A read-only account is the better choice for most deployments than turning on `allowWrite`.

## The three tools

| Tool | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| `db_query` | Read-only queries, in a server-enforced read-only transaction. Returns columns plus rows. |
| `db_execute` | Writes (INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE/DDL). Available only with `allowWrite: true`. |
| `db_schema` | Inspect structure: omit `database` to list schemas; pass `database` to list tables; add `table` for columns, indexes, and DDL. |

You do not call these yourself. Typical requests:

- "list the schemas on 128" → `db_schema`
- "what does sys_user look like in 128?" → `db_schema`
- "show me the first 10 users in 128" → `db_query`
- "change the remark on id=1 in 128" → `db_execute` (needs a writable connection)

## Per-connection options

| Key | Default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `name` | required | Connection name, unique, ≤64 characters |
| `host` | required | Hostname or IP |
| `user` | required | Account name |
| `password` | `''` | Password, stored as plain text in the configuration file |
| `passwordEnv` | — | Environment variable holding the password; wins over `password` |
| `port` | `3306` | TCP port |
| `driver` | `mysql` | Only `mysql` is supported |
| `database` | — | Default schema; without it, qualify SQL as `schema.table` |
| `description` | — | Shown in the prompt, for context |
| `allowWrite` | `false` | Whether this connection accepts writes; the settings page's read-only / read-write dropdown |
| `ssl` | `false` | Connect over TLS |
| `connectTimeoutMs` | `10000` | Connection timeout |
| `queryTimeoutMs` | `30000` | Per-statement timeout (client and server `MAX_EXECUTION_TIME`) |
| `maxRows` | `200` | Rows returned per call; an excess is reported, never silently dropped |
| `maxCellChars` | `500` | Characters kept per cell |
| `maxDdlChars` | `20000` | Bound for the table DDL `db_schema` returns, kept separate so a CREATE TABLE is not cut off |
| `connectionLimit` | `4` | Pool size |

A bad configuration fails **at plugin load** naming the offending key, rather than when the model first calls a tool.

## Security notes

- Passwords never appear in the prompt or in tool results.
- Read-only comes from a server

plugins.description: Activity view for the DeepSeek Harness web sidebar: a bell swaps the sessions list for Needs attention, Working and Today.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-activity-view An activity view for the DeepSeek Harness web sidebar. A bell sits in the sessions header, between the view options and the add-project button. Click it to swap the session list for three groups: | Group | A session shows here when | |---|---| | **Needs attention** | it finished while you looked elsewhere (unread), or it waits for an approval, a plan review or an answer | | **Working** | it is running | | **Today** | its last activity was today (local calendar day) |

  

Left: the default sessions list. Right: the activity view, bell on.

Blank, subagent and archived sessions stay out. Unread rows get the green dot, waiting rows the orange one, working rows the native spinner. The bell itself shows a dot when anything needs attention, also while the view is off. The bell is the only switch. The choice is stored in the browser under the `dsh-activity-view.v2` localStorage key. ## Install ```sh dsh plugin --profile web add github:vec715/dsh-activity-view ``` Restart the server, then reload the page. Remove it with: ```sh dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-activity-view ``` For development, add your local checkout instead: ```sh git clone https://github.com/vec715/dsh-activity-view dsh plugin --profile web add ./dsh-activity-view ``` ## How it works The shipped session browser owns `sidebar.workspaces` as one `single` slot, header and list together. Replacing it would also replace search, view options and add-project. So the plugin does two small DOM moves instead: * the bell is appended to the shipped `headerActions` row and copies the class of the neighbouring icon button, so it looks and behaves like the others * the shipped `listArea` is hidden while the view is on, and a React root with the activity list mounts beside it Both anchors are CSS-module local names, which survive build hashes. A MutationObserver puts the nodes back when the shell re-renders. Row metrics are copied from the shipped session rows and use the same theme tokens. ## Develop No build step. `client/client.js` is a hand-written loader bundle that the host serves as a classic script. Edit it, then reload the page. Types come from JSDoc, checked by `tsc` against `types.d.ts` (the few host modules the plugin touches) and `@types/react`. Nothing is emitted. ```sh npm install npm run check # tsc type-check, then the client self-check in node ``` ## Known limits * Unread state is process-local in DSH. A reload, a second tab, or a session that finished while the page was closed carries no unread mark. * The DOM seam depends on the shipped `headerActions` and `listArea` class names. A DSH release that renames them will break the bell or the list. * Row sizes are copied by hand from the shipped CSS. Check them after a DSH release that restyles the session list. * English only.

plugins.description: DSH plugin: convert a request into MiL with Sarashina, review it, then hand it to the model dsh is running (TUI and Web UI)
plugins.readme_text:
# 1tempo

曖昧な依頼文を MiL へ変換し、承認してから dsh で選択中のモデルへ渡す dsh プラグイン。

```
/onetempo 3Dモデルを作って
  ↓ sarashina が MiL へ変換（mil-spec を system に渡す）
  ↓ 原文と MiL を表示し、承認（必要なら修正）
  ↓ 承認済みの MiL を、dsh で選択中のモデルへ渡す
```

- 確定設計: [architecture.md](architecture.md)
- dsh への要望（会話へ書く API）: [dsh-feature-request.md](dsh-feature-request.md)
- 企画の原案・質疑応答・実測レポート（`proposal.md` / `qa-record.md` / `preflight-report-*.md`）はローカル記録のため、この公開リポジトリには含めていない。本文中の `preflight-report-run*.md` はその記録のファイル名を示す。

## 何をするか

1. `/onetempo` が起動したときだけ動く。通常の依頼文には反応しない。
2. 依頼文を [Sarashina API](https://docs.sarashina.ai/) に送り、MiL へ変換する。
3. 原文と MiL を表示し、承認を求める。承認前に編集もできる。
4. 承認された MiL を、dsh の選択モデルへ **利用者のメッセージとして** 渡す（`source.kind: 'user'`）。dsh は `source.kind === 'user'` のメッセージだけを利用者の行として扱い、`/rewind` の戻り先にもする（それ以外はコンテキスト行になり、会話に出ない）。変換の来歴はプラグインの storage ログと通知に残す。
5. 原文・MiL・逆翻訳・変換モデル・呼び出し回数・承認有無を dsh の storage に記録する。storage が使えない場合は「ログ: 保存できませんでした（理由）」と出し、**保存したように見せない**（セッション内の記録だけを保持する）。

## 必要なもの

- dsh（`@deepseek-harness-tui/dsh-tui` が入ったプロファイル）
- Node.js 24 以降（テストと測定ツールで確認）
- `SARASHINA_API_KEY`（[Sarashina](https://sarashina.ai) で発行。無償ベータ、Google ログイン、事前申し込み不要）

キーの指定方法は以下のいずれか（優先順位順）:
1. `~/.dsh/.credentials.yaml`（dsh 標準の認証情報ファイル、推奨）
2. 環境変数 `SARASHINA_API_KEY`（`.env` を使う場合は `node --env-file=.env`）

```powershell
# 測定ツールの例（~/.dsh/.credentials.yaml にキーがあれば --env-file 不要）
node tools/preflight-decode.mjs --dry
```

## 使い方

```
/onetempo [mini|nano] [back] <依頼文>
```

| 引数 | 意味 |
| --- | --- |
| `mini` / `nano` | 変換モデルの上書き。`sarashina3-mini`（6 RPM） / `sarashina3-nano`（60 RPM、既定） |
| `back` | 逆翻訳（MiL を自然語へ戻したもの）も表示する。省略時は設定の既定 |
| `<依頼文>` | 変換対象。フラグの後に来た文字列をそのまま使う |

引数なしの `/onetempo` は使い方を表示する。

> **名前について**: プロジェクト名は 1tempo だが、コマンドと識別子は `onetempo`。dsh のコマンド名とプラグイン所有の設定名前空間は `/^[a-z][a-z0-9_-]*$/`（英小文字で始まる）に一致する必要があり、当初案の `1tempo` は数字始まりのため拒否される（実測: `command name "1tempo" must match ...` / `invalid TUI settings-section namespace: 1tempo`）。表示名（`1tempo`、設定セクションの見出し、`source.plugin`）は `1tempo` のまま。

### 表示と承認

- 変換結果は **通知欄** に出る。**200 セル以内に収まる形に整形する**（`1tempo: 送信しました…` / `MiL: <送信する MiL>` / 逆翻訳・ログ行）。
  - dsh はプラグインのコマンド結果を `channel.notify(cleanRenderText(text, COMMAND_RESULT_CELLS = 200))` で通知欄に描く。200 セルを超えた分は `…` で切られるため、先頭を MiL にし、続く注記は予算内の分だけ載せる（プラグイン側では切り詰めない）
  - 長い MiL の全文は承認ダイアログの初期値（490 セルまで）で読める
- **会話に出るのは送信メッセージの本文だけ**（`content`）。本文は **MiL のみ**。
  - `content` は「会話に表示されるテキスト」と「モデルが読むテキスト」を兼ねる。dsh に両者を分ける欄は無い（実測: `tools/inspect-session-log.mjs --grep` で `agent/inbox/spliced` に本文が入ることを確認）。そのため原文を会話に出すと、そのままモデルにも渡る
  - `includeOriginalInMessage: true` にすると本文が「依頼: <原文>」→「MiL: …」になる。会話の行が自分の言葉で始まり `/rewind` で識別しやすいが、**MiL の圧縮効果は失われる**。既定は `false`
  - **`source` は `{ kind: 'user' }` のみ**（`form` を付けない）。dsh は `isHuman = sourceKind === 'user'` の一点で利用者とプラグインを区別し（`dsh-adapter/trajectory/projection.js`）、`/rewind` も同じ条件で戻り先を選ぶ（`sessionTree.js`）。`plugin:1tempo` のままだと context 行になり会話に出ず、`form` を付けると行ごと消える（どちらも実機で確認）。**代償**: セッションログ上は「利用者が送った」記録になる。変換の来歴は storage ログと通知に残す（`qa-record.md` §6.22）
  - 会話へ任意の行を足す API は無い。プラグインのコマンド結果は通知に回り（200 セル上限）、`session.append` でログ専用イベントを足すこともできない（`ignorable` を付けられない）。「会話にだけ原文を出す」要望は `dsh-feature-request.md` の提案 6（入力欄へ本文を入れる API）にまとめた
- 承認は **編集ダイアログ 1 つだけ**。MiL がダイアログの初期値として表示されるので、その場で読んで確認できる。
  - そのまま Enter → 送信
  - 本文を編集して Enter → 修正した MiL を送信
  - Esc / Ctrl+C → 送信を取り消す（未編集の MiL を勝手に送らない）
  - `dialogTimeoutMs`（既定 3 分）を過ぎた場合も取り消す
- 確認ダイアログ（「この MiL を送信しますか」）は 2026-10-14 に廃止した。コマンドの出力はハンドラの終了後に出るため、その時点では MiL が画面に無く、見えないまま承認させることになっていた。
- MiL が 490 セルを超える場合は編集ダイアログを開かず、表示のみ行う。
- MiL が質問のみで内容を持たない場合は、その旨を注記に出す（依頼の要件が落ちていないかを確認するため）。
- 変換に失敗したときは、設定 `failureMode` に従う（既定は「原文をそのまま送るか確認」。自動送信はしない）。
- ダイアログ下部の操作ヒント（`Enter to confirm · Esc to cancel` など）は dsh のダイアログ部品が描くもので、プラグインからは消せない。消すにはダイアログを使わない方式（会話で完結する 2 段階）へ変える必要がある。

## インストール（dsh への登録）

このリポジトリは **dsh の bundle パッケージ**として作ってある（`package.json` の `dsh.bundle.patch` → `cordis.patch.yml`）。したがって、**展開も手作業の設定も不要**で、dsh のプラグイン管理から spec を指定するだけで入る。

### 1. Web UI の Plugins ページから（推奨）

サイドバーの **Plugins** ページで追加先に次を入れて Install する。

```
github:puyokura/dsh-1tempo
```

- dsh のプラグイン管理（`@deepseek-ai/dsh-plugin-manager`）が `pnpm add` でこのリポジトリをプロファイルへ入れ、**bundle を既定で有効化**し、同梱の `cordis.patch.yml` の行を適用する。手で `cordis.patch.yml` を編集する必要はない。
- プロファイルが HMR 有効（`patchReload: live`）ならその場で反映される。無効なら dsh を再起動する。
- 削除も同じページから行える（`pnpm remove` 相当）。

エージェント経由なら `plugin_manager` ツールの `install_bundle` に同じ spec を渡す（Creator 系プリセットで有効。実行には `danger-full-access` か承認が要る）。

### 2. プロファイルへ CLI で入れる（bundle 方式）

Web UI を使わない場合（サーバー上で動かす、ヘッドレスなど）は同じ操作を CLI で行う。

```sh
cd ~/.dsh/profiles/<プロファイル名>
pnpm add github:puyokura/dsh-1tempo
```

次に `package.json` の `dsh.profile.bundles` の末尾へ `"dsh-plugin-1tempo"` を足す。`pnpm add` だけでは bundle は有効にならず、この 1 行が Install ボタンの仕事にあたる。

```json
      "bundles": [
        "@deepseek-ai/dsh-base",
        "@deepseek-ai/dsh-web-app",
        "dsh-plugin-1tempo"
      ],
```

- 反映は `patchReload: live` なら即時、そうでなければ dsh を再起動する。
- 戻すときは `pnpm remove dsh-plugin-1tempo` と `bundles` からの削除。
- サーバー側の Web UI で使う場合、`SARASHINA_API_KEY` は**そのサーバー**の `~/.dsh/.credentials.yaml` に置く。プラグインはコマンド実行時にキーを読むため、置いた時点で有効になる（再起動は不要）。

### 3. プロファイルのパッチへ直接書く（手動・従来の方法）

プロファイルのパッチ（例: `~/.dsh/profiles/dsh-tui/cordis.patch.yml`）の `insert:` に 1 行追加する。

```yaml
    - id: onetempo
      name: <このリポジトリの絶対パス>/index.mjs
      config:
        model: sarashina3-nano
        specPreamble: off
```

- `name` は `index.mjs` の絶対パス。Windows ではスラッシュ区切りで書く（例: `C:/Users/you/1tempo-pulgin/index.mjs`）。
- `id` は設定画面が設定セクションを引く名前空間になる。`/^[a-z][a-z0-9_-]*$/` に一致する必要がある（`1tempo` は不可）。
- `config` は省略可能。省略時は下記の既定値が使われる。
- **bundle として入れたプロファイルに、この手動の行を足さない**（同じ `id: onetempo` が二重になる）。すでに手動の行があるプロファイルへ bundle を入れるときは、先に手動の行を消す。
- 読み込みに失敗すると dsh の起動がロールバックする。戻すときはこの 4 行を削除する。

### Web UI（プロファイル `web`）

同じ手順（上記 1 か 2）を web プロファイルへ行う。手動で入れる場合だけ、`insert:` 行を `~/.dsh/profiles/web/cordis.patch.yml` に置く。プラグインはどちらのホストでも動く（接点は実行時に選ばれる）。

| 用途 | TUI（`dsh-tui`） | Web UI |
| --- | --- | --- |
| コマンド登録 | `ctx.tuiPluginHost`（帰属つき）。無ければ `ctx.commands` | `ctx.commands`（コアが提供。結果テキストは会話のコマンドカードに出て、複数行は展開表示になる） |
| 確認・編集 | `ctx.tuiDialogs.input`（初期値つき） | `ctx.userQuestions.ask` の自由記述。初期値の欄が無いので、現在の MiL は `detail` に出る。**空のまま送ると、その MiL をそのまま使う** |
| 中止 | Esc / Ctrl+C / タイムアウト | 質問の取り消し、または `dialogTimeoutMs` での打ち切り |
| ログ | `ctx.tuiPluginStorage`（`~/.dsh-tui/plugin-storage/`、grant が必要） | `ctx.storageDomain`（`~/.dsh/storages/tempo_bridge.json`、grant 不要） |

- TUI 固有の 3 サービス（`tuiPluginHost` / `tuiDialogs` / `tuiPluginStorage`）は Web ホストに存在しない。`ctx.storageDomain` は逆に TUI ホストに mount されていない（実測 2026-10-15）。
- どちらの対話接点も無い構成では、MiL を表示するだけで**送信しない**（未確認の送信を避ける）。
- 引数つきで実行させるには **`input.hint` の宣言が要る**。Web の入力判定（`dsh-client-ui-commands` の `matchEnter`）は `input` を持つコマンドだけを引数つき行として実行し、無い場合はその行をそのままメッセージとして送る（実測 2026-10-17）。
- `ctx.userQuestions.ask()` には**解決済みの agent を渡す**。Web の回答器は live な Agent スコープの要求だけを受け、agent 無しでは `NO_PROVIDER` になってカードが出ない（実測 2026-10-17）。

## 設定

`config` または設定セクション（`/settings`）で変更する。未知の値は警告つきで既定に落ちる。

| キー | 既定 | 意味 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `model` | `sarashina3-nano` | 変換モデル（`sarashina3-mini` / `sarashina3-nano`） |
| `backtranslate` | `off` | `always` で逆翻訳も表示（追加で 1 回呼び出す） |
| `atSymbol` | `ext:` | 送信前に `@` を置換する ASCII 記号。`@` と空白と先頭 `#` は使えない |
| `failureMode` | `confirm` | `confirm`（原文送信を確認） / `abort`（常に中止） |
| `specPreamble` | `off` | `off`（MiL のみ送る） / `prepend`（定義行を前置。原典の運用と同じ） |
| `includeFrozenExample` | `true` | 形式の見本と依頼の見本を変換指示に同梱する |
| `stripSpecClauses` | `true` | 変換結果から、定義と逐語一致する節を除去する |
| `replyLanguageSectionEnabled` | `false` | system prompt に返答言語の指示を足す |
| `replyLanguageSection` | （日本語で返す旨の 1 文） | 上を有効にしたときの文面 |
| `convertInstruction` | （同梱の既定文） | 変換の指示文（見本はこの後ろに付く） |
| `backtranslateInstruction` | （同梱の既定文） | 逆翻訳の指示文 |
| `temperature` | `0` | 再現性のため 0 に固定 |
| `seed` | `20261014` | ベストエフォートの決定性 |
| `maxCompletionTokens` | `2000` | 1〜8000 |
| `retryWaitsMs` | `[10000, 20000, 40000]` | 429・一時サーバーエラー（5xx）・転送失敗の再試行間隔（最大 3 回） |
| `requestTimeoutMs` | `60000` | 1 呼び出しの上限 |
| `dialogTimeoutMs` | `180000` | 承認・編集ダイアログの上限。明示しないとホスト既定の 30 秒で勝手に取り消される |
| `minIntervalMs` | `null` | 連続呼び出しの最小間隔。`null` ならモデルの RPM から算出（nano 1000ms / mini 10000ms） |
| `includeOriginalInMessage` | `false` | `true` にすると送信本文の先頭

plugins.description: DSH (DeepSeek Harness) plugin: configured extra writable roots for the fs tools and the sandboxed shell — first-try writes with no approval, plus a Web settings page and structure-anchored path patterns.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-extra-paths

English | [中文](README.zh.md)

Let DSH **write to a set of configured external paths on the first try, with no approval**: this covers the `write`/`edit`
tools and `bash` subprocesses alike. The plugin works by wrapping services (it does not change DSH core) and ships a Web
settings page plus a preview of the effective roots for the current workspace.

## Install

Requires DSH `0.1.5` / `0.2.0` / `0.2.1` (outside that range the install gate refuses the package).

```bash
dsh plugin --profile <name> add dsh-extra-paths            # <name> = your profile
```

From a checkout instead of the registry:

```bash
pnpm install && pnpm build
dsh plugin --profile <name> add /path/to/dsh-extra-paths   # path = absolute path to this repo
```

Then open the **Extra paths** card under **Settings → Plugins**, or **Extra writable paths** in the settings sidebar.

## Configuration

Write it into the `extra-paths` section of the settings document `~/.dsh/settings.yaml`, or just use the settings page
(**saving takes effect immediately, no restart needed**). `<work root>` below is a placeholder for the directory that
holds your projects (an absolute path, or one starting with `~/`) — replace it with a path of your own:

```yaml
extra-paths:
  paths:
    - <work root>/notes/home                   # default scope/surfaces
    - path: ../../notes/home                   # relative paths resolve against the session workspace
      scope: always-write
    - path: <work root>/some-repo
      scope: write
      surfaces: [fs]                           # only the write/edit tools may write here
```

| scope | session `read-only` | session `workspace-write` |
|---|---|---|
| `write` (default) | denied | writable |
| `always-write` | writable | writable |

`surfaces`: `fs` = the `write`/`edit`/str-replace tools; `shell` = `bash` subprocesses. Reads and execution are not
sandboxed to begin with.

### How relative paths resolve

Relative paths resolve against **each session's own workspace** (the settings page has a "base workspace" field so you
can preview this):

| Spelling | Resolves to | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `..` | `<work root>` | the **parent** of the workspace; that directory and all of its siblings become writable |
| `../some-repo` | `<work root>/some-repo` | grants exactly one sibling repository (more precise than `..`, recommended) |
| `../../notes/home` | `<work root>/notes/home` | go up a few levels and into another tree |
| `~/notes/home` | under your home | independent of the workspace; `~user` is not expanded (same as the host) |

### Patterns: anchor a grant to directory structure (no hard-coded paths)

A `path` can use wildcards to describe **a group of directories**, turning "a certain directory exists somewhere in this
path" into a condition:

| Spelling | Matches (the granted root) |
|---|---|
| `<work root>/**/.worktrees/..` | every **repository root that contains `.worktrees`** (the parent of `.worktrees`) |
| `<work root>/**/.worktrees/*` | each individual worktree (`.git` and the main checkout are never touched) |
| `<work root>/<some-repo>/.worktrees/*` | every worktree of one repository (**zero traversal cost**, recommended) |
| `<work root>/*/notes` | the `notes` directory under every repository/project |

Syntax: `*` = exactly one level, `**` = at most 3 levels (**only directories that actually exist** match, so
"`.worktrees` must exist" comes for free); a trailing `..` moves up **after** matching (so `…/.worktrees/..` is "the
parent of `.worktrees`", rather than something lexical collapsing eats away).

Safety bounds (hard constraints, not advice):

- the wildcard needs a **literal anchor** before it, at least two segments long, absolute or starting with `~/` —
  `/**`, `~/**`, `/srv/**` are refused outright
- traversal **never enters** `node_modules` or `.git`, and `**` never enters hidden directories (`.worktrees` is a
  literal, so it still matches at its own level)
- bounded: `**` covers at most 3 levels, and more than 4096 directories or more than 256 matches makes **the whole
  pattern inert** (fail closed — never a partial, unpredictable grant); the reason is reported as a warning
- expansions are cached for 30 seconds, so a **newly created worktree is picked up within 30 seconds**

The settings page shows the **resolved absolute path** live for every row (symlinks follow the host's canonical
preview) and, for a pattern row, the match count as `[active ×N]` plus each concrete root below it; zero matches and
blocked patterns are both spelled out — so there is no need to "save first and then check whether it resolved".

## Known limits

- Per-path "no restrictions at all" is not achievable: the bash sandbox works at whole-invocation granularity.
- Relative paths resolve against the session workspace, so the same entry points at different directories in different
  workspaces — the settings page preview shows the actual resolution.
- The shell side is not widened on Windows; `always-write` weakens what the `read-only` stop button can do for that path.
- Files written outside the workspace do not appear in the `deliverables` workspace-changes card.

plugins.description: DSH plugin: keeps streamed answers free of red (broken) KaTeX regions - validates every maths region with the client's own renderer before it is written
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-math-tex

让 DSH 的数学回答始终可读：给模型一套排版规则，再在文本落盘之前拦截并修好每一个会被渲染成红字的公式区域。

这是一个 host 侧插件，**没有客户端部分**——渲染器改不了，所以修复发生在文本还属于我们的最后一刻。

---

## 它解决什么问题

DSH 的对话渲染用 KaTeX 渲染 Markdown 数学，只要遇到它解析不了的东西，就把**原始源码**用 KaTeX 的错误色 `#cc0000` 直接吐到屏幕上。**没有崩溃，也没有日志**：一个位置不对的 `$$` 足以让整篇推导变成"一片血红"，而用户只会看到一片红字，不知道哪一步错了、也不知道原因。

前端是 `app.asar` 里的一个整体 bundle，给 KaTeX 传的选项是空的（没有 `errorColor`、没有 `maxExpand`、没有 `trust`），所以**事后无法配置**。文本一旦落盘，屏幕上和会话记录里就都是坏的。

`dsh-math-tex` 因此在文本落盘之前动手。

## 两道防线

| | 机制 | 作用 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | `systemPrompt.section` | 事前规则：行间公式单独成段、`$$` 内只有公式、标题不粘公式……让模型少犯这个错。默认只注入给**已经出现过数学**的会话（`promptRules: auto`） |
| 2 | `llm/stream` waterfall | 兜底：用**客户端同版本**的 KaTeX 逐个区域判定，把会渲染成红色的区域改写掉，然后才落盘 |

第 2 道是关键：`llm/stream` 是每一次流式模型调用外面的 waterfall，改写过的 chunk 会同时进入持久化的消息体、实时前端帧和上下文压缩，所以**屏幕和记录一起修好**。

第 2 道认**两种定界符**：`$…$` / `$$…$$`，以及 LaTeX 原生的 `\(…\)` / `\[…\]`。后者不是可选项：2026-10-18 的一个会话里，模型两篇回答 11883 字、205 个反斜杠公式、**零个 `$`**，而界面照样把它们渲染成公式——只认一种定界符的守卫，等于只保护一半的回答。

## 判定不是正则，是问渲染器

直觉上的启发式（公式太长、嵌套太深、用了重型宏）经实测**两个方向都会错**：300 字符的公式、8 层 `\underbrace`、`\substack`、公式里的中文都渲染正常，而一个 99 字符的公式却死了。

更麻烦的是，"渲染器抛没抛异常"也不是判据：

| 输入 | 第 1 段调用（严格） | 第 2 段调用（宽松） | 读者看到 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `\foobar{x}` | 抛错 | 不抛错，把 `\foobar` 用 `#cc0000` 画出来 | 红字 |
| `x_1_2`（双下标） | 抛错 | 不抛错 | 红字 |
| `\htmlClass{red}{x}` | **成功** | — | **红字** |

第三行是最阴的一种：严格调用完全成功，输出里却带错误色。**只看异常的实现会把它判成健康。** 所以判定看的是**渲染产物里有没有错误色**。

## 修复原则：不猜数学

一个区域会被渲染成红色时，按顺序尝试：

1. **重新排版**——公式本身没问题、只是框架错了（例如 `$$` 开在段落中间），改成规范的 `$$\n…\n$$` 块；
2. **定点施救**——只在两种有确定语义的情况下动：删掉渲染器不认识的命令的反斜杠（`\foobar` → `foobar`），或给重复的算子重新分组（`x_1_2` → `x_{1_2}`）。改完必须**重新渲染验证"严格通过且无红色"**才接受，所以永远不会出现"改一下只是把错误挪了个位置"的循环；
3. **降级**——修不了的（括号不闭合、`\begin` 没有 `\end`）原样给出源码：块级区域包成代码围栏，行内区域只去掉定界符（围栏是多行结构，用在行内会把一条表格行切成三段）。

**数学永远不会被删掉。** 最坏情况是读者看到公式源码（可复制、可恢复），而不是红字。猜结构性损坏等于替作者编造数学，这件事不做。

## 安装

```bash
node tools/install.mjs              # 复制到 profile 并注册 bundle
node tools/install.mjs --dry-run    # 只说会改什么
node tools/install.mjs --uninstall  # 从 bundle 列表移除
```

装完**必须开新会话**：bundle 栈是会话的 runner 进程启动时读的，当前会话不会重新加载。

手工挂载也可以：把本包放进 `<profile>/node_modules/`，再把名字加进 profile `package.json` 的 `dsh.profile.bundles`。

## 配置

在 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml` 里按 id 设置：

```yaml
- id: dsh-math-tex
  name: dsh-math-tex
  config:
    repair: auto
    logFile: C:/tmp/math-tex.log
```

| 选项 | 默认 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `enabled` | `true` | `false` 时两道防线都不挂载 |
| `promptRules` | `auto` | `auto` 只给已经出现过数学的会话注入 / `full` 每个会话都注入完整九条 / `minimal` 只留防红字的两条 / `off` 不注入 |
| `repair` | `auto` | `auto` 改写 / `check-only` 只记日志不改写 / `off` 完全放行 |
| `tailBuffer` | `15` | 最少扣住多少个字符，避免完成记号被逐字泄漏 |
| `maxHold` | `600` | 单个未闭合区域最多等多少字符，超了就把该块原样放行、并从此不再修复这一块（宁可不管，不可卡住） |
| `logFile` | `''` | 诊断日志路径；留空则只走 host logger |
| `katexPath` | `''` | 指定 KaTeX 位置，默认自动按 profile 解析 |
| `macros` | `{}` | 传给渲染器的宏，与客户端行为保持一致 |

未知键**报错而不是静默忽略**——写错的选项看起来像生效了，比没有这个选项更糟。

## 日志能证明它真的在工作

```
oracle: katex 0.16.47
prompt section "math-output-format" registered (auto)
llm/stream hooked model=deepseek-flash mode=auto
prompt rules now apply to session session-8c6a99cc-…
guarded stream: 214 text delta(s) in, 231 out
```

最后一行是**真实回合**的判据：`in` 必须远大于 1（自测喂的假流是 1）。

## 测试

```bash
npm test
```

| 文件 | 测什么 | 断言 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `guard-test` | 判定与区域切分是否和渲染器一致；两种定界符（`$…$` 与 `\(…\)`）是否都认；修复不许破坏周围的 Markdown 结构；释放点不许落进未闭合的行内代码、也不许被前面的围栏骗过去；裸 HTML 是否被记一行日志（标签被切到多次释放时也要报） | 106 |
| `red-render-test` | 三类红字是否都能抓到；`$$` 块的围栏是否和内容分处不同行（宿主只在这一形状下闭合）；回显是否从正确的账本读 | 87 |
| `e2e-test` | 真实事故文本端到端是否可读 | 39 |
| `wire-test` | 流式输出是否等于整篇修复 | 107 |
| `fuzz-test` | 该性质在 236 种任意切分下是否成立 | 236 |
| `config-test` | 每个文档化选项是否真的有效 | 36 |
| `smoke-test` | 包是否按宿主的加载方式加载 | 23 |
| `installed-test` | profile 里那份**安装副本**（不是源码目录）能否加载并自修；与源码逐字节一致 | 12 |
| `regression-test` | 已修缺陷不再回归（用例逐字引自真实会话） | 23 |
| `live-path-test` | **验收**：装好的那份 + profile 的真实配置 + 宿主的挂载路径，坏答案是否真的变成干净文本 | 28 |

合计 10 个文件、697 条断言，约 4 秒，不需要网络。

最有说服力的是 `fuzz-test`：它要求**真实事故文本的任意切分**（1 字符一帧到 1600 字符一帧，外加随机切分）最终都重组为**逐字相同**的整篇修复结果。

`live-path-test` 是唯一一个把"装好的副本、profile 的配置、宿主的挂载路径、真实的增量流"接起来测的文件。它每个用例跑两遍：关掉修复时缺陷必须原样到达读者，开着时必须消失——前一遍是后一遍的前提，否则一个根本没坏的用例也会"通过"。

`regression-test` 是唯一断言"**输出来的文本**渲染后没有红色"的文件——其余文件盯的是判定与结构，它是最后一道"判定对了、但改完仍然红"的防线。把修复回退掉，它会红 4 条。

### 关于 `test/fixtures/real-broken.txt`

这份夹具复刻的是**事故文本的结构**（同一批缺陷形态：段落中间的 `$$` 配错对、`##` 粘在行间公式里、未闭合的 `\begin`、结尾的代码围栏），内容已替换为与具体题目无关的通用推导，因此它测的是缺陷形态而不是任何一次具体事故。

想直接看一份文本是怎么被判定的：

```bash
node tools/inspect-fixture.mjs                    # 默认检查上面这份夹具
node tools/inspect-fixture.mjs path/to/text.md    # 换成任何一份文本
```

它会打印区域数量、被标记的区域及其原因、修复动作，以及修复后是否还有区域会被渲染成红色。

排查真实会话时有这几件工具：

```bash
node tools/find-red-session.mjs                   # 扫本机所有会话，列出还会渲染成红色的回答
node tools/strip-sentinel.mjs --list              # 列出正文里还留着哨兵的记录
node tools/strip-sentinel.mjs --id <前缀> --yes   # 把那些哨兵清掉（逐帧改写，改完自验，失败自动回滚）
node tools/inspect-session.mjs <session.jsonl>    # 单条会话逐条消息：区域、判定、守卫会怎么修
node tools/probe-region.mjs 'd\alpha=0'           # 把候选写法逐个送进渲染器，看哪种被接受
```

**注意**：记录里存的是**修复前**的原文——守卫改的是往外发的流，不改落盘的模型文本。
所以"记录里还有坏公式"不代表屏幕上还有红字，判断要看同一次流的出口。

## 设计边界

- **渲染器不可改**：这是设计前提，不是让步。前端是打包好的 bundle，没有数学相关的 slot 可以替换。
- **只做 host 侧**：唯一能同时影响屏幕、会话记录和压缩的拦截点在 `llm/stream`。
- **宁可不管，不可卡住**：所有等待都有界（`maxHold`），超限即原样放行——那正是没有插件时的行为，因此安全。
- **不改写非数学文本**：不含 `$` 和 `\` 的文本逐字节直通。

## 文档

- `STATUS.md`——现在装了什么、证明了什么、还差什么（交接用）。
- `docs/`——判据的来源：`FINDINGS.md`（到底坏在哪）、`KATEX-MEASUREMENTS.md`（逐个用例的实测数字）、`DESIGN.md`（方案怎么定的、否掉了什么）。

## License

MIT

plugins.description: DSH 插件社区的讨论与反馈入口：插件展示 / 求助 / 想法与需求 / 已知问题。本仓库不含任何可执行代码（见 SECURITY.md）。 / Discussion and feedback hub for the DSH plugin community. Contains no executable code.
plugins.readme_text:
# DSH 插件社区

> DeepSeek Harness（DSH）插件的**社区**——讨论、求助、展示、找方案。
> 市场负责「有什么插件」，这里负责「这个插件怎么样、怎么用、出问题找谁」。

**本仓库不是一个插件市场。** 它不托管插件、不提供安装器，只提供一个**人和插件作者能对话的地方**。

---

## 这里能做什么

| 我想… | 去哪 |
|---|---|
| 看看别人做了什么插件 | [🧩 插件展示](https://github.com/moyuqing-man/dsh-plugin-community/discussions/categories/plugin-showcase) |
| 用某个插件卡住了 | [🙋 求助](https://github.com/moyuqing-man/dsh-plugin-community/discussions/categories/ask-for-help) |
| 想要一个还不存在的插件 | [💡 想法与需求](https://github.com/moyuqing-man/dsh-plugin-community/discussions/categories/ideas) |
| 汇报插件的 bug | **优先去插件自己的仓库开 Issue**；找不到仓库、Issue 关着、或提了没人管 → [本仓库 Issues](https://github.com/moyuqing-man/dsh-plugin-community/issues) |
| 查某个插件已知的问题 | [🐞 已知问题](https://github.com/moyuqing-man/dsh-plugin-community/discussions/categories/known-issues) |
| 随便聊聊 | [🗣️ 闲聊](https://github.com/moyuqing-man/dsh-plugin-community/discussions/categories/general) |

**为什么 bug 走 Issues 而不是 Discussions**：Issues 能关、能指派、能被作者订阅通知，是「待办」；Discussions 是「话题」，发完不一定要有人处理。**能用 Issue 追踪的事不要开讨论帖。**

---

## 怎么参与

**浏览不需要登录。** GitHub 的公开 Discussions 对所有人可见——直接看就行。

**发言需要一个 GitHub 账号。** 这是唯一的门槛，也是本项目的刻意选择：把身份、反滥用、通知全都交给 GitHub，社区自己不做账号体系。

- 第一次来 → 先读 [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md)
- 想推荐自己的插件 → 读 [投稿指南](CONTRIBUTING.md#我想推荐自己的插件)
- 想汇报安全问题 → 读 [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md)（**不要开公开 Issue**）

---

## 讨论分类

| 分类 | 用途 | 能标「答案」 |
|---|---|---|
| 📣 公告 | 索引更新、社区规则变更 | — |
| 🧩 插件展示 | 作者自荐，或推荐你用过的插件 | 否 |
| 🙋 求助 | 使用中遇到问题 | **是** |
| 💡 想法与需求 | 「我想要一个能做 X 的插件」 | 否 |
| 🐞 已知问题 | bug 的汇总与绕行方案 | 否 |
| 🗣️ 闲聊 | 兜底 | 否 |

> **求助帖能标答案**这件事很重要：一个被解决了的问题会留在搜索结果里，下一个人搜到就能直接用。**解决了就请回来把答案标上。**

---

## 行为准则

参与即表示同意 [CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md](CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md)。一句话版本：**对插件苛刻，对人客气。**

---

## 与市场的关系

DSH 的插件市场已经不止一个，而且都做得不错。**社区不是第 N+1 个市场**，也不会去重复它们的索引工作。

社区做的是市场做不了的事：

- **对话**——市场能告诉你插件存在，不能告诉你它在你这种情况下会不会崩
- **沉淀**——一个被回答过的问题，比一次性的 star 数有用得多
- **作者与用户的直接接触**——插件作者能在这里看到真实反馈

如果你在维护一个市场或索引目录，欢迎来[闲聊区](https://github.com/moyuqing-man/dsh-plugin-community/discussions/categories/general)打个招呼——**我们更愿意合作而不是竞争**。

---

## English summary

**DSH Plugin Community** — a place for discussing DeepSeek Harness (DSH) plugins: showcasing them, getting help, asking for new ones, and recording known issues.

**This repository is not a plugin marketplace.** It hosts no plugins and ships no installer. It exists so that people and plugin authors have somewhere to talk.

### Where to go

| I want to… | Go to |
|---|---|
| See what plugins other people built | [🧩 Plugin showcase](https://github.com/moyuqing-man/dsh-plugin-community/discussions/categories/plugin-showcase) |
| Get unstuck on a plugin | [🙋 Ask for help](https://github.com/moyuqing-man/dsh-plugin-community/discussions/categories/ask-for-help) |
| Ask for a plugin that does not exist yet | [💡 Ideas & requests](https://github.com/moyuqing-man/dsh-plugin-community/discussions/categories/ideas) |
| Report a plugin bug | **Open an issue in the plugin's own repository first.** No repo, issues closed, or nobody responding → [this repository's Issues](https://github.com/moyuqing-man/dsh-plugin-community/issues) |
| Look up a known problem | [🐞 Known issues](https://github.com/moyuqing-man/dsh-plugin-community/discussions/categories/known-issues) |
| Just chat | [🗣️ General](https://github.com/moyuqing-man/dsh-plugin-community/discussions/categories/general) |

**Why bugs go to Issues and not Discussions**: issues can be closed, assigned, and subscribed to by the author — they are a to-do list. Discussions are topics; nobody is obliged to act on one. **Anything you want tracked should be an issue, not a discussion thread.**

### Taking part

**Browsing needs no account.** Public GitHub Discussions are visible to everyone — just read.

**Posting needs a GitHub account.** That is the only barrier, and it is deliberate: identity, abuse prevention, and notifications are all delegated to GitHub. The community runs no account system of its own.

- First time here → read [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md)
- Want to submit your own plugin → read the [submission guide](CONTRIBUTING.md#我想推荐自己的插件)
- Reporting a security problem → read [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md) (**never open a public issue for it**)

### Discussion categories

| Category | Purpose | Can accept an "answer" |
|---|---|---|
| 📣 Announcements | Index updates, rule changes | — |
| 🧩 Plugin showcase | Authors self-promoting, or recommending a plugin you use | no |
| 🙋 Ask for help | Trouble using something | **yes** |
| 💡 Ideas & requests | "I wish a plugin could do X" | no |
| 🐞 Known issues | Bug round-ups and workarounds | no |
| 🗣️ General | Everything else | no |

> **That help threads can accept an answer matters**: a solved question stays in search results, and the next person finds it immediately. **Once yours is solved, come back and mark the answer.**

### Forms are bilingual

Every issue form and discussion form in this repository carries Chinese and English in the same field (`中文 / English`), so you can fill them in either language. GitHub has no per-language form support, and shipping duplicate English forms would double the "new issue" list and let the two versions drift apart — so both languages live in one form.

### Code of conduct

Participating means agreeing to [CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md](CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md). The one-line version: **be exacting about plugins, be kind to people.**

### Relationship to marketplaces

DSH already has more than one plugin marketplace, and they are good. **This community is not marketplace number N+1** and will not duplicate their indexing work. What it does is what a marketplace cannot:

- **Conversation** — a marketplace tells you a plugin exists; it cannot tell you whether it will break in your situation
- **Accumulation** — a question that got answered is worth far more than a one-off star count
- **Direct contact between authors and users** — plugin authors can see real feedback here

If you maintain a marketplace or index, come say hello in [General](https://github.com/moyuqing-man/dsh-plugin-community/discussions/categories/general) — **we would rather cooperate than compete.**

### Licence

The repository itself (README, contribution guide, issue and discussion forms) is [MIT](LICENSE), © 2026 moyuqing-man. **It contains no executable code** — see [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md) — and every plugin discussed here carries its own author's licence.

---

*Discussions in this repository carry the community content; each plugin's code and licence are its own author's responsibility.*

plugins.description: Durable subagent execution for DeepSeek Harness: a `durable` provider and a model-facing tool that drive pi-durable-subagents, so a crashed delegation converges on its first outcome instead of running twice.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-plugin-durable-subagent

Durable subagent execution for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness). It registers a `durable` provider on `ctx.subagents` and a model-facing `durable_subagent` tool, both driving [`pi-durable-subagents`](https://github.com/purboo/pi-durable-subagents).

The point of the pairing is one guarantee: **a delegation the harness accepted before a crash is read back, not run again.**

## Where the guarantee comes from

DeepSeek Harness durably records execution intent and does not promise exactly-once effects. Its session checkpoint policy states the convention this plugin implements:

> "The policy durably records execution intent, not generic exactly-once effects. Side-effecting tools should forward `exec.callId` as an idempotency key when their provider supports one."
> — `@deepseek-ai/dsh-session-checkpoint-policy`

`pi-durable-subagents` accepts exactly that key as `--request <id>`: the first submission under an id is decided once, and every later retry carrying the same content gets that first outcome. So the harness supplies durable intent plus the key, and the durable orchestrator supplies the single decision.

The join is a read-before-write state machine. Every attempt reads `describe --key <id>` first and only submits when the id is undecided, so a process that died between deciding a submission and reporting it leaves a durable decision that the next attempt reads instead of executing. The keyless test suite pins that path; the traced CLI invocation sequence is `describe → run → describe` with one execution recorded.

## Install

Two prerequisites. `pi-durable-subagents` must be on `PATH` (`npm i -g pi-durable-subagents`), or named by the `command` option. Without it every start fails with a message saying so rather than retrying.

The plugin is not on npm yet, so install it from the repository:

```sh
npm i -g pi-durable-subagents
dsh plugin --profile web add github:Tim-ReJet/dsh-plugin-durable-subagent
```

`lib/` is checked in. pnpm blocks build scripts for git-hosted packages, so a `prepare` step would fail the install rather than run it. Run `npm run build` after editing the TypeScript to refresh it.

Once the package is published the shorter form works:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-plugin-durable-subagent
```

The bundle patch inserts one row, `durable-subagent`.

## Config

| Field | Default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `provider` | `durable` | Registry name on `ctx.subagents`. |
| `command` | `pi-durable-subagents` | Executable, argv[0] only. |
| `commandArgs` | `[]` | Arguments before the subcommand, for a launcher rather than a bare executable. |
| `home` | — | `DSA_HOME` for every invocation. |
| `agent` | `worker` | The pi agent definition a delegation runs as unless the call names another. |
| `cwd` | the harness process's working directory | Working directory of every invocation. A run's cwd is part of the content the CLI hashes. |
| `idempotency` | `unique` | How the **provider** mints request ids: `unique` (one per start) or `content` (one per identical delegation). The tool always uses the call identity. |
| `attempts` | `3` | Submission attempts before a start fails. |
| `settleTimeoutMs` | `600000` | How long a run handle waits for the durable verdict. |
| `pollIntervalMs` | `1000` | Poll interval while waiting. |
| `timeoutMs` | `120000` | Per-invocation deadline for the CLI. |
| `enableTool` | `true` | Register the model-facing tool. |
| `tool` | `durable_subagent` | Model-facing tool name. |

## How a call becomes a durable request

1. The harness checks the call's intent durably, then runs the tool body with `exec.callId`.
2. The tool derives a request id from the calling session id and `exec.callId`, so a replay of the same call re-derives the same id.
3. The plugin reads the id's durable state. Only `absent` and `pending` proceed to `run`; `running` and `asking` return as they are, and `sealed`, `rejected`, and `pruned` are terminal.
4. `run --request <id> --spec - --cwd <cwd> --json` either decides the request, returns the first outcome, or reports `75` (not decided yet), in which case the next attempt reads the durable state again before resubmitting.

The provider path reaches `ctx.subagents` instead, where no call identity is available (`ResolvedSubagentStartRequest` carries none). It therefore mints ids from configuration: `unique` never conflicts but is not replay-stable, `content` is replay-stable but two identical delegations from one session collide as `request-conflict`. Pick `content` only when the delegations are content-distinct.

## Model Experience

### The tool

`durable_subagent` takes `action` (`run`, `status`, `answer`, `steer`, `notify`, `stop`), plus `task`, `agent`, `to`, `message`, `qid`, and `rev` as each action needs.

`run` returns as soon as the delegation is decided, not when its work finishes, and reports `sealed`, `running`, `pending`, or `asking` with the `request` address. `status` reads that address again; an `asking` state carries the question id and revision that `answer` needs. Nothing is polled on the model's behalf, so a long delegation costs no tokens while it runs.

### Token effect

A `run` reply is one short line. Reading a finished delegation returns its output; reading a running one returns a state name. No child transcript enters the parent's history.

### KV cache effect

Tool calls append after the reusable history prefix. Nothing here rewrites earlier messages.

## Known Limitations and Deferred Work

- **A linked plugin resolves its imports from its own repository.** `dsh plugin add <path>` records a `link:`, and Node follows the symlink to the plugin's real path, so `@deepseek-ai/*` is resolved from the plugin directory and never from the profile. The local install must therefore carry a complete closure: `npm install` resolves this package's harness peers, while `npm install --legacy-peer-deps` leaves `@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools` without the nine packages it declares as peers, and the profile then fails to boot with `failed to import loader entry durable-subagent (dsh-plugin-durable-subagent): Cannot find package '@deepseek-ai/dsh-scope'`. A published install from npm does not have this problem.
- **`cwd` is part of the submission digest.** A retry from a different working directory is a `request-conflict` rather than the first outcome. The default is stable for the life of the harness process; a per-session `cwd` is not yet wired.
- **The provider cannot be replay-stable.** `ResolvedSubagentStartRequest` carries no call identity, so only the tool path gets one execution per call. Making the provider path exact needs a durable run identity on the request; that is a harness change.
- **`dispose()` stops a run but does not await quiescence.** The orchestrator is a separate process and owns its own teardown, so the run handle cannot observe the child's exit.
- **No continuable children and no Agent Teams membership.** `prepareContinuable` is deliberately not implemented: `spawn_teammate` and cold resume need a durable child session this provider does not create.
- **No tool filtering, persona, or delegation depth.** The provider reports `outputSchema` only; a request needing another capability is rejected loudly by the subagent service rather than silently ignored.
- **`outputSchema` validation is delegated.** `pi-durable-subagents` validates a `report` against the schema it was handed before sealing, so a sealed `data` payload is schema-valid; the plugin does not re-validate it.
- **The orchestrator is not supervised.** The plugin neither starts nor restarts `pi-durable-subagents`; it relies on the orchestrator's own lazy start, lock, and idle exit. Running it under `ctx.subprocess` would make harness disposal kill it.
- **A failure is per call.** A workflow reports `status: "done"` even when every call inside it failed, and `output`/`error` live on the calls. `summarize()` reads them there; the read-only `status` view alone would call a failed delegation completed.

# DSH Community Web UI · Mobile & Cross-Device Remote Web Control English | [中文](README.zh.md) GitHub Release tarballs ship prebuilt `lib/` files and do not run a consumer-side build lifecycle. Source checkouts use `pnpm run build`.

   

Mobile & Cross-Device Remote Web Control for DeepSeek Harness (DSH)
Instant QR Pairing · Cross-Device PC Access · Mobile Touch Gestures · Cloudflare Tunnels · Secure Device Session

> Seamless remote access for DeepSeek Harness (DSH) Web GUI and desktop client sharing the **exact same interface**: pair an iPhone, Android smartphone, tablet, or another computer from the QR code next to settings. Both ends run the authentic official Web GUI — phones receive an injected portrait touch layer while remote computers enjoy the complete desktop workbench. Access is guarded by expiring pairing tokens and revocable sessions. Built-in LAN binding and optional Cloudflare quick tunnels enable effortless external access with persistent hostnames. This is an **unofficial community plugin** derived from `dsh-web` v0.4.5. It is structured as a cordis bundle: the host half manages pairing tokens, device sessions, `/api/pair` routes, the gated `/remote` channel, and LAN binding; the browser half renders the remote access trigger, QR pairing modal, live device roster, settings card, and mobile portrait touch adaptation. It is not affiliated with or endorsed by DeepSeek. ## What it does - **Entry**: a phone icon beside the settings button in both the expanded sidebar and the narrow rail; its tooltip and accessible label say "Remote access". - **Panel**: "Remote access" title, a "Pair a device" card with the status area ("Waiting for a device" + status badge), a large QR code, the pairing link with its copy button, Stop / Refresh QR actions, and the authorized-device roster (a device name inferred from User-Agent, online/offline, last active time, per-device unpair). Credential-bearing device ids and raw User-Agent values are never rendered. Both the phone and the PC use the same time-limited link: until it expires or the QR is refreshed, that link can pair several devices, each with its own device session. - **Phone side**: scanning the QR binds the phone with a time-limited token and reloads into the **official Web GUI** — there is no second interface to drift from. On touch phones, the plugin injects a responsive adaptation layer over the running UI for portrait and constrained landscape layouts (see "The mobile adaptation layer" below). The accept chain is cookieless (`/pair-accept` → `/pair-app`): the plugin itself serves the official shell, so the phone needs no harness browser-auth cookie at all. A reopen service worker (https origins) then owns later navigations to `/` from history, bookmarks, or tab restore, so the phone reopens straight into the app instead of a 401 dead end (see Security model). - **PC side**: the same link opens the full desktop Web GUI on another computer over the gated `/remote` channel; unpaired PCs see a guided blocking page (with a manual pair-token input) and no workspace data behind it. - **Security**: one active token at a time (a refresh invalidates the old link; the link stays re-usable within its expiry window so a scan handed between browsers can complete pairing; it expires). 停止 revokes every paired device and the current token — the `/remote` channel cuts them off on their next request. Pairing is this plugin's access control for the `/remote` channel; direct `/api` on a LAN-exposed bind is governed by the harness fence + browser auth (see Security model). Loopback (127.0.0.1) keeps using `/api` directly, and so does a page an application on this machine delivered — the desktop shell's `dsh-app://app/` or a `file:` page — because a pairing link is reachable only over the network. A paired device is a **full-control credential** (see Security model). - **LAN bind toggle**: the settings card writes a managed block into the profile `cordis.patch.yml` that pins the webserver bind to `0.0.0.0` (on) or `127.0.0.1` (off) — no `--host` command-line dance; an explicit `--host`/`--port` flag still wins. It maintains the matching host firewall rule (Windows Defender via netsh; Linux firewalld/ufw/iptables; other platforms report the firewall as unmanaged) and shows the live bind, the reachable LAN URLs, and the firewall state. - **Live status**: the desktop badge flips to 已连接 in real time; an `/api` posture probe reports any host whose `/api` fence the SDK leaves open, and the auto-tunnel state appears on the panel while the tunnel is starting. - **Self-update lives next door**: the one-click family update is its own plugin (`dsh-update`, the same sidebar foot seat), so turning remote access off — or disabling this plugin — never removes the update trigger. - **Desktop foot row**: on the wide sidebar the footer-action occupants share the official Settings trigger's line instead of stacking above it, so no single control owns a full-width row; any other foot block (the usage glance card, another plugin's) keeps a full row above them, and the 56px rail keeps the shell's stacked foot. ## The mobile adaptation layer The official desktop layout already auto-collapses the sidebar below 1024px. On top of that, while the viewport is portrait + coarse pointer + narrower than 1100px the plugin injects: - a CSS sheet keyed on CSS-Modules **semantic suffixes** (`[class$="_composerSeat"]`) so the selectors survive official rebuilds that only change hashes: 44px touch targets on the collapsed rail, 16px inputs (prevents iOS focus zoom), safe-area padding for the composer, compact type for the message list and sidebar, a column layout for the settings modal, and a full-width PlanReview card; - a **draggable whale button** as the entry to the collapsed sidebar (position persisted; wired to the official `ctx.layout.toggleSidebar()`), hidden while the sidebar is expanded; - **gestures**: left-swipe collapses the sidebar, right-swipe in the conversation opens it; long-pressing a session row opens the same action menu as the desktop ellipsis; tapping a session row or anywhere outside the sidebar collapses it again; - **input behavior for touch**: Enter only inserts a newline (send goes through the send button), programmatic composer focus is suppressed (no spurious keyboards), and official tooltip bubbles are hidden because taps leave them stuck; - **mobile plugin scope**: while the layer is active, the right-hand details column and the desktop-oriented tool surfaces (SSH terminal, skill explorer, task board, git graph, pet, usage) are hidden - keyed on the L2 semantic roots (`data-dsh-plugin`), so ownership stays with the declaring plugin and class churn cannot resurrect them. These are render suppressions; the client bundles still load. Activation also closes the details panel through the official `ctx.layout.closeDetails()`. - a **manual opt-out**: `sessionStorage.dsh-remote-force-desktop = 1` disables the whole layer; touch-phone portrait and constrained landscape layouts are adapted, while the native Desktop app and wide desktop-browser layout stay on the official presentation. The paired remote desktop also runs in **host mode**: on this harness line the "configuration plane is local" behavior is a client-side branch on `connection.isLoopback`, and the channel boot script installs the transport hook (`__DSH_TRANSPORT__.ownsHost = true`) before any boot entry. Host mode is **server-granted**: the hook is installed only when the device-gated app landing (`/pair-app`) published the grant marker ahead of the boot patch, so a shell served to an unpaired browser — a fence-open deployment — never poses as the machine owner.
