plugins.readme_text:
# @Echo-Note/dsh-hindsight-settings

English | [中文](README.zh.md)

![The Hindsight settings page in DeepSeek Harness](assets/screenshot-1-settings.png)
A DeepSeek Harness (DSH) companion plugin that adds a **Hindsight 记忆设置** page to Settings, so
`~/.hindsight/coding-agent.json` can be edited from the GUI instead of by hand.

It is a companion on purpose. `@vectorize-io/hindsight-coding-agents` mounts as a **subpath row**
(`…/coding-agents/dsh`), and DSH's client module system only attaches a browser half to the row whose
specifier is the bare package name — so that package cannot carry a settings page without changing how
every existing user mounts it. Nor does it declare any `Config`: it imports nothing from dsh and
resolves its settings from its own file, which the shipped settings form (schema-derived, persisted
into the profile patch) cannot reach. This package therefore ships its own page and its own host
service, and leaves the plugin untouched.

## Install

**From GitHub** — the package is consumed straight from this repository, and its
`@vectorize-io/hindsight-coding-agents` dependency is installed with it, so one install gets both:

```bash
# Any profile except a packaged Desktop one, whose profile the CLI refuses to write:
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add github:Echo-Note/dsh-hindsight-settings
```

In the **desktop app** (the profile the Electron shell owns) the CLI refuses by design; install from
the GUI instead — **Settings → Plugins → install**, and paste the same spec:

```
github:Echo-Note/dsh-hindsight-settings
```

The 40-character commit this resolves to is pinned by the package manager's lockfile, so a later
`git push` does not silently change what you run: re-install (or update) to move it. Git installs
build nothing — the compiled `lib/` is committed — so the install is a checkout, not a build.

Naming it with the scope is optional. `github:Echo-Note/dsh-hindsight-settings` installs it under the
name in this package's `package.json`; to force a different key, use the npm alias form, which is what
this repository's own dry-run used:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add '@Echo-Note/dsh-hindsight-settings@github:Echo-Note/dsh-hindsight-settings'
```

**From a local checkout** (while editing this package):

```bash
git clone https://github.com/Echo-Note/dsh-hindsight-settings.git
cd dsh-hindsight-settings
npm install          # dev dependencies only; nothing is needed at runtime but the peer packages
npm run build        # optional: refreshes lib/ from src/
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add link:"$PWD"
```

`link:` (not `file:`) is the right spec for a package you may edit: `file:` copies a snapshot into the
profile, `link:` symlinks it, so a rebuilt browser half is picked up on the next page load.

### The one manual step

A package's bundle is mounted only when the profile selects it in `dsh.profile.bundles`, and dsh's own
plugin-manager README states that "an unselected plain dependency is left out" — the manager lists
bundles a dependency supplies but does NOT select them. So after installing this package, enable
**Hindsight** once in **Settings → Plugins** (installing the bundle by name,
`dsh plugin --profile <profile> add @vectorize-io/hindsight-coding-agents`, does the same thing).

`dsh` has no bundle-depends-on-bundle field to express this (`DshManifest` carries only
`manifestVersion`, `bundle.patch`, `client`, `engines.dsh`), and the alternative — our patch inserting
Hindsight's row directly — would compose the same row twice when its own bundle is also enabled,
because patch `insert` appends without deduplicating entry ids.

The host half, the `./typert` manifest and the browser bundle are all read at startup, and dsh's
plugin manager notes that "package replacements require restarting the process to load a fresh
JavaScript module generation" — so **restart once** after installing.

## How it works

```
~/.hindsight/coding-agent.json          ← the one file every Hindsight harness reads
        ▲            │
        │ apply()    │ describe()                     (host, src/service.ts + src/typert.host.ts)
        │            ▼
   ctx.provide('hindsightSettings')  ──Remote──▶  POST /api/hindsightSettings/<method>
        ▲                                                  │
        └──────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
                                    browser (src/client/index.tsx)
                       page in Settings, mounted via ctx.remote.$mount(contribution)
```

- The host publishes one Cordis service; its `./typert` manifest exposes `describe` and `apply` to the
  page (`docs/api-gateway.md`).
- The page renders every field from `src/fields.ts` — the single declaration of the config surface —
  and writes back only what changed. A field the user clears is sent as `null`, which removes the key
  so the setting falls back to the environment variable, then to the plugin's own default.
- Fields are grouped into one tab per section, plus a **按项目（banks）** tab. A bank tab edits
  `banks.<id>`, which is how upstream lets one repository differ from the shared top level; opening a
  bank calls `describe({ kind: "bank", id })` and saving calls `applyScoped(...)`. `paths.<dir>` is
  listed read-only.
- A field the file does not set is still shown with its **effective** value — the plugin default —
  labelled as such, while a cleared cell still means "remove the key". Nothing is written until a cell
  actually changes.
- Secrets are never sent to the page: `apiToken` shows as set-but-blank ("已设置（不显示明文）"), typing
  replaces it, and only the explicit 清空 button removes it. This mirrors dsh's own settings service,
  where a `role('secret')` value is kept out of form responses.
- Nothing goes through the DSH settings form or the profile patch. An earlier revision tried to mirror
  the file into this plugin's own `Config` so the shipped form would show it; a real install refused
  that write with _"HMR transactions cannot be nested"_ (the row is mounted inside the loader's
  transaction, an `AsyncLocalStorage` scope that even timers inherit), and the form never served the
  namespace. Talking to the file directly is both simpler and the documented path for host state.

## Safety

- Managed keys only: keys this package does not know, and the nested `banks` / `paths` / `harnesses`
  sections, are preserved verbatim.
- `null` removes a key; there is no other way to delete, and a field the page never sends is untouched.
- Writes go through a temp file + rename, at mode `0600` — the file can hold `apiToken`.
- A file that cannot be parsed is **never** overwritten: the page reports it and disables saving.
- An invalid value (wrong type, unknown key, a file-only nested map) is refused before the disk is
  touched.

## Interface fields

`mapPathToBank`, `pages`, `customPages`, `recallOptions`, `retainMetadata`, `defaultBankConfig`,
`harnesses` and the deprecated `autoReflect` are shown **read-only** in a group tab: they are nested
maps a single form field cannot express, and upstream documents them as file-only. The page says so
per field rather than hiding them. `banks` and `paths` are not read-only: the bank tab edits
`banks.<id>` through a scoped write, and the file's `paths` sections are listed read-only.

## Precedence and when an edit takes effect

Upstream resolves `defaults → HINDSIGHT_* → the file's top level → harnesses.<name> → banks.<id> /
paths.<dir>`, later winning. The page writes the top level, so a `harnesses.dsh` entry for the same key
still wins — the page badges those fields. Upstream reads the file once per workspace, at plugin load,
so an edit reaches a running session after a dsh restart; `apiToken` is the exception (its client
re-reads the credential on the next call after a server rejection, so rotating it needs no restart).

## Troubleshooting

The host half appends what it did to `~/.hindsight/dsh-settings-status.json`:

```jsonc
{
  "events": [
    {
      "at": "…",
      "step": "apply",
      "provided": "hindsightSettings",
      "entryId": "hindsight-settings",
    },
    { "at": "…", "step": "describe", "path": "…/coding-agent.json", "error": null, "fields": 52 },

plugins.description: Bridge QQ official-bot private chats into DeepSeek Harness agent sessions - same session, same memory, same permissions. No second QQ gateway, no copy-pasted system prompt.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-qqbot-bridge

**English** · [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md)

[![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-blue.svg)](LICENSE)
[![Node](https://img.shields.io/badge/node-%3E%3D22.19-339933.svg)](package.json)
[![Tests](https://img.shields.io/badge/tests-139%20passing-brightgreen.svg)](TEST-REPORT.md)
[![PRs welcome](https://img.shields.io/badge/PRs-welcome-ff69b4.svg)](#contributing)

> Route QQ private messages into the AI team sessions you **already** have in [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) — same session id, same memory, same permissions. No second QQ gateway, no copy-pasted system prompt.

![Asking the 程序员 Bot for a quicksort on QQ, and getting the real session's answer back](assets/demo.gif)

*Real run: a private message on QQ, answered by the Bot's actual DSH session — code, files and all. The same conversation is waiting in the DSH Web UI.*

```
        QQ app                          ┌─ DSH Web UI ─┐
           │                            │  程序员 chat  │
    private message                     └──────▲───────┘
           ▼                                   │  the same session
   ┌───────────────────────────────────────────┴──────────────────────────┐
   │  dsh-qqbot-bridge  →  the Bot's REAL session (history + memory + ...) │
   └──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

---

## The problem

You already run a **team of agents** inside DSH: several Bots, each with its own long-lived
session, its own role instructions, its own long-term memory, its own tools and workspace.
You want to talk to them **from QQ**.

The obvious approach — *"write a QQ bot that calls the model with the same system prompt"* —
silently throws away everything that made the team worth building: the conversation history,
the memory files, the permissions, the workspace, the resume-after-restart behaviour.
You end up with a stranger wearing the same name.

This project does not do that. It **delivers a QQ message into the session that Bot already
has**, and relays the Bot's answer back to QQ.

## What makes it different

| | Typical QQ ⇄ LLM bridge | **dsh-qqbot-bridge** |
|---|---|---|
| Identity | Copies the system prompt | **Reuses the real session** — `sessionController.resolveAgent(sessionId)` then `agent.followup(createUserMessage({ source }))` |
| Context | Starts from scratch | The Bot's actual history, memory, tools and workspace |
| Web ⇄ QQ | Two disconnected worlds | **One session**: start on QQ, continue in the Web UI, same context |
| QQ gateway | Opens its own connection | **Borrows** the one the official plugin already runs — no second login, no credential race |
| Allowlist | `[]` often means *everyone* | `[]` means **nobody** (fail-closed); refused peers are only *recorded*, never auto-granted |
| Observability | Silence when it breaks | Console lines **and** `bridge-status.json` — "did it load?" always has an answer |
| Official commands | Frequently swallowed | `/bot-ping`, `/bot-status`, … keep working |
| Long conversations | Pins one session id | Re-reads `state.json` before every send, so a session that rolls over to a new part keeps working |
| Group chats | Often on by default | Off, and group traffic is handed back to the stock chain untouched |

Every row above is backed by a test or a real run log — see [`TEST-REPORT.md`](TEST-REPORT.md).

## How it works

```
QQ private message
      │
      ▼
@tencent-connect/dsh-qqbot   (stock plugin + a tiny local fork, patch 0001)
      │   owns the only QQ websocket, holds the credentials
      │   publishes: ctx.provide('qqbot', { setMessagePreHandler, sender, replyTargetFor, … })
      ▼
dsh-qqbot-bridge   (this project — consumes the service, never opens a socket)
      │   1. allowlist gate      (empty ⇒ refuse everyone, record the OpenID only)
      │   2. command router      /管家 /设计师 /程序员 /聊天 /团队 /当前   → routing.json
      │   3. per-OpenID FIFO queue + message-id de-duplication
      │   4. read state.json (READ-ONLY) for that Bot's CURRENT session id
      │   5. sessionController.resolveAgent(sessionId) → agent.followup(msg)
      ▼
the Bot's real DSH session          ← the very same one the Web UI shows
      │   msg.source.kind = 'qqbot-bridge'   (so QQ and Web turns are distinguishable)
      ▼
ctx.on('session/event') collects the answer, turn/end closes it
      │
      ▼
back to QQ (chunked, with honest failure and timeout messages)
```

The bridge registers **one** Cordis service of its own (`qqbotBridge`) so an operator can ask
a live host what it is doing.

### Why a fork of the QQ plugin is required

The stock `@tencent-connect/dsh-qqbot` keeps its `QQBot` instance, `SessionManager` and
outbound sender inside local variables and **registers no Cordis service at all**, so an
external plugin cannot send on the same connection, cannot intercept the middleware chain,
and cannot learn which OpenID a message came from. Starting a second gateway with the same
AppID would race the first one for the event stream.

So the only clean option is a **minimal local fork**, and patch 0001 adds exactly two things:

| File | Change |
|---|---|
| `dist/gateway/middleware-setup.js` | one optional `preHandlers` argument, inserted at the **front** of the middleware chain |
| `dist/gateway/bootstrap.js` | `ctx.provide('qqbot', { setMessagePreHandler, sender, replyTargetFor, manager })` |

No existing statement is modified, and a host that never calls the extension point behaves
exactly as before. Rollback is one dependency range in the profile manifest.
Full evidence in [`patches/0001-qqbot-extension-point.md`](patches/0001-qqbot-extension-point.md).

## Quick start

Prerequisites: DSH with the Web profile, the stock QQ plugin installed and already bound to
your AppID, and DS Bot with your team created.

```bash
# 1. self-check (zero runtime dependencies — no install needed)
node scripts/run-tests.mjs
node scripts/audit-constraints.mjs
node scripts/verify-host-resolution.mjs

# 2. generate the local fork (finds the installed stock package automatically,
#    or pass --from <dir>)
node scripts/make-bridged-qqbot.mjs --out ../dsh-bridged-qqbot
(cd ../dsh-bridged-qqbot && pnpm install --prefer-offline)   # pnpm does not do this for linked packages

# 3. point your Web profile at the fork and mount this bridge (see the diff first)
node scripts/install-profile.mjs --fork ../dsh-bridged-qqbot --project . --dry-run
node scripts/install-profile.mjs --fork ../dsh-bridged-qqbot --project .

# 4. stop dsh, then install inside the profile
cd ~/.dsh/profiles/web && pnpm install

# 5. start dsh again. You should see the bridge announce itself:
#    [qqbot-bridge] apply() entered (plugin v0.1.0)
#    [qqbot-bridge] allowOpenIds: 0 configured -- FAIL CLOSED, every QQ peer is refused
#    [qqbot-bridge] provided the "qqbotBridge" service
#    [qqbot-bridge] STARTED: transport=dsh-qqbot-bridge/qq | snapshot=...
```

Then allowlist yourself:

```bash
# send any private message to the bot on QQ (it will be refused, on purpose), then:
node scripts/show-openids.mjs          # prints the OpenID that was recorded
# put it into ~/.dsh/profiles/web/cordis.patch.yml -> allowOpenIds: ["YOUR_OPENID"]
```

Editing `cordis.patch.yml` is picked up by DSH's config hot reload — **no restart needed**.

## Using it from QQ

| Command | Effect |
|---|---|
| `/管家` `/设计师` `/程序员` `/聊天` | switch which Bot you are talking to (persisted per OpenID) |
| `/团队` | list the team |
| `/当前` | show who you are talking to |
| anything else | delivered to the current Bot; its answer comes back to QQ |

## Configuration

All of it lives in **your** profile patch, never in this repository:

```yaml
- id: qqbot-bridge
  config:
    allowOpenIds: []        # EMPTY MEANS NOBODY. Add only your own OpenID.
    defaultBot: 管家         # who receives a message from a peer with no switch yet
    allowGroups: false      # v1 is private chats only
    replyTimeoutMs: 600000  # how long to wait for a Bot turn before telling the user
    queueMax: 4             # per-peer queued messages
    textChunkLimit: 4500    # max characters per QQ message
    debug: false
    # statePath / da

plugins.description: Pin an OpenCode Go upstream route in DeepSeek Harness by keeping one stable x-opencode-session key, with an in-GUI route picker and drift checks.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-opencode-pin · 把 OpenCode Go 的上游路由钉住

一个 DeepSeek Harness（DSH）Host 插件：**把所有模型调用钉在 OpenCode Go 套餐上**，并保证每个请求都带 **稳定的 `x-opencode-session`**，从而让 OpenCode 的「会话 → 上游提供商」绑定在整段对话里不漂移。

---

[![awesome · DSH plugin](https://awesome-dsh-plugin.com/badge.svg)](https://github.com/awesome-dsh-plugin/awesome-dsh-plugin)

**源码**：<https://github.com/wobushiyoushen0214/dsh-opencode-pin>

## 安装

```sh
# 官方 CLI（插件市场里的同一条命令）
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-opencode-pin

# DSH 内置插件管理器
plugin_manager { action: "install_bundle", target: "dsh-opencode-pin" }
```

装好后：**设置 → 内置插件 → 页签「OpenCode 上游钉选」**。也可以从插件市场的卡片一键安装（搜 "OpenCode 上游钉选" 或 `dsh-opencode-pin`）。

---

## 0. 当前状态（本机已实测）

| 项 | 结果 |
|---|---|
| 安装 | bundle `dsh-opencode-pin`，行 `opencode-pin`：`enabled` 且 `fiberPhase: active` |
| Config schema | `cordis_inspect_query Config.listConfigs` → `status: "schema"`，`packageDir` 指向 profile 链接；说明 `@deepseek-ai/schemastery` 的 peer 路由在重启后生效 |
| 路由钉（**已在跑**） | 会话日志只有两条 `request/header`：`initial muyuan/deepseek-v4.1-flash` → `resume opencode-go/deepseek-v4.1-flash`（effort `high`、maxTokens `384000`）；重启后 13 条 `assistant/message` 全部由 `opencode-go` 服务，且**没有** provider 反复横跳 |
| 单测 | `node --test test/*.test.mjs` → 23 passed |
| 观测路由 | `GET /opencode-pin/status` 曾 404：已定位为注册时机 bug 并修复（见下），**需再重启一次生效** |

### 两个踩过的坑（都已在代码里修掉）

1. **`agent/request` 必须 `prepend` 才能钉住路由。** `dsh-agent` 自己的"会话模型选择"监听器也答 `agent/request`，它在外层 `await next()` 后用会话选择覆盖结果。插件原来注册在最内层，改写被吞掉，日志里表现为每步都 `muyuan -> opencode-go` 却钉不住；而且"会话选择 ≠ 最近 header"会被当成用户换模型，反复注入 `[model changed: …]` 通知。现在：`{ global: true, prepend: true }` + 通过 `sessionController.selectForNextRequest()` 把钉住的路由写成本会话 `model/selection`。
2. **`ctx.on('webServer', …)` 在 Cordis v4 里永不触发。** 服务就绪只以 `internal/service` 事件广播（`cordis/lib/index.js:849`）。而 `webServer` 由 web 端 bundle 挂载，插件在 profile bundle 之后激活时它可能还不存在 → 路由永远注册不上。正确写法是 `ctx.inject(['webServer'], (scoped) => …)`。
   现场对比（临时探针插件，两个路由同插件内并列）：
   ```text
   /opencode-pin-probe/inject   200  {"ok":true,"via":"ctx.inject"}
   /opencode-pin-probe/event    404
   ```

> 插件 JS 代码改动**必须重启应用**才会加载新一代模块（ESM 模块缓存）；只有 `cordis.patch.yml` 的配置改动走 HMR。

---

## 1. 为什么需要它（实测结论，非推测）

用 `scripts/evidence.mjs` 打真实请求（每次 1 token），OpenCode Go 会在响应头里明说自己用了哪个上游：

```text
x-opencode-endpoint-id:        novita-deepseek | luminal-dsv4.1flash | orcarouter-dsv4.1flash | ...
x-opencode-upstream-model-id:  deepseek/deepseek-v4.1-flash | deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash | ...
x-zen-model:                   deepseek-v4.1-flash
x-opencode-log-id:             98b1140f-5350-4bce-8c02-19e1afa1f438
```

三个关键事实：

1. **同一个模型 id 由多个上游端点服务**（`novita-deepseek`、`luminal-dsv4.1flash`、`orcarouter-dsv4.1flash` …），
   `x-opencode-upstream-model-id` 甚至分两种命名体系：`deepseek-ai/...`（官方权重那一路）与 `deepseek/...`（第三方托管）。这就是「降智」的来源——落到哪个上游不由你选。
2. **路由由 `x-opencode-session` 决定，而且一旦分配就黏在那个 key 上**：
   - 同一 key 连续请求 → 始终同一个端点；
   - 换新 key → 落到「当前默认」端点（会随时间/负载整体变化）；
   - 官方文档明确要求：*"Send a stable session ID in `x-opencode-session` for each conversation so we can optimize routing and prompt caching."*
3. **不带这个头，请求直接被拒**：

   ```text
   HTTP 400  Request is missing x-opencode-session and cannot be routed efficiently.
   ```

而 DSH 只有部分路径会带 session：agent 主循环 / 子代理 / 标题 / 压缩都带，但
`@deepseek-ai/dsh-experimental-auto-review` 这类直接调 `ctx.llm.stream()` 的路径不带（OpenCode 官方文档的 "Known problematic clients" 里点名 DSH：*"Session information arrives on some model paths, but is missing on others."*）。
DSH 也不会把响应头暴露给插件，所以「现在到底落在哪个上游」平时是看不见的。

## 2. 它怎么做

| 机制 | 扩展点 | 作用 |
|---|---|---|
| 路由钉选 | `agent/request` waterfall | 在请求被**记入会话日志之前**把 provider/model 换成配置的目标（默认 `opencode-go/deepseek-v4.1-flash`）。主循环与每个子代理都覆盖，用量归属与可回放 header 保持正确。 |
| 会话兜底注入 | `llm/stream` waterfall | 任何到达 LLM seam 却没有 `sessionId` 的调用，补齐为「发起该调用的对话身份」；落在 OpenCode 路由上的调用可改为共享一个被探测挑出来的 key（`shared` / `hunt` 模式）。 |
| 会话选择对齐 | `sessionController.agents.selectForNextRequest()`（facade 上若将来提升也接受；都没有则退回纯 waterfall，并在状态里报 `selectionApi: false`） | 把钉住的路由写成本会话的 `model/selection`。`dsh-agent` 会把"会话选择 ≠ 最近请求 header"当成用户换了模型，反复注入 `[model changed: ...]` 通知——对齐后不会误报，UI 的模型标签也与实际一致。 |
| 上游观测与挑选 | 自带 1-token 探测 | 因为 Harness 不给插件响应头，插件自己发探测请求，读出 `x-opencode-endpoint-id`，在 `hunt` 模式下**挑一个落在偏好端点上的 key 并全程复用**——这就是字面意义上的「钉住上游提供商」。 |

`hunt` 模式的做法：先用候选 key 并行探测（默认 4 个，每个 1 token），若某个 key 的端点命中 `probe.prefer`（例如 `["luminal-*"]`），就把这个 key 固定下来给所有会话用；超过 `probe.recheckMs` 会重新验证一次，发现漂移就再挑一轮并告警。

### 钉住上游端点（本插件的主要用途）

实测结论（本机，跨 1 小时+、跨两次应用重启）：

| key | 现在落到 | `x-opencode-upstream-model-id` |
|---|---|---|
| `probe-A` / `pin-live-a` | `luminal-dsv4.1flash` | `deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash`（官方权重命名那一路） |
| `pin-6` / `evidence-old` | `novita-deepseek` | `deepseek/deepseek-v4.1-flash` |
| `pin-1` | `orcarouter-dsv4.1flash` | `deepseek/deepseek-v4.1-flash` |
| 任何**新** key | 当前默认（观察期内从 luminal → novita → orcarouter 变过） | 随默认 |

两条关键规律：

1. **绑定黏在 key 上，且长期稳定**；换新 key 只会拿到"当前默认"。
2. 所以想要**非默认**端点（如 luminal），必须**复用当初落在那里、且一直黏着的旧 key** —— 这正是本插件 `probe.pool` / 记忆 key 的用途。

配置（`cordis.patch.yml` 里按行 id `opencode-pin` 覆盖，`config` 整体替换）：

```yaml
- id: opencode-pin
  name: "dsh-opencode-pin"
  config:
    pin:
      route: false                 # 不钉 provider 路由，只钉上游端点
    session:
      mode: shared                 # 所有 opencode 请求共用一个 key ⇒ 同一个上游
      models: [deepseek-v4.1-flash]  # 只钉这个模型（留空=该路由所有模型）
      key: probe-A                 # ← 换这一行就换上游：
                                   #   probe-A / pin-live-a → luminal-dsv4.1flash
                                   #   pin-6 / evidence-old → novita-deepseek
                                   #   pin-1               → orcarouter-dsv4.1flash
                                   #   任意新 key          → 当前默认端点
    probe:
      prefer: ["luminal-*"]        # hunt 模式的偏好端点（通配 *）
      pool: [probe-A, pin-live-a, pin-6, evidence-old, pin-1]  # 优先复用的历史 key
```

### 哪个端点算「DeepSeek 官方」？

同一模型 `deepseek-v4.1-flash` 在三个端点上的线上指纹（实测）：

| 端点 (`x-opencode-endpoint-id`) | `x-opencode-upstream-model-id` | 响应 `id` 形态 | 判断 |
|---|---|---|---|
| `luminal-dsv4.1flash` | **`deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash`** | `chatcmpl-ad9b3b1c` | HuggingFace 官方组织 `deepseek-ai/` 的仓库命名 ⇒ **官方权重那一路** |
| `novita-deepseek` | `deepseek/deepseek-v4.1-flash` | 32 位 hex | OpenRouter 风格 vendor slug ⇒ 第三方托管 |
| `orcarouter-dsv4.1flash` | `deepseek/deepseek-v4.1-flash` | 56 位 hex | 同上 |

另外：端点空间是按模型分配的 —— `deepseek-v4-pro` 只有 `orcarouter-dsv4pro`；`deepseek-v4-flash` 只有 `novita-deepseek`；唯一名字就叫 `deepseek` 的端点只服务 `deepseek-v4-flash-vision-exp`，`deepseek-v4.1-flash` **拿不到**它（4 个不同 key 抽样均未出现）。

所以：**在 opencode-go 体系内，「官方」的上限就是 `luminal-dsv4.1flash`**（本插件的 `key: probe-A` 正指向它）。想要**真正的 DeepSeek 官方 API 直连**（`api.deepseek.com`），应当改用 DSH 自带路由而不是 opencode-go：

| 路由 | 凭据 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|
| `deepseek-account` | DSH 账号授权（`x-dsh-auth-token`） | 登录即用；`inferenceOrigin` 默认 `https://api.deepseek.com`；失败以 `ACCOUNT_QUOTA` 呈现 |
| `deepseek-official` | `DEEPSEEK_API_KEY` | 需在 设置→模型 里填官方 API Key |

两条路由的默认目录都是 `deepseek-flash`（文本+图片，1M 上下文）与 `deepseek-v4-pro`（纯文本，1M），且模型 id 原样透传，任意官方模型 id 都能直接请求。

想让它**自愈**（定期校验绑定、漂移就自动换回一个命中的 key）：把 `session.mode` 改成 `hunt`。hunt 会**先验证 `pool` 里的历史 key**（而不是只探新 key，因为新 key 拿不到非默认端点），命中即用，超过 `probe.recheckMs`（默认 30 分钟）重新校验，发现漂移会在日志里告警并重挑。

监控漂移：面板点「探测一轮」，或 `curl "localhost:19387/opencode-pin/probe?keys=probe-A"`，看 `endpoint` 是否还是你钉的那个。

> 注意：`session.mode: shared` 会让该模型的所有请求（含标题/压缩/子代理）共用这一个 key —— 这是"钉上游"的代价与目的。想让别的模型保持原样，用 `session.models` 限定范围。

## 3. 安装

在 DSH 里用插件管理器安装（不会手写 profile 文件，也不需要 pnpm）：

```text
plugin_manager { action: "install_bundle", target: "/Users/lizhiwei/localProj/dsh-opencode-pin" }
```

安装后确认：

- `plugin_manager { action: "list_plugins" }` 里能看到行 `opencode-pin`（`application: applied` 表示已热挂载）；
- `GET http://127.0.0.1:19387/opencode-pin/status` 返回 JSON；
- 日志里出现 `opencode-pin: route pin on (opencode-go/deepseek-v4.1-flash), session mode "conversation", hunt off`。

> 修改插件代码后需要重启应用才会加载新的 JS（`restart-required`）；只改 `cordis.patch.yml` 的配置会走 HMR。

## 4. 配置

配置走标准 DSH 方式：在 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml` 里按行 id 覆盖。**注意 patch 里的 `config` 是整体替换，不是深合并**，要改哪层就把那层写全。

```yaml
- id: opencode-pin
  name: "dsh-opencode-pin"
  config:
    pin:
      route: true                     # 强制所有调用走下面这个路由
      provider: opencode-go

plugins.description: A configurable direct channel for the DeepSeek Harness LLM egress: a keep-alive undici Agent with adjustable connect/headers/body/keep-alive timeouts, IPv4-forcing, HTTP/2 off by default, automatic stand-down behind a proxy, and a read-only status route. A minimal patch, one file, zero dependencies.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-undici-timeout

[![awesome · DSH plugin](https://awesome-dsh-plugin.com/badge.svg)](https://awesome-dsh-plugin.com)

DSH 插件：给 LLM 出口（`globalThis.fetch` → Node 内置 undici）换一条**可配置超时 + 可保活复用**的直连通道。

English: [README.en.md](README.en.md)　·　发布流程: [RELEASING.md](RELEASING.md)　·　收录条目: [`contrib/awesome-dsh-plugin/`](contrib/awesome-dsh-plugin/)

## 为什么需要它

- Node 内置 `fetch` 背后的 undici，`connectTimeout` 固定 **10s**（DNS+TCP+TLS 全算在内），
  没有环境变量/参数可调；
- 本机（WSL）直连 `opencode.ai` 的新建握手实测出现过 **11.6s**，双栈探测也常整轮
  `AggregateError`（IPv6 无出口 + IPv4 抖动）；
- pi-ai 每次重试都 `new OpenAI(...)` → `Shims.getDefaultFetch()` **当场读全局 fetch**，
  所以每次尝试都是新 TCP+TLS，被 10s 砍掉 → `TIMEOUT/TRANSPORT` → 重试又重连。
  今天（2026-10-13）的日志：87 次 TIMEOUT + 8 次 TRANSPORT，autoswitch 开代理 10 次。

对比：OpenCode（Go 客户端）全程复用一条已建立的 HTTP/2 连接，握手只发生一次，
所以同样的网络下它不超时。本插件就是把这套「长超时 + 保活复用」搬给 DSH。

## 这东西的寿命：它是一个补丁，不是一块功能

它存在的理由只有两条，而且两条都在**上游**，不是 DSH 的既定设计：

1. Node 内置 `fetch` 的 `connectTimeout` 固定 **10s** 且没有开关（Node/undici 上游行为）；
2. undici 8 把 `allowH2` 的默认值翻成 `true`，而 Cloudflare 边缘对 h2 上的 SSE 长流会
   回 `NGHTTP2_ENHANCE_YOUR_CALM`（上游默认值 × 边缘策略）。

这两条一旦在 DSH 侧被解决 —— 比如 LLM 层允许指定 dispatcher / 连接超时，或者换掉内置
fetch —— 本插件就**没有存在价值了**，直接卸掉：

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-undici-timeout   # 或者删掉 profile 里那条 insert
```

判断「可以卸了」的依据（任一条成立即可）：

- 状态路由 `stats` 长期没有 `TIMEOUT`，且直连握手不再接近 10s；
- DSH 的 LLM 层能自己配连接超时 / 强制复用连接（看 release notes，或
  `dsh --profile web --dump-config` 里出现了对应配置项）；
- 上游把内置 fetch 换成了自带 Agent 的实现。

在那之前它是**最小补丁**：单文件、零依赖、只接管白名单域名、随时可摘。
所以只从 GitHub 分发，不发 npm、不进插件市场。

## 原理

```
agent 回合
 └─ dsh-llm-retry（重试）→ dsh-llm-pi-ai → pi-ai → new OpenAI({ fetch: undefined })
      → openai/client.mjs: this.fetch = Shims.getDefaultFetch()   ← 每次尝试当场读全局
      → 【本插件包装过的 globalThis.fetch】
           ├─ 命中 hosts 白名单 且 无代理 env → undici.fetch(url, { dispatcher: 自建 Agent })
           └─ 其它（代理模式 / 非白名单 / Request 输入）→ 原样透传给原来的 fetch
```

- 用**解析到的那份 undici**（`argv[1]` → profile 扫描 → bare）自建 `Agent`：
  `connect.timeout`、`headersTimeout`、`bodyTimeout`、`keepAliveTimeout/MaxTimeout`、
  `pipelining`、可选 `family`。
- **不碰 `setGlobalDispatcher`**：那是 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-http-proxy` 的地盘（代理联动靠它），
  抢了会把 net-proxy 弄坏。本插件只接管「本来要走直连」的那部分流量。
- 代理 env（`http_proxy/https_proxy/ALL_PROXY` 任一大写或小写）在场时**自动让路**，
  由 harness 的代理层处理——所以能和 `dsh-net-proxy` / `dsh-net-autoswitch` 共存。

## 配置项（`cordis.patch.yml` 里本插件的 `config:`）

| 键 | 默认 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|
| `enabled` | `true` | 总开关。`false` 时不改 fetch，状态路由仍在。 |
| `hosts` | `["opencode.ai"]` | 命中这些域名（含子域）才接管；`"*"` = 全部直连流量。 |
| `connectTimeoutMs` | `30000` | **核心项**。DNS+TCP+TLS 的总预算（内置固定 10s）。范围 1000–600000。 |
| `headersTimeoutMs` | `300000` | 等响应头。 |
| `bodyTimeoutMs` | `0` | 相邻 body 块间隔；`0`=关闭，卡流交给 pi-ai 的 `streamIdleTimeoutMs` 看门狗。 |
| `keepAliveTimeoutMs` | `60000` | 空闲连接保留时长（复用 = 不重握手）。 |
| `keepAliveMaxTimeoutMs` | `600000` | 保活上限。 |
| `pipelining` | `1` | 每连接并发请求数。 |
| `family` | `0` | `0`=跟随系统；`4`/`6`=强制 IP 族（本机 IPv6 无出口时 `4` 很划算）。 |
| `allowH2` | `false` | **⚠️ 见下面「h2 的坑」**。undici 8 把 `allowH2` 的默认值翻成了 `true`，不显式关掉，本插件会顺手把 LLM 出口从 h1 换成 h2。 |
| `autoSelectFamilyAttemptTimeoutMs` | `0` | Node happy-eyeballs 的**地址轮换间隔**（默认 250ms）。注意：尝试是**并行保留**的，这个值不是单地址的放弃窗口——黑洞地址实测默认与调大都会等到 connect 超时才死，改大只会拖慢轮换，一般别动。保留它只为极端调优。 |
| `delegateOnProxyEnv` | `true` | 有代理 env 时让路。 |
| `undiciPath` | `""` | 留空自动解析；可显式指到某份 `undici/index.js`。 |
| `probeOnStart` | `true` | 启动时打一次探针（默认打 LLM 网关的 models 端点，不花 token）。 |
| `probeUrl` / `probeTimeoutMs` | `…/zen/go/v1/models` / `15000` | 探针目标与超时。 |
| `logSlowMs` | `0` | >0 时把达到该耗时的请求写日志。 |
| `logFailures` | `true` | 失败请求记日志（含 cause）。 |
| `routePath` | `/_dsh/undici-timeout` | 状态路由。 |
| `logFile` | `$DSH_HOME/logs/dsh-undici-timeout/host.log` | 日志落盘。 |

## 安装

**只从 GitHub 分发**（本插件是上游行为的补丁，不发 npm、不上市场）：

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add github:mqnu00/dsh-undici-timeout
```

装完**重启 DSH** 生效。也可以钉住某个版本：

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add github:mqnu00/dsh-undici-timeout#v0.1.1
```

零 npm 依赖、无构建步骤，所以 pnpm 不会弹 `allowBuilds` 授权（本插件没有任何
`prepare` / `install` 脚本）。⚠️ 别和下面路线 B 的 `file://` 直插**同时用**：
包内 `cordis.patch.yml` 的 insert id 也是 `undici-timeout`，同 id 冲突。

改完代码想知道「别人 clone 下来到底装不装得上」，本地跑一遍试装验证 —— 把包装进一个
临时 DSH_HOME 里的干净 profile、真启动一次、再请求插件自己的状态路由：

```bash
./scripts/trial-install.sh          # 走 tarball（等价于 GitHub Release 资产）
./scripts/trial-install.sh --git    # 走本地裸仓库 git+file://（等价于 github: 源）
./scripts/trial-install.sh --spec=github:mqnu00/dsh-undici-timeout   # 直接验真实远端
# 🎉 试装验证通过 = 组合成功 + 启动就绪 + 状态路由应答
```

打 tag / 建 Release 的步骤见 [RELEASING.md](RELEASING.md)。

### 路线 B：file:// 直插 profile 用户层（改代码时用这条）

`~/.dsh/profiles/web/cordis.patch.yml` 末尾追加：

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: undici-timeout
      name: file:///home/mqnu/program/dsh/dsh-undici-timeout/lib/index.js?v=5
      config:
        enabled: true
        hosts: [opencode.ai]
        connectTimeoutMs: 30000
        # 本机 IPv6 无出口：别让地址族探测把预算烧在 10 个死地址上
        family: 4
        # undici 8 的 allowH2 默认是 true，不关掉就会把出口换成 h2（见「h2 的坑」）
        allowH2: false
        bodyTimeoutMs: 0
        keepAliveTimeoutMs: 60000
```

`dsh-hmr` 会监听该文件，**原地写** 2 秒内自动重挂（tmp+rename 会换 inode，收不到事件）。
⚠️ insert 行按 **id 幂等**：只改 `name`（换 `?v=`）或改 `config` 不会立刻重挂——要么**摘掉再插回**，
要么重启 DSH（HMR 的实测行为，和 dsh-net-autoswitch 一致）。
2026-10-15 复验：只把 `?v=4` 改成 `?v=5` 并加配置，HMR 确实重挂了（实例 id、`installedAt`
都换新），但**跑的还是旧模块代码** —— 日志里没有新加的 `h2=off` 字段，状态路由里也读不到
`allowH2`。原因就是同 id 的 entry 按**旧 URL** 重新 import。**摘掉（等 HMR 跑一轮）→ 再插回**，
这次 `?v=5` 才真正被 import，`h2=off` 出现在日志里。改代码务必按这个顺序。

## h2 的坑（2026-10-15 定位，`allowH2` 就是为它加的）

症状：插件明明在跑（`matched` 一直涨），却仍然「很频繁地失败」，重试日志里
`code=TRANSPORT` 暴涨。

根因是一条**静默换协议**：

| | 用的 undici | ALPN 实测 | 结果 |
|---|---|---|---|
| 内置 `fetch`（Node 22 自带） | 6.24.1 | `http/1.1` | h1 |
| 本插件（`argv` 解析到 harness 那份） | 8.11.2 | `h2` | **h2** |

undici 8 把 `allowH2` 的默认值从 `false` 翻成了 `true`
（`lib/core/connect.js`: `allowH2 = allowH2 != null ? allowH2 : true`，
`lib/dispatcher/client.js`: “enabled by default”）。我们用 undici 8 建 Agent，
于是 LLM 出口从 h1 变成了 h2 —— 这不是本插件想要的，却实实在在换了传输层。

代价：`opencode.ai` 前面是 Cloudflare，h2 上的 SSE 长流会被边缘掐：

```
请求失败 CONNECTION（2275ms）…/chat/completions :: ERR_HTTP2_STREAM_ERROR / Stream closed with error code NGHTTP2_ENHANCE_YOUR_CALM
```

- 2026-10-15 当天：插件记了 **85 次失败，其中 79 次是 nghttp2 流错误**（93%），
  全部落在 `/chat/completions`（长流），`/models`（短请求）一次都没有；
- 首次出现 `ERR_HTTP2` 是 **2026-10-14T07:00**，即代理被关掉、插件开始全量接管直连之后；
  重试日志里 `TRANSPORT` 从 ~10/天 → **201/天**（10-14），`TIMEOUT` 则从 238/天 → 4/天
  （**插件治超时的效果是真的**，只是换了个失败形态）。

修法：`allowH2: false`（已进 DEFAULTS）。关掉之后复用一点没少：

| 4 连发（读完 body） | 新建连接数 | 耗时 |
|---|---|---|
| `allowH2: false` | 1 | 924ms → 383 → 363 → 374ms |
| `allowH2: true` | 1 | 947ms → 340 → 350 → 349ms |

即 h1 + `keepAliveTimeout` 的复用与 h2 等价，「不重握手」的目标照旧达成，
而 Cloudflare 那套 h2 流控彻底不参与。

2026-10-15 03:31 热更后（`?v=5`，`family=4` + `allowH2:false`）现场复验：
**75 秒内 22 个请求（全是 `/chat/completions`）20 成功 0 失败，`ERR_HTTP2` 0 次** ——
同一台机器、同一分钟里，改之前是 85 次失败/天、其中 93% 是这个 h2 流错误。

## 直连失败的另一半：20 个地址里的 10 个是死的（2026-10-15 实测）

`opencode.ai` 的 DNS 一次回 **10 个 IPv4 + 10 个 IPv6**，本机 **IPv6 无出口**
（`curl -6` 秒失败）。地址族探测（happy eyeballs）会把预算烧在这 10 个死地址上：

| 同一分钟内的对照 | 结果 |
|---|---|
| 裸 TCP 连 10 个 IPv4 | 全部成功，245–1332ms |
| `curl`（双栈）/ `curl -4` | 8/8、5/5 成功，connect 0.27–0.46s |
| **内置 fetch**（undici 6） | **2/6 成功**，4 次 `UND_ERR_CONNECT_TIMEOUT`，~2511ms |
| **插件 Agent，family=0** | **6/6 成功**，中位 352ms |
| 插件 Agent，family=4 | 6/6 成功，中位 379ms |

所以「插件生效了吗」的答案是：**生效，而且比内置通道明显强**；
但 `connectTimeoutMs: 30000` 救不了这种形态 —— 整轮在 ~1.0s / ~2.5s 就死掉，
是地址族探测把整轮判死，不是 10s 的 connect 预算不够。`family: 4` 能把这半边也堵上。

WSL 里直连脆弱、本机代理（`127.0.0.1:10808`）实测 3/3 HTTP 200（~0.9s）——
代理开着时插件按设计让路，也就不会被 h2 那套流控碰到。

## 状态/排障

```bash
# 读状态（在机器上直接 curl；Host 白名单只放行回环/本机网卡）
curl -s http://127.0.0.1:3080/_dsh/undici-timeout | python3 -m json.tool

# 手动补一枪探针
curl -s -X POST http://127.0.0.1:3080/_dsh/undici-timeout \
  -H 'x-dsh-undici-timeout: 1' -H 'content-type: application/json' \
  -d '{"action":"probeNow"}'
```

- `stats.matched/ok/failed/byError`：接管了多少请求、失败怎么归类；
- `stats.delegatedProxy`：因代理 env 让路了多少（联动在工作就正常）；
- `stats.lastRequests`：最近 10 条（host/path/ms/status/error）；
- `lastProbe`：最近一次探针（启动探针也会写日志）。
- 日志：`~/.dsh/logs/dsh-undici-timeout/host.log`。

冒烟（不经过 DSH，验证解析与网络）：

`

plugins.description: DSH 技能中心：查看、开关、新建、按链接安装、删除（进回收站可恢复）DSH 技能。
plugins.readme_text:
# @suifengshiqu/skill-center

**English** · [简体中文](README.zh.md)

**Skill Center** adds one page to the DSH Web client where you can see every skill DSH can load from your own directories, read one, switch it on or off, create one, install one from a link, and delete one into a trash you can restore from.

It is a third-party DSH plugin, not an official DeepSeek product. Licensed under the [MIT License](LICENSE).

![The Skill Center panel, open over the composer](docs/shots/list.png)

## Screenshots

| | |
| --- | --- |
| ![The skill list](docs/shots/list.png) | ![Creating a skill](docs/shots/create.png) |
| **The list** — every skill DSH can load, with its switch, its provenance and its problems. The row above it is where a link goes. | **Creating one** — name, description and body, written into whichever destination is selected. |
| ![The trash](docs/shots/trash.png) | ![The delete confirmation](docs/shots/confirm.png) |
| **The trash** — what was deleted, where it came from, and one button to put it back. | **Deleting** — the confirmation says plainly that the skill goes to the trash, because a reversible delete is a different promise from an erase. |

The screenshots are rendered from the shipped browser bundle over the Host's own
`Modal` stylesheet, so the layout, colours and scrollbar are the ones the application
produces; only the surrounding application window is left out. `scripts/dev/render-shots.mjs`
regenerates them, in either theme.

## Where it appears

Two entry points, both opening the same page over one shared store:

- **Settings → Skill Center** — the settings section, so it sits with the rest of the configuration.
- **A `Skills` button in the composer**, in the input row beside the permission chip. It opens the page in a modal, which is the quick path for switching a skill on or off mid-task.

The composer button lives in `conversation.input.left`. That is the only composer seat a plugin may extend: the permission chip (`conversation.input.permission`) and the model picker (`conversation.input.model`) are `single` seats their own plugins already hold, so nothing can be inserted between them. The button also cannot deep-link to its settings section — `openSection` is internal to the settings shell — so it opens the page directly instead.

Both entries follow the Host's theme:

![The same panel in the light theme](docs/shots/list-light.png)

## What it does

- **Lists** the skills under `$DSH_HOME/skills` (default `~/.dsh/skills`), any directory the profile adds through `customSkillDirs`, and the current project's `<project>/.dsh/skills`.
- **Shows details** for one skill: description, path, frontmatter block and instruction body.
- **Searches** by name or description, and can hide the switched-off skills.
- **Switches a skill on or off** without losing it: everything else about the file, including your own frontmatter keys, is left alone.
- **Creates a skill** from a name, a description and a body.
- **Installs a skill from a link** — a GitHub repository, a `/tree/` path inside one, a `.zip`, or a single `SKILL.md`.
- **Deletes a skill into a trash**, and restores it from there.
- **Writes new skills where you choose** — the destination control offers every directory the profile makes available, and the host accepts nothing else.
- **Reports problems** the host would silently skip, such as a missing `description` or a name that is not kebab-case.
- Follows the Host's light or dark theme.

### Where new skills are written

The destinations come from the Host, not from the panel: `GET /roots` answers with the
profile's configured `customSkillDirs` followed by the default `$DSH_HOME/skills`. The
browser offers exactly that list, and `POST /create` and `POST /install` refuse a
directory outside it — so "choose where to write" does not become "write anywhere". With
one destination the control is a sentence; with several, each is a button, because the
path is the point.

### Where deletion is allowed to reach

Removing something the user wrote is the one destructive thing here, so it is bounded:

- **Only DSH's own skills.** The trash covers the global roots (the DSH home and any `customSkillDirs`). A project root — `<project>/.dsh/skills`, which is under version control — is never touched: Skill Center may switch such a skill on or off, but it will not move it out of a repository.
- **Only skills DSH can actually load.** A skill with broken frontmatter may have been misread, which is a reason to leave it alone rather than to move it.
- **Never through a link.** A symbolic link, or a Windows junction (which `lstat` reports as an ordinary directory), is refused by comparing the resolved path with the requested one.
- **Never a plain erase.** The bundle is moved into `~/.dsh/skill-center/trash` with a record of where it came from, and the panel can put it back byte-for-byte. Emptying the trash is a separate, confirmed action.
- **Never a half-move.** Everything is validated before anything moves, and a move that cannot be recorded is rolled back. Because `rename` cannot cross volumes, a failed move falls back to copy-then-remove — copy first, so a failure leaves the original in place.

### What installing a link will and will not do

The download is treated as hostile input: entry paths may not escape the target, a bundle must have a `SKILL.md` with a name DSH accepts and a description DSH requires, an existing name is refused rather than overwritten, and nothing is written until every one of those checks has passed. Private archives and Zip64 are refused. Links to this machine (`localhost`, `127.0.0.1`, `.local`) are not fetched, and a single download is capped at 8 MB and 800 entries.

### Which layouts are discovered

Matching the Host's own filesystem provider exactly, a skill is a directory bundle `<name>/SKILL.md` or a flat `<name>.md`, **at the top level of a skills root**. Nested `**/SKILL.md` is deliberately not discovered.

This matters when installing from a GitHub download: a repository ZIP extracts to one folder, and copying *that* folder into `~/.dsh/skills` leaves every bundle one level too deep, where neither DSH nor this panel will find it. Move the bundle folders themselves into the skills root.

## What it does not do

- No other agents' directories (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, …).
- No Git repositories, no skill marketplace, no automatic updates.
- No creating or importing skills.
- No Trash.
- Nothing outside the two roots above is ever read or written.

## How switching a skill off works

Skill Center writes the two flags the DSH filesystem provider already understands into the skill's own frontmatter:

```yaml
---
name: my-skill
description: What it is for.
disable-model-invocation: true
user-invocable: false
---
```

Switching the skill back on removes exactly those two keys, restoring the document byte-for-byte. Because the flags live in the file:

- the state survives restarts and is visible to any other tool;
- the skill disappears from the model catalogue and the `/` menu, but stays on disk;
- an interrupted write cannot leave a half-written document — the file is replaced atomically.

A skill whose frontmatter cannot be parsed is listed with a diagnosis and its switch is disabled, so Skill Center never rewrites a document it does not understand.

## Requirements

- DeepSeek Harness with the Web client (tested against `0.2.0-rc.2`).
- Node.js `^22.19.0 || >=24.0.0`.

## Install

From npm, which needs nothing on the machine but DSH:

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile <your-profile> add @suifengshiqu/skill-center
```

From source, if you want to change it:

```powershell
git clone https://github.com/a766513648-lgtm/dsh-skill-center.git
cd dsh-skill-center
npm install
npm run verify                   # type check, build, tests
dsh plugin --profile <your-profile> add .
```

Or from a tarball you built yourself:

```powershell
npm pack
dsh plugin --profile <your-profile> add .\suifengshiqu-skill-center-0.1.0.tgz
```

Then **restart DSH** — the host half is loaded once at start-up, so a page refresh
alone is not enough — and open **Settings → Skill Center**.

> Installing this package by its git URL doe

plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-superpowers-verified

**A fork of [Superpowers](https://github.com/obra/superpowers) for the
[DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (DSH)** —
the full Superpowers methodology (brainstorming, planning, TDD, systematic
debugging, subagent-driven execution) adapted to run on DSH, installed
**verifiably and reversibly**.

Superpowers is an agentic software-development methodology by
[Jesse Vincent](https://blog.fsck.com) / [Prime Radiant](https://primeradiant.com);
this fork adapts it to DeepSeek Harness. It is not affiliated with or endorsed
by the Superpowers project, Prime Radiant, or DeepSeek.

[![tests](https://github.com/dkeviv/dsh-superpowers-verified/actions/workflows/tests.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/dkeviv/dsh-superpowers-verified/actions/workflows/tests.yml)

```
15 skills · DeepSeek Harness (DSH) · 86 tests · live-catalog verification · non-destructive install
```

**Keywords:** Superpowers fork for DeepSeek Harness · DSH skills ·
obra/superpowers port · DeepSeek coding agent skills · TDD · subagent-driven
development · agentic workflow for DSH · `superpowers-dsh` alternative ·
DeepSeek Harness 技能包 · 超级技能

## Install

```bash
git clone https://github.com/dkeviv/dsh-superpowers-verified.git
cd dsh-superpowers-verified
./bin/install.sh --dry-run     # see exactly what will change
./bin/install.sh
```

Then start a fresh DSH session and send `Let's make a react todo list`. A
working install invokes **brainstorming** and asks what you actually want
before writing any code.

**Uninstall reverses it exactly:**

```bash
./bin/install.sh --uninstall
```

## Why this fork exists

Superpowers' skills are mostly harness-neutral, but two things don't carry over
to DSH, and this fork supplies them:

**1. DSH has no session-start hook.** Upstream injects `using-superpowers` via a
`SessionStart` hook (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Gemini, Muse, Pi, …). DSH's
`dsh-hooks-*` packages *provide* hooks to other harnesses rather than consuming
them. DSH's equivalent channel is its user-global instruction file,
`$DSH_HOME/AGENTS.md`, loaded every turn of every session — so the bootstrap
goes there, inside self-managed markers.

**2. DSH has a different tool vocabulary.** Nothing here is named `Agent`,
`Task`, `TodoWrite`, or `Skill`. DSH provides `skill`, `todo_write`,
`subagent`/`subagent_fork`/`workflow`, native plan mode, and a file sandbox.
[`references/dsh-tools.md`](references/dsh-tools.md) is the translation layer.
Upstream's platform-adaptation list is rewritten to name DSH **only**: the
Claude Code reference file left in place describes nested-subagent depth tuning
and a `CLAUDE_CODE_MAX_SUBAGENT_SPAWN_DEPTH` variable that do not exist here.

**3. DSH skill names carry no namespace.** Upstream cross-references its own
skills as `superpowers:writing-plans`, but DSH rejects a colon in a skill name
outright, so those references are unresolvable as written. See
[Known limitations](#known-limitations) — this is the one upstream
incompatibility this fork documents rather than silently patches.

## What makes this fork different

There are several Superpowers ports for DSH. This one is built around two
properties rather than around features:

**Verification against the real catalog, not against prose.** `bin/verify.sh`
mounts DSH's own skill registry and filesystem provider and asks what actually
resolves — then checks it. Around that, `tests/run.sh` is 86 checks covering
snapshot integrity, fidelity against the vendored copy, idempotency, hostile
`AGENTS.md` inputs, migration paths, and uninstall, plus a GitHub Actions matrix
on Ubuntu and macOS. Most ports *assert* DSH compatibility; this one
demonstrates it, and fails loudly when it does not hold.

**An install that cannot damage your setup.** The suite runs entirely in a
throwaway prefix, so it never touches your real skill root or `AGENTS.md`. The
installer owns only the region between its markers, preserves your own
`AGENTS.md` content, appends rather than reorders, and uninstalls exactly what
it installed. Updating means `git pull && ./bin/install.sh` — idempotent, so
running it twice is safe.

**A pinned, auditable snapshot.** The skills are a vendored copy of upstream at
an exact commit ([`vendor/superpowers/README.md`](vendor/superpowers/README.md)),
so installs are offline, reproducible, and diffable against upstream. All
DSH-specific code lives outside `vendor/`.

| | This fork | Typical DSH port |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Install mechanism | Filesystem installer into DSH's native skill roots | Cordis plugin bundle via `dsh plugin add` |
| Compatibility evidence | 86-check suite + live-catalog verifier + 2-OS CI | Prose assertion |
| Install reversibility | Marked-block ownership, exact uninstall | Varies |
| Upstream skills | Pinned commit, vendored | Usually synced at build time |

The plugin-bundle approach is more idiomatic to DSH's internals; the
filesystem approach needs no plugin layer and keeps every change reviewable in
your own config. Pick whichever fits how you run DSH.

## What you get

All 15 Superpowers skills:

| Skill | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| `using-superpowers` | Entry point: how to find and use skills |
| `brainstorming` | Draw out intent before building |
| `writing-plans` | Break approved designs into bite-sized tasks |
| `executing-plans` | Inline plan execution, one review at the end |
| `subagent-driven-development` | Fresh subagent per task, reviewed |
| `dispatching-parallel-agents` | Fan independent work out in parallel |
| `systematic-debugging` | Root-cause discipline before fixes |
| `test-driven-development` | RED-GREEN-REFACTOR enforcement |
| `verification-before-completion` | Evidence before claims |
| `requesting-code-review` | Pre-merge review |
| `receiving-code-review` | Evaluate feedback on technical merit |
| `finishing-a-development-branch` | Integrate completed work safely |
| `using-git-worktrees` | Isolated workspaces |
| `writing-skills` | Author and test new skills |
| `diagnosing-superpowers` | Post-mortem a session from its transcript |

## Options

| Option | Effect |
| --- | --- |
| `--target <dir>` | Skill root (default `$DSH_AGENTS_HOME/skills` or `~/.agents/skills`) |
| `--dsh-home <dir>` | DSH home holding `AGENTS.md` (default `$DSH_HOME` or `~/.dsh`) |
| `--no-skills` / `--no-bootstrap` | Do just one half |
| `--dry-run` | Print intended changes, write nothing |
| `--uninstall` | Reverse the install |

## Verification

Two independent things, both re-runnable:

```bash
tests/run.sh          # 86 checks, offline, no writes outside a temp dir
bin/verify.sh         # audit a LIVE install against DSH's own skill catalog
```

`bin/verify.sh` is the interesting one. It does not read your files and guess —
it mounts DSH's real skill registry and filesystem provider in a bare Cordis
context (the same code the running harness uses), asks for the resolved
catalog, and checks the answers:

```bash
$ ./bin/verify.sh
Verifying Superpowers for DSH
  modules: /Users/you/.npm/_npx/…/node_modules
  skills:  /Users/you/.agents/skills
  AGENTS:  /Users/you/.dsh/AGENTS.md

  ✓ catalog resolves completely        22 skills
  ✓ every vendored skill resolves from --target   15/15 at …/.agents/skills
  ✓ no resolved skill name uses a namespace
  ✓ every installed skill has a loadable name
  ✓ no skill is shadowed by $DSH_HOME/skills
  ✓ DSH reference file installed
  ✓ adaptation list names DSH
  ✓ no other harness is advertised
  ✓ namespace workaround is documented
  ✓ bootstrap present in AGENTS.md     one balanced block
  ! upstream namespace references      46 references use superpowers:<name>; agents must strip the prefix

10 passed, 1 warnings, 0 failed
```

It exits non-zero when something is actually wrong, so it works in CI or a
pre-commit hook. It catches, among others: a skill that is installed but does
not resolve (including one silently skipped by DSH for an illegal name), a
skill shadowed by a higher-precedence root, a platform list that were reverted
to upstream, an unpaired bootstrap marker, and a missing reference file.

Options: `--target`, `--dsh-home`, `--modules <node_modules>`, `--json`. If it

plugins.description: Codex-style window-swap compaction engine: deterministic pointer-template summaries with zero LLM calls, replacing the default LLM-summary compaction.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-compaction-codex

Codex 式换窗压缩引擎——彻底替换官方 dsh-compaction-basic 的「LLM 摘要式压缩」。

## 机制

- 继承官方 `BasicCompactionEngine`，只覆写官方承诺的唯一子类钩子 `summarize()`；
- 摘要改为**纯确定性指针模板（零 LLM 调用）**：归档声明 + 恢复通道指引（history_search / history_read / notes read）+ 最近 model 检查点笔记全文（读 `~/.dsh/context-budget/notes/<sid>.jsonl`，只读）+ 被归档区首尾消息截断锚点；
- SummaryResult 走官方契约的模板分支（无 `llmStreamCall` 字段，官方注释点名 "template, remote, or other summarizer"），转录中 `compaction/summary` 事件显示 `provider: template, model: codex-rollover`；
- shadow 事务、replay 定价、工具配对平衡、并发锁、阈值自动触发（0.8×窗口，router-standard 为 0.55）、context-overflow 恢复、/compact（compactNow）全部原样继承。

## 装配

- 源码：`~/.dsh/plugins-src/dsh-compaction-codex/`（本目录），构建：`bash scripts/build.sh`（链接 dsh-install 类型依赖 + tsc 编译 src → lib）；
- profile 链：`~/.dsh/profiles/web/node_modules/dsh-compaction-codex` 软链 + `package.json` link 依赖（防 pnpm install 剪掉）；
- 预设：6 个用户预设（code / code-guarded / code-lean / dshagent / designharness / router-standard）compaction 组中 `compaction-basic` 条目已替换为 `compaction-codex`（2026-09-29，各文件留有 `.bak-20260929` 备份）；
- 生效范围：仅新会话（预设热扫描；运行中会话保持旧代装配）。

## 约束与边缘

- 官方 `summarizeCompaction` 要求摘要帧 token 数 < 被 shadow 内容 token 数；本模板上限约 5K 字符（约 1.5K tokens），对数千 tokens 以上的压缩区安全；极小压缩区会按官方逻辑抛错并留在日志（不会静默）；
- notes 文件缺失/损坏时自动降级（省略检查点段），不阻塞压缩事务；
- 回滚：预设 yml 中把 name 改回 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-compaction-basic`（或恢复 .bak）即回官方 LLM 摘要，热生效（新会话）。

## 决策记录

- 2026-09-29 用户拍板：方案 A（子类替换）+ 纯 Codex 式（永不 LLM 摘要，无混合开关）；
- 否决方案 B（从零实现抽象 CompactionEngine：需重写 shadow 持久化/锁/配对平衡，收益零风险高）与方案 C（拆压缩组：长会话必撞上下文硬上限）。

plugins.description: 余额水桶：水位就是你的 DeepSeek API 余额，出水口流出的是正在花的钱。A bucket that drains while your DeepSeek API balance is being spent (DeepSeek Harness plugin).
plugins.readme_text:
# Balance Bucket · 余额水桶

**A little bucket that drains while your DeepSeek API balance is being spent.**

![Six bucket states: full, pouring, low, refilled, unreadable, and dark theme](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/youchai2016/dsh-plugin-token-bucket/v0.1.1/docs/images/bucket-states.png)

一只挂在窗口角落的小水桶。**水是你的余额，漏出去的是正在花的钱。**

Version 0.1.1.

## What it does

- **The water level is your real balance.** It reads `GET https://api.deepseek.com/user/balance` with the same `DEEPSEEK_API_KEY` that DSH chats with, so the bucket shows the money you actually have.
- **The water is two layers, because the money is.** Granted balance (赠送) floats on top of topped-up balance (充值). DeepSeek deducts the granted wallet first, so you watch the pale layer empty before the deep one moves.
- **The tap opens while money moves.** The stream and its droplets are proportional to the burn rate over the last three minutes — the tool for watching a `vibe coding` session eat your credit.
- **The bucket is as tall as the highest balance it has ever seen.** It starts full, and a top-up makes it taller rather than overflowing.
- **A failed read never lies.** If the balance cannot be read, the water stays where it was, the tap shuts, and the outline turns amber. It never empties the bucket to show an error.

Move it, resize it, tuck it away — right-click for settings, drag to reposition, arrow keys to nudge.

## Reading the bucket

| Look | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| Pale layer on top | Granted balance (spent first) |
| Deep layer below | Topped-up balance |
| Blue water | Above 30% of the highest balance seen |
| Amber water | Between 10% and 30% |
| Red water, gentle wobble | Below 10% |
| Amber outline, no stream | The last read failed; the level is the last known one |
| Grey water, `—` | No API key configured, or the key was rejected |

Hover the bucket for the numbers, or open the settings panel for balance, granted/topped-up split, spent since start, added since start, burn rate, bucket size and the age of the last reading.

## Install

Package page: [dsh-plugin-token-bucket on npm](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-plugin-token-bucket).

```text
dsh-plugin-token-bucket
```

Or pin this release:

```text
github:youchai2016/dsh-plugin-token-bucket#v0.1.0
```

The plugin needs the credential DSH already manages for chat. If the Models page has a working DeepSeek API key, the bucket works; if not, it says so instead of guessing.

## Privacy and runtime boundaries

- The API key is resolved through DSH's credential service on every poll and is **never** stored, logged, echoed in an error, or sent to the client half. The browser half never talks to the balance service itself.
- **One** outbound request exists: a read-only `GET` on the documented balance endpoint. No model calls, no telemetry, no listening port, no third-party service.
- Nothing about your conversations is read. This plugin subscribes to **no** session events, so it cannot see prompts, replies or tool output.
- Preferences and history live in the browser's local storage. The plugin never writes your DSH profile.

## Honest limits

- The burn rate is **estimated from balance deltas**, not from token counts: the balance moves in whole cents (¥0.01), so the reading is a rolling three-minute average rather than a per-request figure. It is deliberately not a billing statement.
- Polling is adaptive: every 5 seconds for two minutes after money moves, then 20 seconds, then once a minute while nothing happens. Change calls from other devices or tools are also visible, because they move the same balance.
- Prices, bonuses and the split between granted and topped-up balance are whatever the API reports. The bucket does not compute costs from a price list.
- Balances are read for one currency, preferring CNY.

## Development

```sh
pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
pnpm run build
npm test
```

`preview/index.html` is a single offline file: open it in a browser, no server and no network needed. Its buttons fabricate balance samples, so every state can be inspected without an API key.

The Host half is bundled to `lib/index.js`, the strict browser/Host contract to `lib/remote.js`, and the browser half to `lib/client.js` by `pnpm run build`. Prebuilt files are committed so a Git install needs no build step.

## License

Code is [MIT](LICENSE). No third-party artwork is bundled: the bucket is drawn with CSS and one inline SVG.

plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness 插件：把输入框模型选择器改成按来源渠道分块 + 下钻选模型，保留搜索与推理强度
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-model-block-picker

[English](README.en.md) | 中文

DeepSeek Harness (DSH) 插件 —— **按模型来源分块**的输入框模型选择器。

把官方那个「所有模型拉成一条长列表」的选择器，换成**先按来源渠道分块、再下钻进块内选模型**的两级结构；搜索、推理强度（Reasoning Effort）、模型可用性等原有能力**完全保留**。

---

## 效果

点击输入框右下角的模型位，弹出的不再是长长的平铺列表，而是**按来源分块的卡片网格**：

![分块面板与搜索、推理强度、速度与输出详略](docs/screenshot-panel.png)

- **① 全局搜索** —— 直接在顶部输入 `v3` / `sonnet` / `r1`，跨全部来源聚合匹配；回车选中首项。
- **② 按来源分块** —— 每个渠道一张卡片，标出「N 个模型」与「进入 →」；卡片可拖动排序。
- **③「当前」标记** —— 正在使用的来源高亮描边 + 右上角蓝标。
- **④ 推理强度彩色滑条** —— 可拖动的 Low → Max 渐变滑条，点击刻度文字可直达。
- **⑤ 速度 / 输出详略** —— 当前模型支持时才出现，不支持则整行隐藏。

深色模式使用同一套主题 token，强调色为 `--dsw-alias-link`（`#7aaaff`），不再出现白底白字：

![深色模式下的分块面板](docs/screenshot-dark.png)

搜索框左侧的 ⚙ 打开**显示设置**，可按提供方整体开关，也可展开逐个开关模型：

![显示设置面板](docs/screenshot-settings.png)

触发按钮本身与同排的截图 / 麦克风图标保持同一设计语言（主题描边与文字）：

![输入框模型位与同排图标](docs/screenshot-composer.png)

---

## 功能

- **按来源分块**：DeepSeek 账号、DeepSeek API，以及 CodeBuddy / Qoder / TRAE 等第三方渠道，各自成为一张卡片；卡片上显示来源名、模型数量，当前所用来源带「当前」标记。
- **两级下钻**：点卡片 → 进入该渠道内只含它自己模型的列表；顶部 `← 所有来源` 或 `Esc` 返回。
- **全局搜索**：直接输入 `v3` / `sonnet` / `r1` 等关键词即可跨所有来源聚合匹配，回车选中首项；清空即回到分块视图。
- **推理强度（彩色滑条）**：当前模型支持 reasoning 时，浮层底部出现一条**可拖动的渐变色滑条**（Low → Max 分档，带发光 thumb），点击刻度文字也能直接跳档；右侧显示当前档位，`恢复模型默认` 一键回到提供方推荐值。
- **速度 / 输出详略自适应**：订阅类提供方（如 ChatGPT 订阅）的模型若支持 `speedMode` / `outputVerbosity`，浮层底部会**额外出现对应的分段控件**；不支持的模型或提供方这两项**自动隐藏**，不会出现死开关。
- **显示设置面板**：搜索框左侧的 ⚙ 按钮打开设置，可**按提供方整体开关**、也可**展开逐个开关单个模型**是否出现在选择器里；顶部显示已隐藏数量，底部可一键恢复全部。
- **提供方拖拽排序**：卡片可直接拖动调整先后顺序（拖动时卡片半透明、目标位显示描边），松手即保存。
- **偏好持久化**：顺序、隐藏来源、隐藏模型全部写入 `localStorage`（key `dsh-model-block-picker.prefs.v1`），刷新与重启后保持；不存在的来源会在下次自动清理。
- **主题自适应**：浅色、深色均用 DSH 主题 token，深色下强调色使用 `--dsw-alias-link`（`#7aaaff`）而非会反转成近白的 `--dsw-alias-brand-primary`。

## 安装

### 从本机目录安装（开发 / 自用）

在 DSH 会话里对 Agent 说：

> 帮我安装位于 `<本仓库路径>` 的插件

Agent 会执行 `plugin_manager(action: 'install_bundle', target: '<绝对路径>')`。

安装后**彻底退出 DSH 桌面端再重新打开**（客户端 bundle 有启动基线缓存，仅刷新页面不一定加载新代码）。

卸载：`plugin_manager(action: 'remove_bundle', target: 'dsh-model-block-picker')`，回退到官方原生选择器。

## 它是怎么工作的

### 1. 覆盖官方选择器（Slot 影射）

输入框模型位是 DSH 公开的一个**命名插槽**：`conversation.input.model`（`kind: "single"`，会话作用域）。

- 官方实现注册在优先级 `-10`；
- 动态安装的插件注册同名插槽时，系统分配**更低的数值即更高优先级**获胜；
- 本插件显式注册 `priority: -20`，因此作为 winner 覆盖原生组件，卸载即自动回退。

> 注意：`single` 槽位要求同优先级唯一，所以必须用负数优先级，否则会抛
> `single slot already has a registration`。

### 2. 复用官方数据服务（不重复造轮子）

不自己请求后端。通过 `ctx.modelDirectories`：

```js
const directory = models.directoryFor(sessionId);
directory.store   // 快照：{ groups: [{ id, name, models: [...] }], current: { provider, model, reasoningEffort } }
directory.load()  // 拉取目录
directory.select({ provider, model, reasoningEffort })  // 提交选择
```

与 `/model` 命令弹窗**共用同一份会话级目录**，任一入口的切换另一入口立即可见。

### 3. 深色外观的白，来自主题而不是硬编码

早期版本手写 `#1c1f23` 之类的兜底色，在深色下不会反转，导致字和箭头变深灰。现在全部改用真实 token：

| 用途 | token | 深色取值 |
|---|---|---|
| 主文本 | `--dsw-alias-label-primary` | `#f9fafb`（off-white，非纯白） |
| 边框 | `--dsw-alias-border-l1` | `#ffffff0f` |
| 背景 | `--dsw-alias-bg-layer-1/2`、`--dsw-alias-bg-overlay` | — |
| 品牌色 | `--dsw-alias-brand-primary` | — |

深色下额外用 `body[data-ds-dark-theme]` 把触发按钮设为 `.5px` 描边 + 该 token，与右侧截图插件
（`color: var(--dsw-alias-label-primary)` + `fill:none stroke=currentColor stroke-width=1`）
保持同一笔画重量。

> **踩坑记录**：写 CSS 时**别凭印象编变量名**。DSH 里**不存在**
> `--dsw-alias-text-regular`、`--dsw-alias-border-subtle`、`--dsw-alias-surface-overlay`、
> `--dsw-alias-primary` 这些名字——它们会静默回落到你写的兜底值，浅色看着没事、深色就崩。
> 可用 `cordis_inspect_query(platform: 'client', provider: 'Theme', method: 'listTokens')` 查真实 token。

## 文件结构

```
dsh-model-block-picker/
├── package.json          # 清单：dsh.bundle.patch + dsh.client 声明
├── cordis.patch.yml      # Loader patch：把本包插进 profile 名单
├── index.js              # 宿主半边（挂 /diag 诊断路由）
├── client.js             # 浏览器半边：React 组件 + 样式 + 插槽注册
├── .github/workflows/
│   └── publish.yml       # 推 main 即发布 npm + 打 tag + 建 Release
├── scripts/
│   └── release-notes.mjs # 从 CHANGELOG 抽取当前版本的 Release 正文
├── CHANGELOG.md
├── LICENSE
└── README.md
```

## 诊断

排障时会用到：

- 宿主侧日志前缀 `[dsh-model-block-picker]`（DSH 日志里搜这个）。
- 浏览器端各生命周期节点会打到 `/plugins/dsh-model-block-picker/diag`：
  `module-evaluated` → `apply-called` → `slot-inject-triggered` → `registered-success`。
  若停在 `register-error`，说明槽位/优先级冲突；停在 `apply-error` 多半是 `inject` 未声明就访问了服务。

> **另一个坑**：客户端沙箱对服务访问有白名单。顶层 `inject` 声明了 `['slots','modelDirectories']`，
> 就**不能**再直接读 `ctx.sessions`，否则抛 `service "sessions" is not declared` 并当场崩溃。

## 已知限制

- 只替换输入框（composer）的模型位；`/model` 命令弹窗仍是官方样式（两者共用同一份数据，切换互通）。
- 已寻址的 subagent 会话不提供模型选择（沿用官方约定）。
- 来源分组顺序：默认 DeepSeek 账号 → DeepSeek 官方 → 其余按名称排；**可直接在面板里拖动卡片自定义顺序**，保存于 `localStorage`。
- 速度 / 输出详略依赖提供方暴露能力：目前只有实现了 `speedMode` / `outputVerbosity` 偏好的提供方（如 `dsh-codex-subscription` 的 `openai-codex`）会被识别；其他提供方这两项不显示。
- 偏好保存在浏览器 `localStorage`，因此**按浏览器 profile 隔离**，不随 DSH 账号同步。

## 发布流程

发版只有一步：**push 到 `main`**。

```bash
# 1. 改代码
# 2. 改 package.json 的 version
# 3. 在 CHANGELOG.md 加一个 ## [x.y.z] 段落
git push                     # ← 只有这一步会触发发布
```

`publish.yml` 随后依次完成：校验版本号 → 确认 npm 上还没有这个版本 → `npm publish`（带 provenance）→ 打 `vX.Y.Z` tag → 用 CHANGELOG 对应段落建 GitHub Release。

### 只有第一次需要手动配置

npm 那边要认这个仓库，得先建一次「信任关系」（之后永久有效）。

**前置条件：npm 账号必须已开启 2FA。** 未开启时 registry 直接拒绝可信发布器的读写（`403 Please enable 2fa for your account`），而且这个报错只在你尝试配置时出现，不会提前提示。2FA 用安全密钥（passkey / Windows Hello）或验证器 App 都行，等级选 `auth-and-writes`。

**方式一：命令行**

```bash
npm trust github dsh-model-block-picker \
  --file publish.yml \
  --repo liu19666/dsh-model-block-picker \
  --allow-publish
```

这是账号级写操作，会要求一次性口令：终端会打印一个 `https://www.npmjs.com/auth/cli/<id>` 链接（npm 11.19 起把链接里的 id 打码成了 `***`，看不到就改用下面的网页方式），在浏览器里用你的 2FA 完成验证即可。

**方式二：网页**

1. 打开 <https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-model-block-picker/settings>，找到 **Trusted Publisher**。
2. 选 **GitHub Actions**，填三项（区分大小写，仓库和文件名都不能带路径）：

   | 字段 | 值 |
   | --- | --- |
   | Organization or user | `liu19666` |
   | Repository | `dsh-model-block-picker` |
   | Workflow filename | `publish.yml` |

3. **Allowed actions 里勾上直接发布。** 2026-09-03 起新建的可信发布器默认只允许 `npm stage publish`（把包丢进待审队列，需要人手动 2FA 批准）。本仓库要的是无人值守直接发布，必须额外勾选 `npm publish`。漏了这一步，工作流会以 `403` 失败，而 npm 保存配置时**不会**校验这些字段，错误只会在发布那一刻才出现。
4. Environment name 留空——工作流没有声明 `environment`，填了反而对不上。

### 它不会踩的几个坑

- **不写死版本号。** 版本号的唯一来源是 `package.json`；`CHANGELOG` 段落只决定 Release 正文，漏写不会导致失败（会退回 GitHub 自动生成的 notes）。
- **幂等。** 每个 job 都先检查自己的产物是否已存在：版本已在 npm 上就跳过发布，tag 已存在就跳过 Release。所以重跑失败的任务、或者忘了改版本号又推一次，都不会重复发布，也不会有「版本号被占了但 tag 没打」这种半成品状态。
- **不需要任何 secret。** 认证走 GitHub OIDC：npm 验证的是「这个仓库、这个分支、这个工作流文件」签出的短期令牌，没有 `NPM_TOKEN` 可泄露，也无法从别人机器上重放。
- **发布前不做任何不可逆的事。** npm 版本号一旦发布就永久占用，所以版本格式、npm 是否已有该版本这些检查全在 `preflight` job 里跑完，`publish` 才会启动。
- **预发布版本不会顶掉 `latest`。** `1.2.0-beta.1` 会以 `beta` 这个 dist-tag 发布，Release 也标成 prerelease —— 否则 `npm install dsh-model-block-picker` 会给陌生人装上一个 beta。
- **`.npmrc` 里不留凭据。** `actions/setup-node` 一旦带 `registry-url`，就会往 `.npmrc` 写 `//registry.npmjs.org/:_authToken=${NODE_AUTH_TOKEN}`；可信发布场景下这个变量是故意不设的，展开成空串后 npm 会误以为「凭据已配置」，直接跳过 OIDC 交换并报 `ENEEDAUTH`（[npm/documentation#1960](https://github.com/npm/documentation/issues/1960)）。本工作流因此**不传** `registry-url`（npm 本来就默认官方源），并在发布前断言 `.npmrc` 里没有 `_authToken`，让失败指向真正的原因。

### 只想发一次 npm、不想建 Release

手动跑一次 `workflow_dispatch` 也行；或者反过来，用 `gh release create` 手工发版——工作流只认 `package.json` 的版本号，不关心是谁推的。

## 许可

MIT

plugins.description: DSH chat zoom plugin / DeepSeek Harness 聊天缩放插件
plugins.readme_text: # DSH Chat Zoom · 缩放 **中文** | [English](#english) DeepSeek Harness（DSH）聊天区域缩放插件。仅缩放聊天消息和输入区，不改变侧栏、设置页或全局弹窗。 - 插件名称：**缩放** - 软件包 / 仓库名称：`dsh-plugin-chat-zoom` - 首个 GitHub 发布版本：**v0.1.0** - 许可证：[MIT](LICENSE) [下载 v0.1.0](https://github.com/YangShen-SWE/dsh-plugin-chat-zoom/releases/tag/v0.1.0) · [报告问题](https://github.com/YangShen-SWE/dsh-plugin-chat-zoom/issues) 补充文档：[更新说明](CHANGELOG.md) · [脱敏验收记录](VALIDATION.md) · [隐私说明](PRIVACY.md) · [贡献与维护](CONTRIBUTING.md) · [市场投稿与合并注意事项](MARKET.md)。这些文档后补于 main；既有 v0.1.0 安装包与 tag 保持不变。市场 PR #7323 已合并；界面展示仍取决于后续采集，安装包仍为 v0.1.0。 **当前 main 开发版本：v0.3.2（尚未发布安装包）**。已接入自定义放大/缩小/复位键盘组合与独立滚轮修饰键（Ctrl/Alt/Shift/Meta）、原生设置、恢复默认与本地配置；默认仍为 Ctrl。下方下载和市场条目仍安装 v0.1.0，不包含本周开发更新；新能力当前仅在 main 源码中。 ## 简介与示例图（已发布 v0.1.0） **仅缩放 DSH 聊天消息和输入区（80%–200%），支持 Ctrl 快捷键、设置调节与本地记忆，不缩放侧栏。** 下图是用 **v0.1.0 原客户端**在合成示例页面中运行后截取的浏览器隔离演示，**不是 DSH 实机截图，也不证明宿主兼容性**。示例文字、侧栏和输入区均为合成内容，不包含用户会话；未展示 main 中尚未发布的自定义快捷键界面。市场图片由根目录 [screenshots.json](screenshots.json) 声明，需市场合并及采集后才可能显示，不保证立即出现。 **放大演示**：消息、代码、图示与输入区放大，示例侧栏及顶部尺寸不变。 ![150% 局部缩放隔离演示，非 DSH 实机截图](assets/chat-zoom-demo-150.png) **默认倍率对照**：使用同一演示布局，便于比较作用范围。 ![100% 默认倍率隔离演示，非 DSH 实机截图](assets/chat-zoom-demo-100.png) 图片依据原 v0.1.0 安装包（SHA-256：`908b0eca7bf91b4528a125f29b05a0590901ee29ad3fcb98f7afddb381510222`），使用 Chrome 155 无头浏览器、固定视口及示例输入事件生成；原客户端代码未修改。它们只展示已发布版本的局部缩放行为，不替代真实 DSH 验收。 ## 功能 - 文字、代码、图片和输入控件一起进行布局缩放。 - 默认 **100%**，范围 **80%–200%**；快捷键和放大 / 缩小按钮每次调整 **10 个百分点**。 - 在设置页选择倍率、放大、缩小、恢复默认或清除倍率记忆。 - 操作后显示倍率提示，最后一次操作 **5 秒**后自动隐藏；聊天区没有常驻缩放工具栏。 - 同一页面的聊天面板共用倍率；按浏览器的网站来源保存偏好，刷新后可恢复。 - 尽量保留当前阅读位置，不强制跳到聊天顶部或底部。 ## 运行要求 这是 **DSH 插件**，不是 Chrome / Edge 扩展，也不是可独立运行的网站。 需要提供客户端模块加载器、React 共享模块和 `settings.section` 插槽的 DSH，以及支持 CSS `zoom` 的浏览器。适配依据为 **DSH 0.2.0-rc.2** 的内部聊天 DOM 属性；不保证其他宿主版本兼容。`v0.1.0` 是本插件的版本，不是 DSH 的版本。 发布包已包含可运行的客户端文件，**无需自行构建或安装独立 React**。插件界面目前使用中文；本文档提供中英双语说明。 ## 安装 ### 方法一：在 DSH 插件页安装（推荐） 1. 在 [v0.1.0 发布页](https://github.com/YangShen-SWE/dsh-plugin-chat-zoom/releases/tag/v0.1.0) 下载 **`dsh-plugin-chat-zoom-0.1.0.tgz`**。不要把 GitHub 自动生成的源码 ZIP 当作插件安装包。 2. 打开 DSH 侧边栏的 **插件** 页面，进入安装外部插件 / 组合包的入口。 3. 将下载文件的**完整绝对路径**作为安装来源，例如：`C:/Downloads/dsh-plugin-chat-zoom-0.1.0.tgz`。这里的路径只是示例，请换成实际下载位置。该路径必须能被运行 DSH 的电脑访问；远程浏览器本地的文件不一定对 DSH 主机可见。 4. 确认安装，并检查 `dsh-plugin-chat-zoom` 已启用。若入口支持 HTTP(S) 压缩包来源，也可直接填写下方下载地址。 5. 刷新 DSH 页面，再打开 **设置 → 缩放**。如果仍不出现，请完整退出并重启 DSH，而不是只关闭网页。 安装包直链： ```text https://github.com/YangShen-SWE/dsh-plugin-chat-zoom/releases/download/v0.1.0/dsh-plugin-chat-zoom-0.1.0.tgz ``` ### 方法二：使用 DSH CLI 如果已配置 `dsh` 命令，桌面版可运行： ```sh dsh plugin --profile desktop add "dsh-plugin-chat-zoom@https://github.com/YangShen-SWE/dsh-plugin-chat-zoom/releases/download/v0.1.0/dsh-plugin-chat-zoom-0.1.0.tgz" --ignore-scripts ``` 离线安装已下载的文件，例如在 Windows 上： ```sh dsh plugin --profile desktop add "dsh-plugin-chat-zoom@file:C:/Downloads/dsh-plugin-chat-zoom-0.1.0.tgz" --offline --ignore-scripts ``` 请把文件路径和 `desktop` 替换为实际下载位置与当前 profile（配置档案）。不确定 profile 或没有 `dsh` 命令时，使用插件页安装。**这些命令由用户执行，本仓库不会自动修改 DSH 配置。** 插件自身没有安装脚本。 ### 方法三：安装仓库目录 也可下载并解压 GitHub 源码，或克隆仓库，然后在 DSH 插件页将**包含 `package.json` 的目录绝对路径**作为安装来源。不要直接选择 `lib` 子目录。 ## 使用 ### 设置页 进入 **设置 → 缩放**： 以下设置说明对应当前 main，历史变更见[更新说明](CHANGELOG.md)；v0.1.0 安装包没有自定义键盘/滚轮分区。顶部标出“仅缩放聊天消息与输入区”，并显示当前倍率和范围。“选择倍率、缩小、放大”与“恢复 100%、清除倍率记忆”分组，下方另有真实可用的键盘表单和独立滚轮选择。均保留原生控件、换行与焦点样式；真实 DSH 窄屏布局和键盘操作尚未实机验收。 | 控件 | 作用 | | --- | --- | | 聊天倍率 | 选择 80%–200% 的倍率 | | 缩小 / 放大 | 每次调整 10 个百分点 | | 恢复 100% | 恢复默认倍率，并保存该值 | | 清除倍率记忆 | 恢复 100%，删除本插件保存的倍率记录 | | 保存快捷键 | 校验三个输入；有效时应用并尝试保存，未保存草稿不生效 | | 恢复默认快捷键 | 丢弃键盘草稿并恢复默认，仅删除键盘记录，不改倍率或滚轮 | | 滚轮修饰键 | 选择一个修饰键，立即应用并尝试保存 | | 恢复默认滚轮 | 恢复 Ctrl，仅删除滚轮记录，不改倍率、键盘或键盘草稿 | 倍率修改立即生效；自定义键盘输入需点击“保存快捷键”才生效。清除倍率记忆不会删除聊天、输入草稿、键盘/滚轮配置或其他设置；滚轮选择立即生效，无需“保存快捷键”。 当前 main 的设置底部显示初始倍率、操作完成或保存失败的状态。“恢复 100%”会保存 100%，即使当前已经是 100%；“清除倍率记忆”会恢复 100% 并删除记录，之后调整倍率或再次恢复会重新保存。无法保存/删除时会明确提示，而不声称记录已清除。存储键与格式不变。 设置使用原生键盘操作：`Tab` / `Shift+Tab` 移动焦点，方向键选择倍率，`Enter` 或空格激活按钮；不依赖聊天缩放快捷键。main 的“恢复默认快捷键”只重置三个键盘绑定，不改变倍率。恢复/清除按钮关联同一段区别说明，底部状态使用礼貌播报。已完成模拟树与事件检查，真实 Tab 顺序、选择框在各浏览器的交互和屏幕阅读器效果仍需实机验收。 ### 快捷键（下表为默认绑定） 当前 main 的 **设置 → 缩放 → 键盘快捷键** 提供放大、缩小、复位三个输入框。输入组合后点击“保存快捷键”，例如分别设为 `Alt+J`、`Alt+K`、`F9`；只有保存后的绑定生效，新的键盘绑定替换而非叠加旧默认。滚轮独立配置，见下节；修改键盘不会改变滚轮。 - 使用单次组合，以 `+` 连接 `Ctrl` / `Alt` / `Shift` / `Meta` 与主键。主键支持 `Plus`（`+` / `=`）、`Minus`（`-`）、数字、A–Z 和 F2/F8/F9，但须通过下面的安全限制。`Control`、`Option`、`Cmd` / `Command` 分别是 Ctrl、Alt、Meta 的别名，修饰键顺序和字母大小写会归一化。 - 无修饰键或仅 Shift 时只允许 F2/F8/F9；字母仅允许含 Alt 且不含 Ctrl/Meta，保守拒绝 Alt+B/D/E/F/H/T 等菜单组合。Ctrl/Meta+数字 1–9、普通文字/编辑键、F1/F3/F4/F5/F11/F12、常见保留键、连续序列和重复绑定不可用。Ctrl/Meta+0 和符号键可用。Plus/Minus 忽略 Shift 差异，不能借此配置重叠动作；从 main v0.3.1 起，物理 Minus 键带 Shift 产生 `_` 时也匹配 Minus，其他键位的下划线不接管。其他修饰键必须准确匹配。示例不是跨系统无冲突保证。 - “恢复默认快捷键”丢弃输入草稿、恢复默认并删除仅此键盘配置，倍率不变；“清除倍率记忆”不清除快捷键。格式无效时不覆盖已有绑定；本地保存/删除失败时会说明仅本页生效，刷新可能恢复此前记录。不会接管 IME、AltGraph 或全局快捷键；被 OS/宿主先截获时改用其他绑定或倍率控件，插件不会重写宿主保留键。 ### 自定义滚轮（仅当前 main，未发布） 在 **设置 → 缩放 → 滚轮缩放** 选择一个修饰键：`Ctrl`（默认）、`Alt`、`Shift` 或 `Meta`（Windows 键 / macOS Command）。选择立即生效并尝试保存；鼠标位于聊天消息或输入区时，只按所选一个键滚轮向上放大、向下缩小。普通无修饰滚轮和叠加其他修饰键的滚轮不接管；相比旧默认规则，本版不再接管 Ctrl+Shift 滚轮。仍保持 90ms 同向节流、反向立即响应和 80%–200% 边界。 “恢复默认滚轮”恢复 Ctrl 并仅删除滚轮配置，不改倍率、键盘或未保存的键盘草稿；存储失败会提示本页有效、刷新可能回退。Shift 会占用该区域的横向滚动手势；Alt/Meta 可能被 OS/宿主先处理。插件不改写宿主保留操作，冲突时换键或用倍率控件。IME、AltGraph、弹窗与内嵌工具继续避让。触控板捏合报告为 Ctrl 滚轮时仍无法可靠区分；未选 Ctrl 时插件不接管此类事件，但浏览器可能自行处理。 **下表是当前 main 的默认绑定与作用范围，不是 v0.1.0 的完整行为说明。** v0.1.0 没有自定义配置；其焦点判定较宽，消息内普通按钮/链接聚焦也可能响应键盘缩放，且 Ctrl+Shift 滚轮也可缩放。main 的收窄规则没有回写到旧包。 | 操作 | 效果 | 使用位置 | | --- | --- | --- | | `Ctrl` + 滚轮向上 / 向下 | 放大 / 缩小 | 鼠标位于聊天消息或输入区 | | `Ctrl` + `+` / `-` | 放大 / 缩小 | 输入区有焦点；或没有其他控件焦点且鼠标悬停聊天区 | | `Ctrl` + `0` | 恢复 100% | 与上述键盘快捷键相同 | 加号支持 `Ctrl` + `=`、`Ctrl` + `Shift` + `=`；也支持小键盘加减号。普通滚轮与 `Ctrl+C/V/Z` 等编辑快捷键不会被接管。 从 main 的 v0.1.1 起，“输入区有焦点”仅指输入区内的多行文本框、文本输入框或可编辑文字区域。消息按钮、链接、发送按钮、文件选择、复选框、选择框等获得焦点时，不接管这些键盘缩放操作，即使鼠标仍在聊天区。无控件焦点时，必须仍悬停聊天区才响应。滚轮与设置控件的规则不变；插件不接管不代表浏览器或宿主也会忽略按键。 ## 隐私与卸载 插件自身不发送网络请求、不上传聊天、不收集遥测，不写服务端设置。v0.1.0 只保存倍率键 `dsh-plugin-chat-zoom:v1:percent`；当前 main 另保存 `dsh-plugin-chat-zoom:v1:keyboard`（版本号与三个绑定字符串）和 `dsh-plugin-chat-zoom:v1:wheel`（JSON：`{"version":1,"modifier":"Ctrl"}`，modifier 为所选单个修饰键），均位于当前浏览器来源的 localStorage。缺失/无效/未来键盘或滚轮配置使用默认，不迁走旧倍率或自动覆盖异常记录；不保存按键/滚轮事件日志，不跨设备/实时跨标签同步，也不按会话保存。 如需移除记录，main 中先点击 **设置 → 缩放 → 恢复默认快捷键** 和 **恢复默认滚轮**（分别只清除自己的配置），再点击 **清除倍率记忆**，检查状态无失败后再到插件页禁用或卸载；v0.1.0 只需清除倍率记忆。正常停用会移除插件自有监听器、倍率标记、提示和样式；可能需要刷新或重启。默认停用保留现存倍率、键盘和滚轮记录，**不要为了清理倍率而清空整个 localStorage**。 安装包的下载和 DSH 插件管理器自身可能使用网络；上面的隐私说明仅描述本插件运行时。 ## 已知限制与排查 - **设置中看不到“缩放”**：确认插件已安装并启用，刷新页面，必要时完整退出并重启 DSH。 - **所有网页元素一起放大**：可能是浏览器或桌面宿主先截获了快捷键。先用设置中的倍率控件；插件不能保证拦截宿主已处理的按键。 - **输入法或内嵌工具中不响应**：中文输入法组合输入、全局模态弹窗、聊天内嵌编辑器、终端和画布优先，插件有意避免抢占这些操作。 - **触控板捏合也触发缩放**：部分浏览器会将捏合报告为 `Ctrl` 滚轮，插件无法可靠区分。 - **升级 DSH 后不响应**：插件依赖宿主内部 DOM 属性，不匹配时不会对整个页面强制缩放；可能需要更新适配。 - **保存倍率失败**：浏览器可能限制本地存储，本次缩放仍可生效，但无法保证刷新后恢复。 当前开发检查涵盖模拟 DOM/虚拟 React、文档契约、JavaScript 语法、包内引用和模块注册；不代表已完成 DSH 实机、物理操作或真实输入法验证。浏览器支持 CSS zoom 不等于识别到了宿主聊天 DOM，设置可显示但区域不匹配时仍可能无效果；不会回退全页缩放。 ## 仓库内容与重新打包 本仓库包含插件文件、文档及无依赖的轻量回归测试，不包含私人聊天、缓存、安装配置备份或迁移工具。`lib/client.js` 为完整、可读的预构建客户端实现；本仓库未提供原始拆分源码和构建工具。 在 Node.js 24 上运行 `node --test tests/*.test.mjs`，执行 75 项模拟 DOM/虚拟 React/配置回归及 5 项文档契约检查，共 80 项通过。文档检查直接对照客户端默认值、存储 JSON、版本和相对链接；不验证真实 DSH。测试不随安装包分发，D5/D6 的实际证据与实机未测项见[脱敏验收记录](VALIDATION.md)。维护分区注释不是磁盘上的 src 文件；直接维护可读客户端，不运行不存在的生成器，见[贡献说明](CONTRIBUTING.md)。 | 文件 | 用途 | | --- | --- | | `package.json` | 包版本、入口与 DSH 元数据 | | `index.js` | 宿主入口；功能在浏览器客户端运行 | | `cordis.patch.yml` | DSH 插件注册配置 | | `lib/client.js` | 完整客户端逻辑与设置界面 | | `README.md` | 中英双语使用说明 | | `LICENSE` | MIT 许可证 | 维护者可在仓库根目录使用 Node.js / npm 重新打包： ```sh npm pack --ignore-scripts ``` 生成的 `.tgz` 安装包不提交到源码仓库，而是上传到 GitHub Releases。发布包包含本文档和许可证，不包含 Git 元数据。 --- ## English **DSH Chat Zoom** changes the size of chat messages and the input area in **DeepSeek Harness (DSH)**. It does not zoom the sidebar, settings pages, or global dialogs. - Display name: **缩放** (Zoom) - Package / repository: `dsh-plugin-chat-zoom` - First GitHub release: **v0.1.0** - License: [MIT](LICENSE) [Download v0.1.0](https://github.com/YangShen-SWE/dsh-plugin-chat-zoom/releases/tag/v0.1.0) · [Report an issue](https://github.com/YangShen-SWE/

plugins.readme_text:
# HAR Triage

Offline network evidence for DeepSeek Harness. Find failed and slow browser requests without handing the agent your URLs, cookies or response bodies.

浏览器网络排障插件：读取本地 HAR，生成可回查原始请求索引的离线诊断报告。默认不把网址、请求头、Cookie、参数值或正文带进报告和 AI 工具结果。

![Synthetic HAR diagnosis: signals, source indexes and timing evidence](docs/report-demo.jpg)

The screenshot uses the bundled synthetic scenario, not real browser traffic.

## What it does

- Reads an existing HAR 1.2 capture; never records traffic, sends requests, or changes the capture.
- Groups requests into endpoint aliases, highlights HTTP 4xx/5xx, unavailable responses, slow requests and long waiting phases.
- Produces a self-contained HTML report: signals → request row → measured timing phases. Filters, pagination and source locators work offline.
- Returns at most 20 evidence entries to the agent, with a count of omitted evidence. The full numeric projection stays in the local JSON/HTML files.

Request #43 corresponds to `log.entries[42]` in your original HAR. Endpoint aliases deliberately do not reveal names. Keep the original capture private and use its index to look up the actual request locally.

## Install in Harness

Node 22.19+ is required. Install the prebuilt bundle into your chosen profile:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile YOUR_PROFILE add https://github.com/po-et/dsh-har-triage/releases/download/v0.1.0/dsh-har-triage-0.1.0.tgz
dsh --profile YOUR_PROFILE --dump-config
```

The configuration should contain the `har-triage` row. Start that profile, put your HAR inside its session workspace, and ask:

> Inspect capture.har with har_triage. Save reports in a new har-review directory. Explain the measured evidence and cite the original HAR entry indexes. Do not guess root causes.

Tool arguments:

```json
{"input":"capture.har","outputDir":"har-review","slowMs":2000}
```

The tool uses Harness filesystem and sandbox services. It requires write permission to create the reports and refuses input/output paths outside the session workspace. Existing report files are never overwritten. Uninstall with `dsh plugin --profile YOUR_PROFILE remove dsh-har-triage`.

## Try without Harness

The CLI and analysis/report modules use Node built-ins only. From a source checkout:

```sh
node src/cli.js capture.har --out new-report-directory --slow-ms 2000
```

Open `new-report-directory/report.html`. The output directory must not exist. The original capture is unchanged.

For a reproducible synthetic example:

```sh
npm run demo
```

This creates a new directory under `artifacts/` with a deliberately synthetic capture and its report. It is not evidence of real browser traffic or real users.

## Evidence, not root-cause claims

`503` means the capture records a server-error response. `status: 0` means it did not record a valid HTTP response. Neither identifies a failing service, proves CORS, or proves an expired token. A high wait/TTFB share is an observation, not proof that the backend or database is slow.

Start offsets include submillisecond differences and are expressed in relative milliseconds. Absolute source timestamps are never included in the report.

Unknown phase timings and byte sizes remain `-1`, displayed as “Unknown.” TLS is part of the HAR connection timing and is not added a second time. Contradictory phase durations are flagged; the report hides misleading proportions.

Ollama's [`application/x-ndjson` streaming responses](https://docs.ollama.com/api/streaming) are classified as JSON. This is a MIME-based content category, not validation of the response body; model output remains excluded from reports.

## What is retained and removed

Retained: source entry index, sequential endpoint alias, controlled method/status/content classes, relative offsets, numeric durations/sizes, and fixed diagnostic codes. Aliases group the same method/origin/path within one capture; query strings and fragments do not affect grouping.

HTTP method identity is case-sensitive: `GET` and `get` receive separate aliases. Only the allowlisted uppercase methods receive named display values; all other method tokens appear as `OTHER`. Private method tokens are used only for grouping and are not included in reports, tool evidence or report ID hashes.

Removed: complete URLs including origins and paths, query values, headers, cookies, request/response bodies, page titles, initiator data, IP addresses, absolute timestamps, extension fields, raw error text, and the original file digest. The report ID hashes only the retained projection. Arbitrary source strings are not copied to reports or tool evidence.

This is a minimal diagnostic projection, **not** a scrubbed HAR, an anonymization guarantee, or a replacement for reviewing an artifact before sharing it. Status patterns, sizes, timing, request counts and grouping can still identify an application. See [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md).

## Limits

- HAR JSON only: version `1.2`, UTF-8, at most 16 MiB and 10,000 entries. Invalid supported entries fail with fixed errors rather than silently truncating the evidence.
- HTTP and HTTPS requests are analyzed. Other protocols are excluded and counted. Missing timing/size values are retained as unknown; a valid request URL, start timestamp, duration, status and response content object are required.
- Synchronous bounded analysis: cancellation is checked before parsing and between entries, not an interruptible worker. The slow threshold defaults to 2,000 ms and is configurable per call.
- Reports are created exclusively. If HTML creation fails after JSON creation, the JSON is retained and the tool reports the partial result; retry using a fresh destination.
- No upload, traffic replay, header inspection, body analysis, automatic source lookup, or edits to the original HAR.

## Development and validation

```sh
npm ci --ignore-scripts
npm test
npm run smoke:host
npm pack --dry-run
```

48 tests passed on Node 24 and 26. They cover actual CLI subprocesses, controlled output and failure text, input limits, phases, original-file preservation, and real Cordis tool dispatch/filesystem/sandbox/Loader integration. `smoke:host` is a real service composition, not a CLI profile boot or a live-LLM test.

The packed bundle was separately installed through the actual CLI into fresh temporary Profiles on Harness `0.2.0-rc.2` and `0.2.1-alpha.2`, then booted with `runProfile` and exercised through `har_triage`. Source bytes were unchanged; output omitted the synthetic canary; overwrite and workspace-escape attempts were refused. HMR was disabled only in those temporary Profiles. The alpha host emitted three unrelated Typert activation warnings; rc.2 did not. No LLM or real credentials were used.

Browser checks covered status filtering, signal-to-request navigation, correct source locators, no console errors, and a 390-pixel layout without page-level overflow. The demo and regression captures are synthetic; real-user usefulness is not yet validated.

## Related tools

[net-debug](https://github.com/JohnXu22786/net-debug) is an existing Harness HTTP client with history, replay and HAR export. [harlite](https://github.com/brucehart/harlite) already offers extensive HAR analysis, SQL, waterfall and HTML reporting. This plugin does not replace those tools: its narrower purpose is a Harness-native, no-external-binary, allowlisted evidence path for agent-assisted debugging.

MIT licensed.
