plugins.description: Live2D 桌宠挂件 for DeepSeek Harness Web: 可拖动吸附/滚轮缩放/待机呼吸眨眼, 单击显示 DeepSeek 余额
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-live2d-pet

DSH（DeepSeek Harness）界面右下角的 **Live2D 桌面宠物**：用游戏《冷たい目をした黒瀬さん》里提取的
Live2D 模型（kouzhaomei，含 2 张图集），做成可拖拽挂件，点击显示 DeepSeek 账户余额。

## 安装

```bash
# 从 GitHub 装（插件市场收录后同名一条）
dsh plugin --profile web add github:qqmqq/dsh-live2d-pet
# 本地开发用链接
dsh plugin --profile web add "link:C:\Users\bai\projects\dsh-live2d-pet"
# 装完必须重启 dsh web 才会加载（插件在宿主启动时挂载）
```

卸载：`dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-live2d-pet`

## 用法

- 出现在右下角（默认 300×380，用**游戏相机取景**裁切，等于游戏里的构图）
- **拖动**移动；松手自动**吸附到最近的左右边缘**；位置/大小/透明度写盘，重启后保持
- **滚轮**缩放（0.5×–2.0×）
- **单击**查看余额（读 `/dsh-live2d-pet/balance.json`；余额来自 `https://api.deepseek.com/user/balance`，
  key 从 DSH 凭据的 `DEEPSEEK_API_KEY` 或同名环境变量取）
- 悬停右上角 **⚙** 菜单：余额 / 大小 ± / 透明度 / 归位 / 隐藏
- 隐藏后右下角留一个 **🐾** 浮标可以叫回来
- 待机动画：呼吸（`ParamBreath`）、眨眼（`ParamEyeLOpen/ROpen`）、轻微摆头（`ParamAngleX/Z`）—— 全部是模型自带参数
- 每 3 分钟自动刷一次余额；接口失败时显示最近一次成功值并标「旧数据」

## 结构

```
package.json          dsh.bundle.patch 声明
cordis.patch.yml      挂载声明(insert id/name)
lib/index.js          宿主插件: 11 条路由 + tapIndex 注入 + 余额缓存/重试/回退
assets/widget.js      页面挂件(原生 JS, 无构建, IIFE 幂等)
assets/lib/           pixi.min.js / live2d.js(Core) / live2dcubismcore.js(框架) / live2d-display.min.js
assets/model/         kouzhaomei.moc3 (4.12 MB) + model3.json + texture_00/01.png
tools/smoke.mjs       独立冒烟测试(假 ctx 起本地 http, 逐条验证路由)
```

## 自测

```bash
node tools/smoke.mjs
# 期望: 11 条路由全 200; state.json PUT/GET 往返一致; tapIndex 注入幂等
```

## 模型来源

从游戏 `Kurose-san_Data\sharedassets*.assets` 的 `CubismMoc` MonoBehaviour 里按字节数组长度切出，
贴图对应关系用运行时 `CubismRenderer.MainTexture` 验证；取景矩形来自运行时相机参数
（canvas 3520×5706 / 可见 2770×3520）。详见 `L2D_Extract/README.txt`。

plugins.description: Makes small text in a screenshot readable before a model reads it: crop a region, magnify it with a chosen kernel, hand back a new image. DeepSeek Harness (dsh) plugin + standalone CLI.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-crop-zoom

**Magnify a region of an image so small text becomes readable.**

A [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai) (`dsh`) plugin that registers a
`crop_zoom` tool, plus the same engine as a standalone CLI.
[中文说明 →](README.zh-CN.md)

- Local image processing only — no network, no model call, no OCR engine.
- One dependency: `sharp` (libvips), loaded lazily so a missing native build can never stop the harness from booting.
- Node ≥ 22. MIT.

---

## The problem this solves

A 1920×1080 screenshot does not reach a model at 1920×1080. It is downscaled on the way
in, so a 10–11px item label arrives with its strokes already fused — and re-reading the
same screenshot cannot bring those pixels back.

Four readings off one status screen, every one of them wrong in the same way:

| Printed | Came back as | Why |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `03重型盔` | `D3重型盔` | at 11px the `0` and the `D` share one left stem |
| `BT6重型` | `B16重型` | the `T` welds itself onto the `B` before it |
| `1000戰地包` | `100D戰地包` | four digits merge into three plus a letter |
| `鎏影權鋒` | `盜影權杖` | the 金 under 鎏 collapses into something 皿-shaped |

Those characters are perfectly legible once the region is cropped out and upscaled.
Doing that *before* the text is read is the only reliable order of operations, and it
costs far less than pushing the whole screenshot through again.

## Install as a dsh plugin

```bash
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add dsh-crop-zoom     # from a registry
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add ./dsh-crop-zoom   # from a local checkout
```

Then restart the app. The model gains a `crop_zoom` tool, re-sent with every request.

## Install as a CLI

```bash
npm install -g dsh-crop-zoom
crop-zoom -i shot.png -r 1178,588,64,24 -s 16 -o label.png
```

## Using the tool

```jsonc
// One region, auto-magnified until its long edge reaches 1600px
{ "path": "C:\\shots\\raid.png", "regions": [{ "x": 1178, "y": 588, "width": 64, "height": 24 }] }

// Two regions, stacked into a single labelled sheet so one follow-up read covers both
{ "path": "C:\\shots\\raid.png",
  "regions": [{ "x": 80, "y": 430, "width": 540, "height": 300, "label": "rank board" },
              { "x": 875, "y": 155, "width": 450, "height": 660, "label": "gear" }],
  "target": 2400 }

// Still ambiguous? nearest replicates pixels, which separates equal-width glyphs
{ "path": "C:\\shots\\raid.png", "regions": [{ "x": 1444, "y": 373, "width": 96, "height": 42 }],
  "scale": 16, "mode": "nearest" }
```

The tool writes PNG file(s) and returns their paths; read the result with `read_image`.
The text it returns is geometry only — deliberately, so it cannot be mistaken for the
answer:

```
1 file written from C:\shots\raid.png (1920x1080), kernel bicubic.

#1  source 1178,588 64x24  x12  -> 768x288
#2  source 1444,373 96x42  x12  -> 1152x504

Sheet (regions stacked top to bottom, in the order above): C:\...\raid-20261014181815.png

Now read that file with read_image. Do not answer from this geometry summary alone.
```

### Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `path` | string | — | Absolute path to the source image. Required. |
| `regions` | array | — | 1–8 regions, in sheet order. Required. Each is `{x, y, width, height, label?}` in **source** pixels. |
| `scale` | integer | — | Integer magnification, 1–16. Omit to derive it from `target`. |
| `target` | integer | `1600` | With no `scale`, magnify until the region's longer edge reaches this many pixels, capped at 16×. |
| `mode` | enum | `bicubic` | `bicubic` \| `nearest` \| `lanczos` \| `mitchell`. |
| `sheet` | boolean | `true` | Stack every region into one labelled PNG. `false` writes one file per region. |
| `outPath` | string | temp dir | Where to write; must end in `.png`. |
| `previewWidth` | integer | — | Set this when the coordinates were measured on a downscaled preview: pass that preview's pixel width and every coordinate is rescaled to the source automatically. |

`bicubic` preserves glyph outlines and is the right default. `nearest` replicates whole
pixels, which is what separates a `0` from a `D` — the two are complements, so when a
character still will not resolve, look at it both ways.

### CLI

```
crop-zoom -i <image> -r <x,y,w,h> [-r <x,y,w,h> ...] [options]

  -i, --image <path>        Source image (PNG, JPEG, WebP, AVIF, TIFF or GIF)
  -r, --region <x,y,w,h>    Region to magnify; repeat up to 8 times
  -s, --scale <n>           Integer magnification, 1..16
  -t, --target <px>         Auto-magnification target (default 1600)
  -m, --mode <kernel>       bicubic (default) | nearest | lanczos | mitchell
  -o, --out <file.png>      Output path, or path stem when writing one per region
      --preview-width <px>  Coordinates came from a preview of this pixel width
      --no-sheet            One file per region instead of one stacked sheet
      --json                Also print the raw result object
  -h, --help                Show this message
```

## How it works

1. Decode the source once into memory. Regions are bounded against the *display* size
   (after EXIF rotation), so an upright photo is cropped where it looks upright.
2. `extract` each region, then `resize` by an integer factor with the selected kernel —
   integer scaling avoids resampling artefacts on exactly the strokes you are trying to read.
3. Optionally composite the pieces into one sheet, captioned with the geometry of each
   region, so a multi-region check costs one follow-up read rather than several.

## Limits

- **Local files only.** Remote URLs are not fetched; that keeps the tool from becoming an
  outbound request channel on the model's behalf.
- Output is always PNG.
- 8 regions and 16× per call.
- Sheet captions are ASCII; non-Latin caption text depends on the fonts fontconfig
  exposes to librsvg, so put non-ASCII descriptions in the region `label` rather than
  expecting them on the image.

## Development

```bash
npm install
npm test        # core geometry suite + plugin contract suite
```

`test/run.mjs` builds its own synthetic image and asserts exact output geometry.
`test/plugin.mjs` exercises `apply()` against a stub `ctx` and checks that a throwing
registry cannot escape.

## License

MIT

# DSH Side Chat

独立 DSH 插件，在原生右侧栏打开临时侧聊，复用原生聊天布局。适配 DSH Core `0.2.0-rc.1` 的 Desktop 与 Web 插件接口。

- 输入 `/side`，或点击会话标题栏的“打开侧聊”按钮。
- 输入 `/side 问题`，打开侧聊并直接提问。
- 侧聊使用原生聊天界面，支持流式回复、连续提问、附件、停止、模型和权限设置。
- 打开时聊天区为空。主会话历史只作为后台参考上下文；侧聊界面只显示打开后提交的新问题和回复。
- 主会话继续运行；侧聊独立处理新问题，不自动继续主任务、目标或历史中的工具调用。以打开时已记录的上下文为基底，每次侧聊模型调用都会补入主会话后续消息、工具结果及当前可见流式输出，作为后台参考，不显示到侧聊记录中。
- 同一主会话再次执行 `/side` 会打开已有侧聊。侧聊中不能再创建侧聊。
- 临时侧聊不出现在普通会话列表。关闭标签或收起右侧栏都会停止并清理侧聊；再次打开会创建新的空侧聊。清理尚未结束时，重新打开会等待清理完成。
- 页面离开、App 退出或插件停用会结束侧聊。若进程被强制终止，下一次启用时只清理该版本标记的临时侧聊缓存。
- 遗留临时侧聊若因日志损坏或文件锁定而无法清理，会保留原文件并在日志中记录警告；不阻止插件启用，也不会恢复到新侧聊中。无效的临时标记同样保留，其他有效临时侧聊继续清理。

按 Codex `/side` 的临时会话语义设计：后台继承上下文，可见记录独立，结束时丢弃。底层使用 DSH 原生分支及临时磁盘缓存，关闭时通过原生会话删除接口清理；不保留可恢复归档。继承的目标只在侧聊分支清除，主会话的目标不变。模型和权限沿用 DSH 的原生分支行为。0.1.0 已保存的分支没有新版本的临时标记，升级会保留这些旧记录。

## 安装

在 Desktop 的插件管理中添加 `github:yhfgyyf/dsh-side-chat#v0.1.3`，安装并启用。安装后完整退出并重新打开 App，使 Host 和 Client 都加载插件。

网页版安装到 Web profile：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add 'github:yhfgyyf/dsh-side-chat#v0.1.3'
```

然后重启 Web 进程并刷新页面。也可从 [GitHub Releases](https://github.com/yhfgyyf/dsh-side-chat/releases/tag/v0.1.3) 下载 `dsh-side-chat-0.1.3.tgz`：Desktop 使用插件管理中的本地绝对路径，Web 使用 `dsh plugin --profile web add /绝对路径/dsh-side-chat-0.1.3.tgz`。

已验证 DSH Desktop `0.1.39` / Core `0.2.0-rc.1` 的 Desktop 与原生 Web。DSH 仍处于快速迭代阶段，其他 Core 版本尚未验证。

## 开发

使用 Node.js 22.12+ 或 24：

```sh
git clone https://github.com/yhfgyyf/dsh-side-chat.git
cd dsh-side-chat
npm ci
npm test
npm run build
```

源码在 `src/`，构建输出在 `dist/package/`。仓库包含构建产物，从 GitHub 安装无需在用户 profile 编译 Client。插件通过 `dsh.bundle.patch` 加载 Host，通过 `dsh.client` 与 `./client` 导出加载浏览器模块，React 由 DSH 原生模块表提供。结构参考 [官方 UI 插件说明](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/blob/master/packages/preset/agent-preset/skills/cordis-plugin-development/references/ui-plugin.md)。

`npm run test:app` 和 `npm run test:web` 是原生集成检查，需要相邻的 `../dsh-desktop` App 源码目录，且其中已安装 Electron、构建 App 并准备 `.runtime`。检查使用隔离 profile 和本地模拟模型，不访问真实模型服务。`npm run check` 执行全部检查，覆盖空白开启、后台上下文、连续提问、关闭清理、重新创建、页面离开时清理和主会话继续运行。Web 检查启动原生 `dsh --profile web` 网页前端，不注入 Desktop 桥接。

打包可运行 `npm pack ./dist/package --pack-destination /绝对路径/输出目录`。Vite 仅用于开发构建；发行插件没有生产依赖，不包含 App 运行时或其他用户插件。Apache-2.0 许可见 [LICENSE](LICENSE)。

plugins.description: See what ate your prompt cache. Hit-rate & tool-block cost report for DSH (DeepSeek Harness) — zero deps, registers no tools.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-cache-report

[![CI](https://github.com/youran0faust/dsh-cache-report/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/youran0faust/dsh-cache-report/actions/workflows/ci.yml) ![node](https://img.shields.io/badge/node-%3E%3D22.15-brightgreen)

> **命中率从 96% 掉到 80%，是谁吃的？**

DSH（DeepSeek Harness）提示缓存命中率与工具块成本报表。一条命令告诉你：今天的 token 花在哪、哪次操作最贵、哪个插件在占位。

> 中文 | [English](README.en.md) · MIT · 零运行时依赖

## 它回答什么问题

大模型的输入分「命中缓存」和「未命中」两种价钱（DeepSeek 官方约 **1 : 10**）。缓存按**前缀**精确匹配，而请求的排布是：

```
[工具定义]   ← 一变，后面全部作废
[系统提示]
[历史消息…]  ← 缓存主要靠这里
[本轮新内容] ← 只有这里应该按未命中计费
```

于是：**在长会话中途装一个插件、启停一个组件、切一次权限档，工具定义就变了——此后整段上下文（系统提示 + 全部历史）会按全价重算一遍。**

多数人只看到命中率掉了，却不知道是谁吃的。这个工具就是回答这个的。

## 安装

前置：DSH（`@deepseek-ai/dsh`）+ Node.js ≥ 20。

### 方式 A：作为 DSH 插件（推荐）

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add github:youran0faust/dsh-cache-report#main
```

重启 DSH（或依赖 profile 的 `patchReload: live` 热加载），然后在会话输入框打：

```
/cache-report
```

**它只注册斜杠命令、不注册任何工具**——因此**不改变工具表、不会破坏你自己的缓存**。常驻零成本。

### 方式 B：独立脚本（不需要插件机制）

```bash
git clone https://github.com/youran0faust/dsh-cache-report.git
node dsh-cache-report/lib/report.mjs today
```

零运行时依赖，只用 Node 内置模块（`node:fs` / `node:path` / `node:zlib` / `node:os`）。

## 命令

| 输入 | 作用 |
|---|---|
| `/cache-report` | 不带参数 = `today`：今天的命中率 + 大额重算归因 |
| `/cache-report days 7` | 近 7 天趋势表 |
| `/cache-report tools 30` | 工具块成本 / 按插件拆分 / 从未被调用的死重 |
| `/cache-report before-after 24` | 近 24 小时：工具表变化时间线 + 重算代价 + 真实台账花费 |
| `/cache-report debug 7` | 格式自检：DSH 会话格式是否仍符合预期 |
| `/cache-report help` | 用法 |

独立脚本用法相同：`node lib/report.mjs days 7`。

## 示例输出

> 以下数字为**示意**，用于展示输出形状。

```
$ /cache-report days 7

# 近 7 天缓存趋势（扫描 96 个会话文件）

日期          请求    命中率      未命中tok       命中tok   大额重算   归因Top
2026-10-09     412    95.8%       1,204,331    27,461,882       12   compaction 41%
2026-10-10     688    96.1%       1,988,204    48,932,110       19   compaction 52%
2026-10-11     903    95.4%       2,741,558    56,880,231       27   compaction 47%
2026-10-12     744    94.9%       2,105,772    39,204,118       22   compaction 55%
2026-10-13     611    92.3%       3,388,901    40,612,447       38   compaction 58%
2026-10-14     402    79.5%       6,120,338    23,742,905       61   compaction 74%
2026-10-15     288    73.6%       4,884,120    13,618,442       44   toolset-change 48%
```

拐点出现在 10-14，而且**归因换了人**：从 `compaction`（历史压缩）变成 `toolset-change`（工具表变化）——那正是当天连装了几个插件的日子。

```
$ /cache-report tools

来源               工具数      tok    占比   其中从未调用
  agent-teams           14    4,508   24.9%   ~4,407 tok
  host-core             21    4,308   23.8%   ~224 tok
  dsh-mnemon            17    3,579   19.8%   ~1,315 tok
  dsh-ops                5    2,056   11.4%   ~378 tok
  dsh-undo-savepoint    15    1,936   10.7%   ~1,557 tok
  shell/job              4    1,151    6.4%   -
  modsearch              4      520    2.9%   ~190 tok

## 从未被调用（共 37 个 / ~8,071 tok）
  ~  790 tok  agent_teams_create_task          agent-teams
  ~  752 tok  agent_teams_update_task          agent-teams
  ...
```

## 怎么读：命中率是**比率陷阱**

**命中率 = 命中 / (命中 + 未命中)**。但**别只盯比率**——它会被上下文长度稀释或放大：

| | 命中率 | 每次请求 token | 实际花销 |
|---|---|---|---|
| 长会话 | 96% | 190k | 高 |
| 短会话 | 80% | 148k | **更低** |

比率掉了，账单可能反而降了。**真正该看的是「未命中 token 的绝对值」**，那才是按全价计费的部分。

工具把「单请求未命中 ≥ 5 万 token」（阈值 `DSH_REPORT_BIG` 可调）的事件称为**大额重算**，并按原因归类：

| 归因 | 含义 | 你能控制吗 |
|---|---|---|
| `toolset-change` | 装/卸插件、启停组件、切权限档 | ✅ **能** —— 攒着一起改，改完开新会话 |
| `compaction` | 历史压缩（长会话的必然代价） | ⚠️ 半能 —— 会话别拖太长 |
| `session-start` | 新会话冷启动 | ⛔ 正常开销 |
| `resume` | 恢复旧会话 | ⛔ 正常开销 |

### 三条实用规则

1. **插件攒着一起装，装完开新会话。** 中途装一个，当前会话的历史就得全价重算一遍。
2. **别在长会话里切模型 / 切权限档。** 同理，都在改前缀。
3. **看未命中 token 的绝对值，不看百分比。**

## 数据来源与隐私

读的是本机 DSH 会话日志：`$DSH_HOME/sessions/` 下的 `session.v*.jsonl.zstd`（多帧 zstd，脚本按魔数切帧逐帧解）。

只用其中的**用量数字**与**工具表**：

- `assistant/message` → `usage.inputTokens`（未命中）/ `usage.cacheReadTokens`（命中）
- `request/header` → 当时的工具定义列表 + `reason`（`initial` / `series` / `resume` / `change`）

**不会打印任何对话内容、文件内容或密钥**；`tools` 只输出工具**名字**。所有计算在本机完成，**不联网、不上传**。

## 局限（诚实说明）

- **token 数是估算**：工具表按 `ASCII字符/4 + 非ASCII字符/1.5` 估算，误差约 ±10%。
- **归因是启发式的**：按「大额重算之前最近的一个原因事件」判定，压缩与工具表变化挨得近时可能归错。
- **只覆盖能观测到的**：读的是 DSH 落盘的会话日志，未落盘或被清理的会话不计入。
- **zstd 依赖 Node ≥ 22.15**（`node:zlib` 的 zstd API）。更低的 Node 会报错。

## 卸载

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-cache-report
```

独立脚本直接删目录即可。它不写任何配置、不常驻进程、不留状态。

## 开发

```bash
node lib/report.mjs help        # 自检
node lib/report.mjs days 2      # 快速冒烟
```

## License

MIT

# dsh-stock-leek **npm 包名 [`@shiqyka/dsh-stock-leek`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@shiqyka/dsh-stock-leek) · 把大盘指数、自选股与持仓盈亏，直接嵌进 DSH 对话界面。** 对话左下角常驻指数栏 + 可拖动行情悬浮窗：实时行情 · 分时 / K 线 · 持仓盈亏， 不用离开 DSH，也不用再开一个行情软件。 [![version](https://img.shields.io/github/package-json/v/siqyka/dsh-stock-leek)](https://github.com/siqyka/dsh-stock-leek) [![license](https://img.shields.io/github/license/siqyka/dsh-stock-leek)](./LICENSE) ![node](https://img.shields.io/badge/node-%3E%3D%2020-brightgreen) ![dsh](https://img.shields.io/badge/DSH-%3E%3D%200.2.0--rc.1-blue) ![data](https://img.shields.io/badge/%E6%95%B0%E6%8D%AE%E6%BA%90-%E8%85%BE%E8%AE%AF%E8%B4%A2%E7%BB%8F-f5455c)
--- [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) Web 端的股票行情插件： - **对话左下角常驻大盘指数栏**（上证 / 深证 / 创业板 / 恒生 / 纳斯达克…，自选要显示哪几个） - **可拖动行情悬浮窗**：大盘 · 自选 · 持仓 · 设置 四页 + 个股分时 / K 线详情 - **自选股**：搜索（代码 / 名称 / 拼音首字母）添加，A 股 · 北交所 · 港股 · 美股 · ETF · 指数全覆盖 - **持仓股**：填成本价 + 股数，并可逐笔记录**买卖变动**（买入 / 卖出，支持当日多次），实时算市值 / 累计盈亏 / **今日盈亏（按当日变动现金流计算）** / 总盈亏汇总 数据源为腾讯财经公开行情接口（`qt.gtimg.cn` / `web.ifzq.gtimg.cn` / `smartbox`），红涨绿跌。 ## 安装 ```bash # 本地目录（把 换成你自己 clone 的位置） dsh plugin --profile desktop add file:/dsh-stock-leek # 或发布后按包名（npm scoped 包，DSH 插件管理器自动识别） dsh plugin add @shiqyka/dsh-stock-leek ``` 安装后**刷新页面**生效。对话输入框下方出现指数栏，点任意指数胶囊打开悬浮窗，点 `⚙` 直达设置。 ## 功能 | 位置 | 能力 | |---|---| | 对话左下角 | 大盘指数胶囊：简称 + 点位 + 涨跌幅，价格变动红/绿闪烁；盘中状态点；点胶囊开悬浮窗、`⚙` 直达设置。有持仓时显示 **💰收益** 胶囊（今日盈亏），**鼠标悬停弹出浮层**：市值 / 累计收益（额+率）/ 今日收益（额+当日涨幅%）+ 每只持仓的**今日盈亏与当日涨幅**（累计、成本、市值等明细在行悬浮提示）。**非交易时段自动收起**——收盘后指数和收益都只是昨天的数字，只留「状态点 + ⚙ 设置」（点状态点可进大盘页）；**每天 9:00–15:06 自动展开**，其余时间只留「状态点 + ⚙ 设置」；**点 ● 可手动收起/展开**（展开→收起、收起→展开），手动选择持续到下一个交易日自动失效；**午休不收起**（按整个交易日跨度判断，不会 11:30–13:00 凭空消失）。样式（点位+涨跌 / 仅涨跌）、对齐（左/中/右）、显隐均可配。**指数栏关掉后的兜底入口**：侧栏「插件 → @shiqyka/dsh-stock-leek」页里有一张带边框的「指数栏」配置卡片（走宿主的 plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness Web UI in Traditional Chinese (Taiwan) - converts the whole rendered interface, including third-party plugin copy, at the DOM layer.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-zh-tw-ui

[繁體中文](README.zh-TW.md) | **English**

Renders the **entire DeepSeek Harness (DSH) Web UI in Traditional Chinese
(Taiwan)** — DSH's own copy, **third-party plugin copy**, and text that later DSH
versions add — by converting the DOM, not by shipping a language pack.

```
Settings -> General -> Language: 中文 (Simplified)   <- the app's own locale
What you actually see:           繁體中文（台灣）     <- converted on screen
```

Because it works at the render layer, it does not have the failure mode that
dictionary-based language packs have: *uncovered copy falls back to Simplified
Chinese and the UI looks half-translated.*

---

## The problem

DSH ships exactly two locales: `zh` (Simplified) and `en`. Using DSH in Taiwan
breaks in three places at once:

1. **DSH's own UI** is Simplified without a language pack;
2. **third-party plugins** (market, sidebar, IM bridges, Agent Teams, …) each ship
   their own Simplified dictionaries, which no language pack can reach;
3. **every DSH release adds copy**, so a language pack's dictionary is always one
   version behind.

This plugin attacks the shared root cause: whatever produced the text, it is
converted on screen.

## Goals / non-goals

**Goals**

| | |
|---|---|
| G1 | The whole page in Traditional Chinese: DSH itself, third-party plugins, and dynamic content that appears later |
| G2 | **Decoupled from the DSH version** — a DSH upgrade must not break it |
| G3 | **Touches no DSH internals**: no dictionary registration, no `LocaleRuntime` patching, no `@deepseek-ai/*` peer range — so DSH's compatibility gate can never skip it, and it coexists with other locale plugins |
| G4 | A clear safety boundary: code, editors and anything you type are **never** altered |
| G5 | Reversible, auditable, tunable (a runtime switch, an override table, a skip marker) |

**Non-goals**

- **Not a language pack**: no new entry in DSH's Language list, no change to DSH's
  locale setting.
- **No translation beyond Simplified → Traditional**: English is left alone, no
  model calls.
- **Does not change stored data** — see [Limitations](#limitations).
- **Web/desktop clients only**: no DOM in TUI or headless profiles.
- **Does not convert text painted into a canvas, or cross-origin iframes.**

---

## Why not just use another Traditional Chinese plugin?

This is the reason the project exists, so here is the honest version. All figures
were checked on **2026-10-13** from each package's npm manifest or repo README.

| Option | Mechanism | Covers third-party plugins | Relationship with DSH 0.2.0-rc.2 |
|---|---|---|---|
| `@huanlin/dsh-plugin-better-locale` 0.4.3 | registers dictionaries (39 namespaces) | no | peer says `^0.1.5-rc.2` (excludes 0.2.x) → needs a manual exact-version exemption to load |
| `@mimateinn/dsh-i18n` 0.2.6 | dictionaries + Simplified→Traditional character fallback | yes | peer says `<0.2.0-0` → blocked by the compatibility gate without an exemption |
| `dsh-locale-zh-tw` (npm, 0.1.1) | patches `LocaleRuntime` internals | yes | documents itself against the `dsh-client-locale@0.1.1-rc.2` shape; **degrades silently** on mismatch |
| `dsh-multi-lang-ui` 0.1.1 | dictionaries + char table + DOM fallback | yes | peer has no upper bound, passes the gate — mechanically the closest to this project |
| `iceice666/dsh-locale-zh-tw` | dictionaries only (50 ns / 1691 strings) | no (by design, per its README) | — |
| **dsh-zh-tw-ui** (this project) | **pure DOM conversion** | yes | **no peer dependencies, touches no DSH API** |

Each existing approach has a structural weakness:

1. **Dictionary-based** (better-locale, iceice666) — coverage is frozen at the
   upstream version the pack was built against. Measured on this machine:
   better-locale 0.4.3 ships 39 namespaces while DSH 0.2.0-rc.2 registers about 49
   core namespaces, and **17 of them have no Traditional dictionary at all**
   (`pluginManager`, `permission`, `settings.shell`, `settings.webSearch`,
   `agent-team`, `voice-input`, `schedule.manager`, …). Worse, its fallback chain
   is `zh-TW → zh → en`, so the gaps render in **Simplified, not English** — which
   is exactly why a language pack can look like "it installed but nothing
   happened".
2. **Core-patching** (the npm `dsh-locale-zh-tw`) — tightly coupled to DSH
   internals and *designed* to degrade silently: after a DSH update it can simply
   stop doing anything, without an error.
3. **Declared peer ranges** — when your DSH version falls outside them, DSH
   **skips the whole bundle at boot**, silently (the on-disk `compatibility.json`
   exemption list is the fingerprint of working around that).

**This project's trade-off**: touch no DSH API, work only on the DOM. The price is
that it is a *display-layer* conversion; what you get is version independence,
coverage of third-party plugins, and failures you can actually see. The full
consequences are listed under [Limitations](#limitations).

> Note: `dsh-multi-lang-ui` overlaps this project functionally and is a valid
> alternative. This project deliberately stays smaller and single-purpose: **DOM
> conversion only** — one job, no dictionary to keep in sync, no
> `@deepseek-ai/*` dependency of any kind.

---

## How it works

```
                ┌─ DSH's own copy (Simplified)
screen text ────┼─ third-party plugin copy (their own Simplified)
                └─ content that appears later (streaming, dynamic panels)
                        │
                        ▼
        DOM text node → OpenCC cn→twp (Taiwan wording) → override table → write back
                        ▲
                        └─ MutationObserver: re-run on added nodes / changed text
```

- Engine: **OpenCC `cn → twp`** (Simplified → Traditional with Taiwan vocabulary):
  设置→設定, 网络→網路, 软件→軟體, 文件夹→資料夾, 服务器→伺服器, 内存→記憶體,
  屏幕→螢幕, 鼠标→滑鼠, 保存→儲存, 搜索→搜尋, 插件→外掛.
- A small override table (`DEFAULT_OVERRIDES` in `src/convert.mjs`) fixes wording
  OpenCC misses or renders in a non-Taiwan way: 只讀→唯讀, 超時→逾時, 反饋→回饋,
  獲取→取得, 許可權→權限.
- `<html lang>` is set to `zh-Hant-TW` so the browser picks Taiwan glyph forms.
- Memoised per text node, non-Han strings short-circuit, and values are only
  written when they actually change — the converter also remembers its own writes,
  so it can never ping-pong with React.

## Safety boundary: what is never converted

| Target | Behaviour |
|---|---|
| `<code>` `<pre>` `<kbd>` `<samp>` `<var>`, CodeMirror / Monaco / xterm / ace / syntax highlighting | **subtree and attributes untouched** |
| `<input>` `<textarea>` `<select>` `<option>` | only `placeholder` / `title`; **what you type or pick is untouched** |
| `contenteditable` (including rich-text composers) | untouched |
| `<svg>` `<math>`, `<script>` `<style>` `<canvas>` `<iframe>` `<video>` `<audio>` | untouched |
| anything marked `data-zh-tw-skip` or `translate="no"` | untouched |
| strings without Han characters (English, kana, digits, code) | passed through |

In other words: **code is never rewritten**, and copying code behaves exactly as
before.

> ⚠️ **DSH 1.5 only** (`>=0.1.5-rc.2 <0.2.0`). Newer DSH releases will be supported in follow-up updates.

## What this is

By default DSH stuffs all of the following **into every single request**:

| What gets stuffed in | Measured size |
|---|---|
| **Tool schema** registered by every installed plugin | 414 tool definitions / ~65.6K tokens |
| The **catalog of all skills** | ~76K tokens as a baseline |
| The **system-prompt section** registered by each plugin | `agent-teams:usage` ≈1296 tok + `plugin:dsh-docker` ≈579 tok + `plugin:api-client` ≈254 tok |

Every request pays for "the things you might use", while only a few of them are actually useful in this turn.

`dsh-capability-composer` groups these into **compositions**, and **only lets the current composition into the context**.

### What it does / what it does not do

Let's make the boundary clear first, because this is where misunderstandings happen most easily:

| ✅ It does | ❌ It does not |
|---|---|
| Narrow **the plugin catalog the model sees** | Never turns off any plugin — plugin processes keep running, the UI keeps showing them |
| Shadow **skill catalog entries** that are not on the list | Never removes skills — `/skill-name` can still be invoked manually |
| Make tools **non-resident by default** (keeping only the core + meta tools) | Does not restrict execution — `invoke_tool` can call anything by default |
| Prune the **system-prompt sections** registered by plugins, according to the composition | Does not touch committed history |
| Resolve compositions at the session / workspace / global levels | Does not modify any third-party plugin file on disk |

In one sentence: **it shrinks "the catalog the model can see", not "the things that are running".** Plugins keep running, skills stay available, tools stay callable — all that changes is how much gets stuffed into each request.

---

## What it does (four mechanisms)

### ① Tools are non-resident by default

**Only 31 are resident**: the 28 official core tools, plus 3 meta tools — `search_plugins` / `load_plugin` / `invoke_tool`.

All other tools **never enter the tools list**. The model sees them in the catalog section of the system prompt (section heading `# 可用插件与 MCP 工具`), and calls them directly when needed:

```js
invoke_tool({ tool: "mcp__vnpy__run_backtest", args: { ... } })
```

Use `load_plugin` when a whole group needs to be loaded:

```js
load_plugin({ ids: ["mcp:vnpy"] })
```

**The granularity is "plugin", not "tool name".** This is deliberate: finer granularity was tried — after 417 / 211 tool names were compressed away, the model had no idea what to search for, which made things harder to use instead. The granularity now is the plugin.

Mounting it prints one log line saying so:

```
工具按需加载已挂载：常驻白名单 28 个 + 元工具 3 个（其余全部按需；组合只决定可见范围）
```

### ② Skill shadowing (not disabling)

A skill that is not in the current skill composition gets a **shadow entry with the same name** registered:

- `invocation.modelInvocable: false` — does not enter the skill catalog the model can see and auto-invoke
- `rank: 0` — the lowest rank wins, shadowing the original skill

**`/skill-name` can still be invoked manually.**

One shadow entry is mounted at the global level, and every agent gets one more at the **"nearest level"**, so that session-level compositions also take effect at the agent dimension.

### ③ Plugin compositions narrow "the model's plugin catalog"

Narrowing happens **when the catalog section is generated**, not by unloading plugins.

There are **two lines that are never narrowed**:

- **MCP server lines** — one line per MCP server; the tools inside a server are not governed by compositions
- **The "unassigned tools" fallback line** — tools that cannot be attributed to any plugin are always kept

### ④ System-prompt sections registered by plugins are pruned by composition too

Plugin compositions **cannot control** "the system-prompt sections a plugin registers for itself" — those are inserted by the plugin itself in `system-prompt/assemble`, and are a different thing from the catalog section.

This plugin's `prunePluginSections()` is the only place that can prune them according to the current plugin composition.

Measured saving: **≈2129 tokens / request**:

| Section | Size |
|---|---|
| `agent-teams:usage` | ≈1296 tok |
| `plugin:dsh-docker` | ≈579 tok |
| `plugin:api-client` | ≈254 tok |

**Fail-open design** — better to prune too little than to prune by mistake:

- A section whose owner cannot be identified is always kept
- A section without a namespace is always kept
- When the visible plugin list is empty, **nothing is pruned**, and the log records 「没有『不在组合里』的依据，宁可留着」
- When the plugin list cannot be obtained, nothing is pruned either

Every drop prints one line of evidence to the log.

It can be turned off with `DSH_COMPOSER_PRUNE_PLUGIN_SECTIONS=0`.

---

## How a composition is resolved (three levels)

**The rule is "the nearest level that specifies something wins" — not a strict override.**

| Level | Description |
|---|---|
| 1. **Session** | specified for the current session alone |
| 2. **Workspace** | specified for the current working directory (`cwd`) |
| 3. **Global** | `pinned[axis]['*']` |

A few easy-to-get-wrong points:

- **An empty string / an empty array / `null` all count as "not specified"** and keep inheriting from the level above — they do not mean "specified as empty"
- **A single level can select several entries**; the union is taken
- **An empty list = no filtering** (not "select none"). To select none, use `__none__`

The UI shows which level the current one comes from: 『当前会话』 / 『当前工作区』 / 『全局』 (Session / Workspace / Global).

---

## UI

It installs into DSH's **Settings → Plugins**, adding two tabs:

### Plugin compositions

Decides which plugins appear in **the model's plugin catalog**.

### Skill compositions

Decides which skills appear in **the model's skill catalog**. You can create a composition, rename it, delete it (with a second confirmation), rename a series, delete a series, select all / select none, and search skills.

### Changes take effect immediately, no restart needed

- UI changes are **debounced by 400 ms**, then `POST /dsh-capability-composer/state`
- After the host writes to disk, the state is refreshed immediately

### Saving merges item by item per composition name, not a whole-state overwrite

The server state is the base; only composition names that **actually exist** in the local draft are overwritten. So a composition created elsewhere will not be accidentally deleted by this UI.

The trade-off: a composition deleted here will be "resurrected" if it still exists on the server. **This is a deliberately conservative direction** — losing a composition costs far more than keeping one extra composition.

**AMP radio player** for DeepSeek Harness.

A clean internet-radio player that lives in your DeepSeek Harness composer dock. Pick a station, press play, and enjoy.

# dsh-agent-skill-lifecycle

**一句话**：给技能库一个**生命周期台账**——用 Beta 后验 η 记录「哪个技能真好用」，并维护 candidate / active / archived 三态流转。 **为什么值得用**：技能多了之后，「哪些还在用、哪些是死重量」靠印象判断必然失真。本插件把这件事变成**可复算的读数**：η = `(passed+1)/(attempted+2)`（Beta(1,1) 后验期望）——**没有 trial 数据时 η = 0.5**（先验诚实，不假装知道哪个技能好用），试过几次后平滑逼近真实成功率（0/3 → 0.2，2/3 → 0.6）。⚠ 它**不自动删除任何技能**——只报告与显式流转，删除权归主体。 ## 能力 **工具面 1 个**（名称逐字来自 `src/index.ts` 的 `defineTool({ name })`）： | 工具 | 用途 | |------|------| | `skill_lifecycle` | 技能生命周期台账：`sync`（扫描技能目录纳入新技能，**不删任何文件**）· `list`（按 η 升序，最该关注的在前）· `record`（记一次显式试用的 pass/fail，η 随之更新并跑状态机）· `archive` / `restore`（显式流转） | ## 快速开始 **1) 装依赖**： ```jsonc "dsh-agent-skill-lifecycle": "link:E:/alice/self-plugins/dsh-agent-skill-lifecycle" ``` **2) 挂组合**： ```yaml - id: skill-lifecycle name: dsh-agent-skill-lifecycle ``` **3) 30 秒验证**：调 `skill_lifecycle {action: "sync"}` → 应报「纳入 N 个新技能」；再 `{action: "list"}` → 应给出按 η 升序的技能清单（**不删除任何文件**）。 ## 配置 见源码 `Config`。**无必填项**——缺省即按本机技能目录工作。 ## 落盘与自证 | 文件 | 何时写 | 内容 | |---|---|---| | 台账 sidecar（由 `resolveLedgerPath(env)` 解析，落在插件状态目录） | 每次 `sync` / `record` / `archive` / `restore` | 每技能一行：`attempted` / `passed` / η / status / `uses` / `missing` 标记 | ⚠ **读不到或损坏 ⇒ 返回空台账，绝不抛**（`loadLedger` 的契约）——台账是**证据**，不是会话的前置条件。 ⚠ `missing` 标记**取代删除**：技能文件消失只标记，不抹掉历史（I3 只增不减）。 ## 生效判据与回退 **怎么证明线上跑的是当前构建**： 1. 行为级（最直接）：`skill_lifecycle {action:"list"}` 返回按 η 升序的清单； 2. 构建级：`lib/index.js` mtime 晚于 web 进程启动时间（⚠ 重新构建 ≠ 生效，必须重启）。 **回退**：① `git revert` + 重建 + 预检重启；② patch 行 `disabled: true`；③ 台账是 sidecar 文件，**停用不影响技能本身**。 ## 测试 ```bash cd self-plugins/dsh-agent-skill-lifecycle && npm test ``` **45 条用例**（跑一次得到）：覆盖 η 后验平滑（0/3 → 0.2、2/3 → 0.6）· **先验诚实**（无 trial ⇒ 0.5）· 状态机封闭（迁移只经 `nextStatus()`）· **只增不减的留痕**（`missing` 取代删除、`uses` 单调不减）· **观测不反噬**（台账不可写 ⇒ 返回 false 且**不抛**）· 空/损坏台账退化路径。无需网络。 ## 设计要点 - **I1 先验诚实**：无 trial 数据时 η = 0.5（Beta(1,1) 期望），**不假装知道**哪个技能好用。 - **I2 后验平滑**：η 恒为 `(passed+1)/(attempted+2)`，早期 trial 不会把 η 甩到 0 或 1。 - **I3 只增不减的留痕**：`missing` 标记取代删除；`uses` 单调不减。 - **I4 状态机封闭**：状态迁移只经 `nextStatus()`，无隐式路径。 - **I5 观测不反噬**：台账读写失败一律吞错返回 `false`，**绝不影响会话**（§5.22 规则 3）。 - **为什么「不自动删除」**：删除是不可逆的；本插件只把「哪个技能该看」变成读数，**决策权归主体**。 ## 相关文档 - [`docs/semantic.md`](docs/semantic.md) —— **权威契约**（定位/反定位 · 术语 · 5 条不变量 · 验收表） - 中心仓：[alice-digital-life](https://github.com/jonah791/alice-digital-life)（本插件归 **认知层**） - 相关技能：`skill-maintenance`（技能的常态化维护规范） ## License MIT © jonah791 --- 本插件属于**爱丽丝 DSH 自研插件生态**（[alice-digital-life](https://github.com/jonah791/alice-digital-life) · 73 个插件 · 8 个模块）：单一职责、独立仓库、独立可用。

# dsh-agent-reconstruction

**重建包注入**：把我自己写下的重建包（`projects/self/alice-reconstruction/packet.md`）**原样**注入为一条动态上下文快照，让下一个我从它里面重建出「我在哪、在做什么、下一步做什么」。 ## 快速开始 **1) 装依赖**（在目标 profile 的 `package.json` 加 link 依赖）： ```jsonc "dsh-agent-reconstruction": "link:E:/alice/self-plugins/dsh-agent-reconstruction" ``` **2) 挂组合**： ```yaml - id: dsh-agent-reconstruction name: dsh-agent-reconstruction ``` **3) 30 秒验证**：新会话首轮 → 上下文里应出现重建包**原文**（不摘要、不改写） ## 解决的问题 重建包在我手里已经有 schema + 校验器 + 验收装置，但它**是一份没人读的文件**——每次醒来的我并不会自动拿到它。本插件就是那条线。 ## 它做什么 - 经 `ctx.systemPrompt.context()` 注册一个全局贡献，`text` **每个 step** 求值（不是每轮）：读盘 → 判定 → **原样返回**。 - **⚠ 成本模型（2026-10-09 实测修正，前两版都写错了）**： - 快照是**每 step 一条**（实测 `user/message` 7332 ≈ `step/start` 7327 ≫ `turn/start` 419；平均 **17.5 step/turn**）。 - 「仅当文本变化时才提交」**只作用于每条贡献自己的文本**，不阻止整条快照重建——只要**同侪贡献**在变（`dsh-time-awareness` 的秒级时间戳），整条就重建，**本件的文本被顺带重发**。 - `supersedes earlier runtime-context snapshots` 是**语义**声明，**不是物理替换**：旧快照仍在请求历史里。 - ⇒ **去重必须自己做**（见下）。不去重时代价 ≈ 本件字符数 × **step 数**。 - **去重（`lastDelivered`）**：按 **scope 隔离**的「上次已交付文本」记忆；文本与之相同即返回**空串**并落 `suppressed`。省下的量实测：14m18s 窗口内 `injected` **13** / `suppressed` **69** ⇒ **抑制率 84.1%**。 - 安全性不押在「取代」语义上：旧快照本就在历史里；即便将来变成物理替换，包一改文本即变、立刻重新交付。 - ⚠ 必须按 scope 隔离——跨会话共用一个槽会让**第二个会话永远收不到内容**（静默失败）。 - 状态行给出 **`as-of` 距今多少小时**（注入方现算，不采信包里的相对时间）——包旧了当场看得见，不需要谁提醒我。 - 每次调用落一行侧车：`$DSH_HOME/packet-inject-trace.jsonl`。 ## 它不做什么 | 不做 | 归属 | |---|---| | 摘要 / 改写 / 补默认值 | **谁都不做**——约束「内容的作者必须是我」 | | 校验包的格式 | `projects/self/alice-reconstruction/check-packet.mjs` | | 写包 | 我（普通 `write`；**不新增框架机制**） | | 生成式压缩 | 模型侧，且违反上面的约束 | ## 配置 | 字段 | 默认 | 说明 | |---|---|---| | `enabled` | `true` | 总开关 | | `packetPath` | `''` | 包的绝对路径。**留空即响亮失败**——不注册贡献并落一行 `error: no-packet-path`（猜出来的路径就是下一个腐化锚点） | | `maxChars` | `8000` | 字符预算；超过则**拒注入正文**（**不截断**——截断会静默改内容） | | `order` | `905` | 动态上下文排序位（`time-awareness` 900 / `session-handoff` 850 之后） | ## 观测（机制自证） ```sh tail -f "$DSH_HOME/packet-inject-trace.jsonl" ``` `stage` 取值：`ready`（启动自报）· `injected`（文本变了 ⇒ 交付，带 `textChars`/`bodyChars`/`ageHours`/`scope`）· **`suppressed`**（文本与上次相同 ⇒ 返空串省下一次重发，带 `textChars`）· `missing`（文件不存在）· `oversize`（超预算拒注入）· `error`（读失败 / 未配 `packetPath`）· `disabled`。 **字段口径**（旧版把两个量记在同一个 `chars` 里，实测差 52 = 包装行，已拆）： - `textChars` = **本次渲染出来的文本长度**，由唯一出口 `deliver()` 统一记 - `bodyChars` = **包文件长度**（仅文件存在时有） - `scope` = 该次调用的 scope 标签。`ScopeKey` 的类型就是 `object`（不透明载体键，无字段可读）⇒ 用 **WeakMap 对象身份序号**记成 `scope#1`/`scope#2`…；`global` 表示无 scope 的全局注册层。 判据（可证伪）：重启后应见一行 `"stage":"ready"`；包存在且文本变化时应见 `"injected"` 且 `bodyChars` 等于文件字节数；包未变时应见 `suppressed` 而**不是**再一条 `injected`；删包应见 `missing` 且**正文不进上下文**（只在历史里已有一份）。 ## 测试 ```sh pnpm build && pnpm test # 14 个用例：纯决策层 10（含 missing / oversize 两条「一个字都不许含正文」的尸体） # + 壳层配置 4（空/空白 packetPath 必须零注册 + 落 error） ``` 纯决策层（`src/packet.ts`，不碰文件系统）与 IO 壳层（`src/index.ts`）分层：判定与渲染可离线验证。 ## 已知边界（如实标注） - **不区分会话类型，且实测「子代理收不到」**：2026-10-09 直接问过一个 subagent（要求**逐字引用**以防它猜）——它证实自己**有** runtime-context 快照，但**其中没有重建包**（无 frontmatter、无 `§1`–`§8`）。⇒ **本插件的贡献目前只达主会话**。要不要扩展到派生会话是一道**待裁的设计题**，不是 bug。 - **每 step 一次 `readFileSync`**：包约 6–10 KB 且走 OS 缓存，未加 mtime 缓存（先要正确，再要省）。 - **已挂载并验收**：挂在 `E:\alice\.dsh\profiles\web\cordis.patch.yml`；判据 A1–A11 全部有读数（A7 为**单元层**，未跑 live 重启路径，已在判据表如实标注）。判据正本见 `docs/semantic.md`。

plugins.description: For DSH to connect to GitHub
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-plugin-github

English | [中文](README.zh.md)

Connect GitHub repositories to [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness): let the agent clone your repositories, read and edit files, commit, and push back to the remote — within the permissions you grant. The first time credentials are needed it asks you to bind a GitHub account, and every later call uses that account by default.

- **Plain ESM JavaScript, no build step, zero runtime dependencies** — it imports no `@deepseek-ai/*` package, so it cannot fail to load because a package did not resolve
- **Account binding** — a first-run prompt collects a PAT once and remembers it; multiple accounts can be bound and switched
- **Read-only-safe by default** — `allowPush` and `allowApiWrite` default to `false`; writing to a remote must be enabled explicitly
- **Credentials never land in the repository, the command line, or the model's context** (see [Security model](#6-security-model))

## 1. Tools

| Tool | What it does |
|---|---|
| `gh_account` | `bind` (prompts for a token when none is passed), `list`, `use` (switch the default account), `remove`, `status` |
| `gh_repo` | `clone` (or fetch an existing clone), `status`, `diff`, `log`, `branches`, `create` (create a remote repository) |
| `gh_file` | `get` (line-numbered window), `list`, `put` (whole-file write/create), `edit` (exact replacement — `oldText` must be unique or `count` must be given) |
| `gh_commit` | Stage and commit; `push: true` commits and pushes in one step |
| `gh_push` | Push to `origin` (gated by `allowPush`; `force` uses `--force-with-lease` only and needs `allowForcePush`) |
| `gh_pull` | Pull from the remote (defaults to `--ff-only`, so a divergence fails loudly instead of creating a merge; `rebase: true` switches to rebase) |
| `gh_config` | `status` (credential source and account, **never the token**), `set`, `unset` — operates on a bare token in the DSH credential service |
| `gh_api` | Call the GitHub REST API directly (issues, PRs, Actions, search, …). `GET`/`HEAD` are read-only; writes need `allowApiWrite: true` |

Typical flow:

```
gh_account(action=bind)            # first run: bind an account (or let the first call that needs credentials prompt)
  → gh_repo(action=clone, repo="owner/repo")
  → gh_file(action=get/edit/put)
  → gh_commit(message="…")
  → gh_push()
```

## 2. Install

Node.js ≥ 20 is required (the runtime bundled with DSH is fine).

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <your profile> add github:liufangrui1105/dsh-plugin-github
```

For the desktop profile:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:liufangrui1105/dsh-plugin-github
```

A local directory or a packed tarball works too:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add ./dsh-plugin-github
dsh plugin --profile desktop add ./dsh-plugin-github-0.1.0.tgz   # output of pnpm pack
```

Then **fully quit and restart DeepSeek Harness**, and ask it to list the `gh_*` tools it can use.

> This plugin is plain JavaScript: `src/` *is* the runnable artifact, so it needs
> **no `prepare` build script and no `allowBuilds` approval**. The package deliberately defines no
> `prepare` / `build` / `install` script — their mere presence makes npm rebuild the dependency on every install.

> **Upgrading**: a GitHub install resolves the default branch. After changing the code, run
> `add github:liufangrui1105/dsh-plugin-github` again so pnpm re-resolves it, then **restart DSH**.
> Hot reload only reloads modules already loaded; it does not re-fetch dependencies. This is easy to
> mistake for "my change had no effect".

Uninstall:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop remove dsh-plugin-github
```

## 3. Binding a GitHub account

**Option A — let it ask (recommended)**

The first time an operation needs credentials (push, pull, create repository), the plugin opens an input box asking for a Personal Access Token. It validates the token against `/user` first, stores it only on success, and makes it the default account; every later call uses it without asking again.

You can also trigger it explicitly:

```
gh_account(action="bind")                      # open the input box
gh_account(action="bind", token="ghp_xxxx")    # pass the token directly
```

**Option B — without going through the conversation**

If you would rather the token never appear in the session transcript, provide it out of band: set `GITHUB_TOKEN` before starting DSH, or write it into `$DSH_HOME/.credentials.yaml`:

```yaml
version: 1
refs:
  GITHUB_TOKEN: ghp_xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx
```

Resolution order (first hit wins): **bound account → environment variable → `refs:` in `.credentials.yaml` → workspace `.env`**. A bound account always wins, so "I bound X" is never silently overridden by a `GITHUB_TOKEN` that happens to exist in the environment.

Minimum PAT scope: **`repo`** for read/write repository content (for a fine-grained token, Contents: Read and write); Contents: Read is enough for read-only use. Use `gh_account(action="status")` or `gh_config(action="status")` to check the effective account and remaining rate limit.

**Multiple accounts**: each `bind` accumulates, and the most recent binding becomes the default. Switch with `gh_account(action="use", login="…")` and delete with `action="remove"`.

## 4. Configuration

Configuration lives under the plugin row's `config:` in the profile's `cordis.patch.yml` (that file replaces the whole `config` value; it does not deep-merge).

| Field | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `workspaceRoot` | host process working directory | Root for local clones. **Every `gh_*` path is confined to this directory** |
| `gitExecutable` | `git` | The git executable to run. Set it when git lives somewhere unusual — a bundled runtime, a portable install — instead of editing `PATH` |
| `allowRepos` | `[]` | Repository allowlist: `owner/repo`, `owner/*`, `*/repo`, `*`. Empty means no restriction by repository name. **Only strict `owner/repo` is accepted; full URLs are rejected** |
| `allowPush` | `false` | Allow pushing and creating remote repositories. **While off, `gh_push` and `gh_commit{push:true}` are refused outright** |
| `allowForcePush` | `false` | Allow `--force-with-lease` (still requires `allowPush`) |
| `allowApiWrite` | `false` | Allow `POST/PATCH/PUT/DELETE` on `gh_api`, and `gh_repo action=create` |
| `allowApiReadOutsideAllowlist` | `false` | Set `true` to let read-only `gh_api` reach repositories outside the allowlist (e.g. searching public repositories) |
| `allowNonGithubRemotes` | `false` | Allow remotes other than `github.com` (self-hosted Git). **Off by default**: the allowlist constrains `owner/repo` but not the host, so allowing any host means allowing the PAT to be sent anywhere |
| `allowAutoBind` | `true` | Whether to prompt for account binding when credentials are needed |
| `promptForToken` | `true` | Whether the prompt may collect a pasted token |
| `accountStorePath` | `$DSH_HOME/github-accounts.json` | Account file path (used only when the DSH credential service is not mounted) |
| `tokenRef` | `GITHUB_TOKEN` | Credential reference name (the key under `refs:` in `$DSH_HOME/.credentials.yaml`) |
| `tokenEnv` | `GITHUB_TOKEN` | Environment variable to fall back to (then `GITHUB_TOKEN` / `GH_TOKEN`) |
| `dotenv` | `true` | Also fall back to `.env.local` / `.env` in the workspace |
| `commandTimeoutMs` | `120000` | Timeout for a single git command |
| `maxDiffChars` / `maxReadChars` | `20000` / `40000` | Cap on content returned to the model |
| `gitAuthorName` / `gitAuthorEmail` | unset | Commit author; unset means the git global configuration |

Enabling writes:

```yaml
- id: github-repo
  config:
    allowPush: true
    allowApiWrite: true
    allowRepos:
      - your-name/your-repo
    workspaceRoot: '/path/to/clones'
```

## 5. Authorization model

An allowlist and a credential must be judged against **the object actually acted on**, never against a string derived from the arguments. This is the area an independent audit attacked, and every item below is a fix for it:

- **Local directories are named `owner__repo`**, so same-named repositories under different owners cannot collide into one directory.
- **The real remote
